items.title_en: PDAC BioPortal: An Integrated Web Resource for Multi-Scale Analysis of Pancreatic Cancer Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: PDAC BioPortal：用于胰腺癌转录组学多尺度分析的综合网络资源
items.abstract_en: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) exhibits extensive molecular heterogeneity and undergoes substantial transcriptional remodeling across disease and treatment contexts. However, publicly available PDAC transcriptomic resources remain fragmented across experimental modalities, limiting the integrated investigation of molecular programs across biological scales and cellular compartments. Here, we developed PDAC BioPortal, an integrated web-based analytical resource for multimodal interrogation of PDAC transcriptomics. The platform incorporates bulk RNA sequencing, treatment-associated transcriptomics, single-nucleus RNA sequencing, and spatial transcriptomics. It integrates 349 TCGA-GTEx samples, including a primary tumor-versus-normal comparison of 178 PDAC tumors and 167 normal pancreas specimens; a clinically annotated treatment-associated cohort of 55 specimens (GSE225767); a single-nucleus atlas comprising 224,988 nuclei from 43 patients (GSE202051); and spatial transcriptomic profiles encompassing 23,436 tissue spots from five patients (GSE274103). The platform provides interactive differential expression analysis, over-representation analysis, gene set enrichment analysis, patient-aware pseudobulk comparisons, cell-type-resolved interrogation, and spatial gene-expression visualization. It additionally incorporates PDACopilot, an evidence-grounded natural-language interface connecting user queries with structured datasets and precomputed analytical results. Application of the platform revealed distinct transcriptional architectures across disease and treatment contexts. Primary PDAC exhibited prominent proliferation-associated, inflammatory, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition-related programs, whereas specimens obtained following neoadjuvant chemotherapy and stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) showed prominent mesenchymal, collagen, and extracellular matrix-associated signatures. Comparison of independent bulk and single-nucleus treatment-associated datasets demonstrated significant pathway rank-order concordance, despite limited linear correlation. Focused interrogation of the NRF2-associated redox network revealed broad transcriptional elevation in primary PDAC, involving antioxidant-response, glutathione metabolism, and NADPH-generating genes. Treatment-associated bulk transcriptomes exhibited selective remodeling of individual network components rather than uniform expression changes. At single-nucleus resolution, NFE2L2 expression exhibited cell-type-dependent patterns, with significant patient-level increases in selected vascular, immune, and endocrine populations across the neoadjuvant-treated cohort and reduced expression in malignant epithelial cells in the standard chemoradiotherapy subgroup. Spatial profiling further revealed interpatient variation in NFE2L2 transcript distribution across treatment-naive PDAC tissues, with differences in the proportion of positive spots despite comparatively consistent expression intensity among positive spots. Higher expression of a selected six-gene NRF2-associated signature was also associated with shorter overall survival, providing an exploratory link between redox-associated transcriptional patterns and clinical outcome. Together, PDAC BioPortal provides an integrated analytical infrastructure for investigating PDAC transcriptional programs across complementary cohorts and biological resolutions. By combining interactive bioinformatics capabilities with evidence-grounded AI-assisted exploration, the platform facilitates cross-dataset molecular interpretation and hypothesis generation while distinguishing transcriptional associations from mechanistic evidence.
items.abstract_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）表现出广泛的分子异质性，并在疾病和治疗背景下经历显著的转录重塑。然而，公开可用的 PDAC 转录组资源仍分散于不同实验模态中，限制了跨生物学尺度和细胞区室的分子程序整合研究。在此，我们开发了 PDAC BioPortal，一个用于 PDAC 转录组多模态解析的集成式网络分析资源。该平台整合了批量 RNA 测序、治疗相关转录组学、单核 RNA 测序和空间转录组学。它整合了 349 个 TCGA-GTEx 样本，包括 178 个 PDAC 肿瘤与 167 个正常胰腺标本的原发肿瘤对正常比较；一个经临床注释的 55 份标本治疗相关队列（GSE225767）；一个包含来自 43 名患者的 224,988 个细胞核的单核图谱（GSE202051）；以及包含来自 5 名患者的 23,436 个组织斑点的空间转录组图谱（GSE274103）。平台提供交互式差异表达分析、过表征分析、基因集富集分析、患者感知的伪批量比较、细胞类型解析的探查和空间基因表达可视化。它还整合了 PDACopilot，一个以证据为基础的自然语言接口，将用户查询与结构化数据集和预计算分析结果连接起来。平台应用揭示了不同疾病和治疗背景下不同的转录架构。原发 PDAC 表现出显著的增殖相关、炎症和上皮-间质转化相关程序，而新辅助化疗和立体定向体部放疗（SBRT）后获得的标本显示出显著的间充质、胶原和细胞外基质相关特征。对独立的批量与单核治疗相关数据集的比较表明，尽管线性相关性有限，通路排序具有显著一致性。对 NRF2 相关氧化还原网络的聚焦探查显示，原发 PDAC 中广泛的转录升高，涉及抗氧化反应、谷胱甘肽代谢和 NADPH 生成基因。治疗相关批量转录组表现出单个网络组分的选择性重塑，而非一致的表达变化。在单核分辨率下，NFE2L2 表达呈现细胞类型依赖模式：在新辅助治疗队列中，选定的血管、免疫和内分泌群体在患者水平显著增加，而在标准化放化疗亚组中恶性上皮细胞表达降低。空间分析进一步揭示，在初治 PDAC 组织中，NFE2L2 转录本分布存在患者间差异，尽管阳性斑点的表达强度相对一致，但阳性斑点比例存在差异。选定的六基因 NRF2 相关特征较高表达也与较短总生存期相关，提供了氧化还原相关转录模式与临床结果之间的探索性联系。总之，PDAC BioPortal 提供了集成的分析基础设施，用于跨互补队列和生物分辨率研究 PDAC 转录程序。通过将交互式生物信息学能力与基于证据的 AI 辅助探索相结合，该平台促进跨数据集分子解释和假设生成，同时区分转录关联与机制证据。

items.title_en: A fast and accurate model for gradient-based inverse design of multimode waveguides
items.title_zh: 一种用于多模波导基于梯度逆向设计的快速准确模型
items.abstract_en: Multimode photonic inverse design requires fast, accurate computational models that provide geometry gradients. Based on coupled-mode theory (CMT), we propose a differentiable surrogate model. Its parameter-extraction method uses a change of modal basis to obtain coupled-mode parameters from cross-sectional mode data. We also provide a complete, easy-to-implement propagation and optimization workflow. Using finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulation data as a common reference, we compare the prediction accuracy of our model and forward dataset-based eigenmode expansion (EME) for randomly generated thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) waveguide profiles that traverse modal coupling regions. Using identical modal libraries, the model reduces the maximum per-mode mean absolute transmission error by 17-37% compared with forward EME. We demonstrate a spot-size converter design that preserves the fundamental TM$_0$ mode in its hybridization region with the first-order TE$_1$ mode and obtain nine structures, each with FDTD-verified transmission above 98%. These tests demonstrate the model's utility for large-scale photonic inverse design, enabling rapid exploration of the design parameter space by combining gradient information with improved prediction accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 多模光子逆向设计需要快速、准确且能提供几何梯度的计算模型。基于耦合模理论（CMT），我们提出一种可微代理模型。其参数提取方法使用模态基变换，从横截面模式数据获得耦合模参数。我们还提供完整、易于实现的传播与优化工作流程。以时域有限差分（FDTD）仿真数据作为共同参考，我们针对随机生成的、穿越模态耦合区域的薄膜铌酸锂（TFLN）波导轮廓，比较了我们的模型与基于前向数据集的模式展开（EME）的预测精度。使用相同的模态库，与前向 EME 相比，该模型将每个模式平均绝对传输误差的最大值降低了 17-37%。我们展示了一个光斑尺寸转换器设计，该设计在其与一阶 TE$_1$ 模式的杂化区域中保持基模 TM$_0$ 模式，并获得了九个结构，每个结构的 FDTD 验证传输率均高于 98%。这些测试证明了该模型在大规模光子逆向设计中的实用性，通过将梯度信息与改进的预测精度相结合，能够快速探索设计参数空间。

items.title_en: Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
items.title_zh: 从次优数据中学习潜动作策略
items.abstract_en: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn control representations from action-free video, but existing pipelines typically train latent policies with behavioral cloning, without an explicit policy improvement objective. Although offline RL offers a natural approach to policy improvement, standard methods do not transfer directly to learned latent action spaces. We find that the structure of learned latent actions makes naive offline RL unreliable: directly maximizing value over latent actions or fitting a unimodal policy can produce latent actions that cannot be realized by physical execution, while the latent representation can merge physical controls that receive different rewards. To understand when latent-space optimization remains valid, we derive conditions under which policy improvement transfers to decoded execution and under which latent and physical optima align. Building on these insights, we propose LAPIS for goal-conditioned latent policy improvement, grounding value-based policy improvement in observed state-latent transitions and using a conditional flow policy to capture their multimodal structure. LAPIS outperforms baselines on most tasks, with the clearest gains in visual manipulation, and remains effective even with only 1% action labels, where competing methods largely collapse.
items.abstract_zh: 潜动作模型（LAM）可从无动作标注的视频中学习控制表示，但现有流程通常只用行为克隆训练潜策略，缺少显式的策略改进目标。离线强化学习（RL）天然适合策略改进，然而标准方法并不能直接迁移到学习得到的潜动作空间。我们发现，潜动作的结构会使朴素的离线 RL 不可靠：直接在潜动作上最大化价值或拟合单峰策略，可能产生物理执行无法实现的潜动作；潜表示还可能把获得不同奖励的物理控制合并在一起。为厘清潜空间优化何时仍然有效，我们推导了策略改进可迁移到解码执行的成立条件，以及潜最优与物理最优对齐的条件。基于这些分析，我们提出 LAPIS，用于目标条件潜策略改进：它把基于价值的策略改进锚定在观测到的“状态—潜动作”转移上，并用条件流策略刻画其多模态结构。LAPIS 在多数任务上优于基线，在视觉操作任务上增益最明显；即使只有 1% 的动作标签，它依然有效，而对比方法大多崩溃。
items.highlight_zh: LAPIS把离线RL安全地搬到潜动作空间，仅1%动作标签仍有效
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：机器人学习常面临动作标签昂贵的问题。潜动作模型（LAM）能从没有动作标注的视频里学出一套“潜动作”表示，但现有做法下游只用行为克隆——即照抄数据里的行为，没有主动“改进策略”。离线强化学习本可用于改进，可是直接搬到潜动作空间往往失效。
2）关键发现：作者指出两处结构性问题。其一，潜动作是学出来的，直接在其上最大化价值、或拟合一个单峰策略，可能给出物理上根本执行不出来的动作；其二，潜表示可能把奖励不同、但看起来相似的物理控制合并成同一个潜动作，导致优化方向错误。为此他们推导了两个条件：策略改进在什么条件下能迁移到解码后的真实执行，潜空间最优在什么条件下与物理最优一致。
3）用了什么方法：基于上述分析，提出 LAPIS，做目标条件的潜策略改进。它把基于价值的策略改进“锚定”在数据中真实观测到的状态—潜动作转移上，避免凭空生成不可执行的潜动作；再用条件流策略捕捉潜动作的多模态结构，而不是强行压成单峰分布。
4）有什么结果：LAPIS 在多数任务上超过基线方法，视觉操作任务提升最明显；在只有 1% 动作标签的极低监督下仍然有效，而对比方法大多性能崩溃。
5）为何重要：它给了“大量无标注视频 + 极少量动作标签”这一现实场景一条可行的策略改进路径，同时把潜空间优化的可靠性问题从经验试错推进到有理论条件的分析。

items.title_en: Thinking Harder Doesn't Lead to Better Choices: Reasoning Effort Increases the Confidence but Not the Correctness of LLM Shopping Agents
items.title_zh: 想得更久并不能带来更好的选择：推理努力提高了 LLM 购物智能体的置信度，但未提高其正确性
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous shopping agents that process multimodal product listings (consisting of visual and text data) and recommend purchases on behalf of consumers. Naturally, one might assume that models with more thinking power would make higher-quality purchasing decisions. To test this belief, we ask two questions about such agents: does asking a model to think harder make it choose better products, and does the confidence it reports tell us the likelihood it may be wrong? We benchmark ten frontier models on three product-choice benchmarks built from WebShop, Amazon's SQID and Wayfair's WANDS platforms to see if LLMs with more thinking power actually make better-quality product purchase decisions. Across all three benchmarks, we found that increasing the thinking effort does not increase decision quality in a statistically meaningful way. The same change in thinking effort raises stated confidence at a statistically significant level, so extra thinking buys confidence rather than correctness. We also measure the calibration of these models (how well their reported confidence percentage matches their true correctness percentage) in these tasks and show that most models are not well-calibrated at every effort level. We also find that errors are strongly shared: when one model errs in a task, several others tend to err on that same task. Furthermore, on tasks where several models all err, a large number of them pick the same wrong product.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被部署为自主购物智能体，它们处理多模态商品列表（由视觉和文本数据组成），并代表消费者推荐购买。人们自然会假设，具有更强思考能力的模型会做出更高质量的购买决策。为检验这一信念，我们针对此类智能体提出两个问题：要求模型更努力思考是否会让它选择更好的产品，以及它报告的置信度是否能告诉我们它可能出错的可能性？我们在由 WebShop、亚马逊的 SQID 和 Wayfair 的 WANDS 平台构建的三个产品选择基准上对十个前沿模型进行基准测试，以检验具有更强思考能力的 LLM 是否确实做出更高质量的产品购买决策。在所有三个基准上，我们发现增加思考努力并不会以统计显著的方式提高决策质量。同样的思考努力变化以统计显著水平提高了所声明的置信度，因此额外的思考换来的是置信度而非正确性。我们还测量了这些模型在这些任务中的校准性（其报告的置信度百分比与真实正确率百分比的匹配程度），并表明大多数模型并非在每个努力水平上都校准良好。我们还发现错误具有强共享性：当一个模型在某任务上出错时，其他几个模型也往往在同一任务上出错。此外，在多个模型都出错的任务上，其中很大一部分选择了相同的错误产品。

items.title_en: Learning What Actions Change: Action Effect Matching for Dynamics-Faithful World Models
items.title_zh: 学习动作改变了什么：用于动力学忠实世界模型的动作效应匹配
items.abstract_en: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. Yet despite producing increasingly realistic videos, current world models often fail to capture how small action changes affect future observations. This limits their use in tasks such as robotic policy evaluation and model-based planning, where nearly identical actions can lead to qualitatively different outcomes. To address this, we propose AFFECT, an auxiliary training objective for learning the distribution of visual changes induced by action perturbations. Specifically, we inject temporally correlated noise into the actions of a policy trained on task-agnostic human teleoperation. We then train the world model so that its generated videos respond to this noise as the recorded videos do, without requiring repeated executions from the same initial state. Across OGBench simulation and real-world DROID and ALOHA-2 setups, AFFECT makes world-model rollouts more faithful to real outcomes. On DROID, the Pearson correlation between policy success rates in the world model and on the real robot rises from 0.47 to 0.79, alongside up to 23% lower FVD. These gains carry over to planning, where selecting actions with AFFECT-trained world models improves task success by up to 8.3%.
items.abstract_zh: 世界模型旨在预测动作下的环境动力学，从而无需在真实世界中执行动作即可预测动作后果。然而，尽管当前世界模型生成的视频越来越逼真，它们常常无法捕捉微小的动作变化如何影响未来观测。这限制了它们在机器人策略评估和基于模型的规划等任务中的使用，在这些任务中，几乎相同的动作可能导致性质不同的结果。为解决此问题，我们提出 AFFECT，一种辅助训练目标，用于学习由动作扰动引起的视觉变化分布。具体而言，我们向在任务无关的人类遥操作数据上训练的策略动作中注入时间相关噪声。然后训练世界模型，使其生成的视频对该噪声的响应与记录视频的响应一致，而无需从相同初始状态重复执行。在 OGBench 仿真以及真实世界 DROID 和 ALOHA-2 设置中，AFFECT 使世界模型推演更忠实于真实结果。在 DROID 上，世界模型中的策略成功率与真实机器人上的策略成功率之间的 Pearson 相关系数从 0.47 升至 0.79，同时 FVD 最多降低 23%。这些增益延续到规划中：使用 AFFECT 训练的世界模型选择动作可将任务成功率最多提升 8.3%。

items.title_en: FirstCross: Convex Single-Photon 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views
items.title_zh: FirstCross：基于稀疏视角的凸单光子三维重建
items.abstract_en: Single-photon lidar records the arrival time of each returning photon, enabling 3D reconstruction from few views and scarce photons. However, leading neural methods such as Transientangelo require over an hour of non-convex per-scene optimization, and their accuracy degrades as photon flux decreases. We propose FirstCross, a network-free approach that instead solves a short sequence of convex problems on a voxel grid. For a solid object, the Poisson likelihood of a ray with given signal and background rates depends on the scene solely through its first crossing, the point where the ray first enters the object. Decomposing this likelihood yields two tractable terms. The first penalizes surfaces in front of detected photons and admits a tight convex closure, namely volume rendering with a running-maximum transmittance in place of NeRF's product transmittance. The second accounts for photons that no surface explains and admits a convex upper bound once the object is assumed to be thick behind each detected surface point. Compared with Transientangelo under its own real-data protocol, FirstCross achieves lower depth error across every test scene, view count, and flux level. With three views and 100 times fewer photons than at the protocol's lowest flux, our mean object depth error stays under half of Transientangelo's with all photons. Given our detected surface points, the best classical fusion has 1.3 to 1.8 times our three-view error across flux levels. On real room-scale captures with 1% of their photons, TransientNeRF has 2.8 to 7.7 times our error. FirstCross lets few-view single-photon scanners cut exposure to 1% and reconstruct an object in about a minute on one GPU.
items.abstract_zh: 单光子激光雷达记录每个返回光子的到达时间，使从少量视角、稀少光子条件下进行三维重建成为可能。然而，如 Transientangelo 等领先的神经方法需要一小时以上的非凸逐场景优化，且精度随光子通量下降而退化。我们提出 FirstCross，一种无网络方法，改为在体素网格上求解一小串凸问题。对实心物体，在给定信号与背景速率下，一条光线的泊松似然仅通过“首次穿越点”（光线首次进入物体之处）依赖场景。分解该似然可得两个可处理项：第一项惩罚位于已探测光子之前的表面，并具有紧致的凸闭包，即用运行最大值透射率替代 NeRF 乘积透射率的体渲染；第二项解释没有表面能解释的光子，在假设每个探测表面点后方物体足够厚时具有凸上界。在与 Transientangelo 相同的真实数据协议下，FirstCross 在每个测试场景、每种视角数与每个通量水平上都取得更低深度误差。用三个视角、光子数比该协议最低通量还少 100 倍时，其平均物体深度误差仍不到 Transientangelo 使用全部光子时的一半。
items.highlight_zh: 凸优化替代神经网络，一分钟级稀疏光子三维重建
items.digest_zh:
① 研究的问题：单光子激光雷达能记录每个返回光子的到达时间，理论上只需少量视角和极少光子就能重建物体三维形状。但当前最强的神经方法（如 Transientangelo）需要针对每个场景做一小时以上的非凸优化，而且光子越少精度越差。
② 方法：作者提出 FirstCross，完全不用神经网络，改为在体素网格上求解一小串凸问题。关键洞察是：对实心物体，一条光线在给定信号／背景速率下的泊松似然，只通过“首次穿越点”（光线第一次进入物体之处）与场景相关。把似然分解为两项——第一项惩罚位于已探测光子之前的表面，具有紧致凸闭包，相当于在体渲染中用“运行最大值”透射率替代 NeRF 的乘积透射率；第二项负责解释没有表面能解释的光子，在假设每个探测表面点背后物体足够厚时可得凸上界。凸问题求解快速且稳定。
③ 结果：在与 Transientangelo 相同的真实数据协议下，FirstCross 在每个测试场景、每种视角数和每个光子通量水平上都取得更低深度误差。用 3 个视角、光子数比该协议最低通量还少 100 倍时，其平均物体深度误差仍不到 Transientangelo 使用全部光子时的一半；在真实房间级数据只用 1% 光子时，其误差比 TransientNeRF 低 2.8–7.7 倍。单张 GPU 上约一分钟即可完成重建。
④ 意义：证明不用重型神经优化也能做好稀疏光子重建，把曝光量降到 1%、重建时间压到分钟级，对实际单光子成像系统很有吸引力。

items.title_en: Entrenchment of germline amino-acid differences in antibody affinity maturation
items.title_zh: 抗体亲和力成熟中种系氨基酸差异的固化
items.abstract_en: Entrenchment - epistasis that locks in amino acid differences between homologous proteins, so each disfavors substitutions toward the other's state - has been demonstrated along individual protein lineages over deep evolutionary time. Antibodies offer a unique system for studying entrenchment: multiple homologous germline V gene paralogs provide diverse starting points, and the rapid somatic evolution of affinity maturation generates dense phylogenies from which selection on germline-encoded residues can be inferred. Using DASM, a deep-learning model that separates selection from mutation in antibody repertoire data, we test for entrenchment across immunoglobulin heavy chain variable (IGHV) genes. We detect entrenchment at two levels of germline divergence, driven by different sources of epistasis. Within V gene families (up to ~20% amino acid divergence), entrenched sites cluster at the borders of the complementarity-determining regions (CDRs, the antigen-binding loops) and show high germline diversity. These sites contact antigen, light chain, and the heavy-chain CDR3 loop, all of which vary independently of the IGHV germline. This pattern is consistent with epistasis from genetically uncoupled partners. Between V gene families, at deeper levels of divergence (25-40%), entrenchment additionally includes positions in the framework scaffold distant from binding interfaces, suggesting a larger contribution from intra-heavy-chain structural constraints. Observed mutation frequencies in human repertoires corroborate these predictions where data are sufficient. Together, these results demonstrate that the rapid somatic evolution of antibodies can serve as a lens for revealing epistatic constraints acting on germline-encoded residues, including constraints imposed by genetically uncoupled partners assembled during B cell development.
items.abstract_zh: 固化（entrenchment）——即锁定同源蛋白之间氨基酸差异、使各自不利于向对方状态替换的上位效应——已在深度演化时间尺度上沿单个蛋白谱系得到证明。抗体为研究固化提供了独特体系：多个同源种系V基因旁系同源物提供多样化起点，而亲和力成熟的快速体细胞演化产生密集的系统发育树，从中可推断对种系编码残基的选择。利用DASM——一种在抗体库数据中分离选择与突变的深度学习模型——我们检验了免疫球蛋白重链可变（IGHV）基因中的固化。我们在两个种系分化水平上检测到固化，其由不同来源的上位效应驱动。在V基因家族内（氨基酸分化最高约20%），固化位点聚集在互补决定区（CDR，即抗原结合环）边界，并表现出高种系多样性。这些位点接触抗原、轻链和重链CDR3环，而这些均独立于IGHV种系发生变异。该模式与来自遗传上非偶联伙伴的上位效应一致。在V基因家族之间，在更深的分化水平（25–40%），固化还额外包括远离结合界面的框架支架位置，提示重链内部结构约束贡献更大。在数据充分处，人抗体库中观察到的突变频率佐证了这些预测。总之，这些结果表明，抗体的快速体细胞演化可作为透镜，揭示作用于种系编码残基的上位约束，包括B细胞发育过程中组装的遗传上非偶联伙伴所施加的约束。

items.title_en: Orientation-Tunable Interfacial Thermal Conductance in Lateral MoSe2/MoS2 Heterostructures: A Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics Study
items.title_zh: 取向可调的横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构界面热导：深度势分子动力学研究
items.abstract_en: Managing heat flow across interfaces in lateral 2D transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures is a key challenge for next-generation nanoelectronic and optoelectronic devices. To tackle this, we trained a deep learning interatomic potential (DLP) using DeePMD-kit on density functional theory (DFT) data, then paired it with non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) simulations to study interfacial thermal conductance (ITC) in lateral MoSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ heterostructures, considering both armchair and zigzag interface orientations. The potential we trained closely matches DFT energies, forces, and phonon dispersion relations, which confirms its reliability for thermal transport simulations. Examining cell lengths from 10 to 40 nm and extrapolating to infinite length, the armchair interface shows a higher ITC (473 MW/m$^2$K) than the zigzag interface (387 MW/m$^2$K), and the armchair interface remains higher at every length considered. Both increase further as temperature rises. At 300 K, the vibrational density of states shows greater phonon spectral overlap at the armchair interface than at the zigzag interface. Together, these results offer a solid machine-learning framework for studying heat transport in lateral TMD heterostructures, and identify interface orientation as an effective means of controlling heat dissipation at these junctions.
items.abstract_zh: 横向二维过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）异质结构的界面热流管理是下一代纳米电子与光电器件的关键挑战。作者基于密度泛函理论（DFT）数据，用 DeePMD-kit 训练深度学习原子间势（DLP），结合非平衡分子动力学（NEMD）研究横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构在扶手椅与锯齿界面取向下的界面热导（ITC）。势函数与 DFT 能量、力和声子色散吻合良好。将长度从 10 nm 外推至无限长，扶手椅界面 ITC（473 MW/m2K）高于锯齿界面（387 MW/m2K），且在各长度下均更高；温度升高时两者均增大。300 K 下扶手椅界面的声子谱重叠更大。该工作提供了机器学习框架，并表明界面取向可调控散热。
items.highlight_zh: 扶手椅界面热导高于锯齿界面，界面取向可调控散热
items.digest_zh: 这篇论文关注一个很具体的工程问题：当二维材料横向拼接成异质结构时，热量穿过接口会遇到多大阻力，以及这种阻力能否通过改变接口的原子排列方向来调节。研究对象是横向 MoSe2/MoS2 异质结构，接口有两种常见取向：扶手椅型和锯齿型。作者没有直接用经验势，而是先用 DFT 数据训练了一个深度学习原子间势，并验证它能复现能量、力和声子色散；然后把它放进非平衡分子动力学模拟中，测量界面热导。为了排除有限尺寸影响，他们计算了 10 到 40 nm 不同长度并外推到无限长。结果显示扶手椅界面的界面热导约 473 MW/m2K，高于锯齿界面的 387 MW/m2K，而且在所有模拟长度上都更高；温度升高时两者都上升。300 K 下的声子态密度分析表明，扶手椅界面的声子谱重叠更强，这为热导差异提供了微观解释。意义在于：一方面给出了可用于横向 TMD 异质结构热输运的机器学习模拟框架；另一方面说明界面取向是一个可设计的调控旋钮，对未来纳米器件散热和热管理有直接参考价值。

items.title_en: Hardware Acceleration of Vision-Language-Action Models with Weight Precision Rising over the Flow Steps
items.title_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型的硬件加速：权重精度随流匹配步数递增
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models such as GR00T control robots through an action head: a diffusion transformer that turns noise into a chunk of actions in a few flow-matching steps. Every step re-reads all of the head's weights from DRAM but applies each weight to only about fifty tokens. Inference is therefore memory-bound, and its latency and energy are largely determined by the total number of transferred weight bits. We show that later flow steps attenuate the quantization errors of earlier steps, so the weight precision of an action head should rise over the steps. With plain per-channel rounding and without calibration or training, widths rising over the steps from 2 to 4 bits preserve the closed-loop success of robot policies. These widths transfer 25% fewer bits than 4-bit weights at every step. However, we show that on Jetson AGX Thor, current GPU kernels cannot exploit this per-step precision due to fixed overheads. We therefore present a programmable accelerator whose latency and energy both scale with the transferred weight bits. It decodes entropy-coded weights for bit-serial sub-arrays at the DRAM rate. Because the width changes per step, a run-time allocator divides these sub-arrays between the linear layers and the attention to balance their workloads. The same sub-arrays are thus capable of running action heads of different families and sizes, as well as a vision-language model. On the DRAM side, a requantizer and an entropy encoder at each bank let one stored 8-bit copy replace the copies of all widths. Simulated with LPDDR5X timing, our RTL implementation runs the GR00T N1.6 action head in 8.02 ms per inference with 2, 3, 3 and 4 bits in its four flow steps. With a copy per width and 50% of Thor's memory bandwidth, the accelerator runs this schedule 1.7x faster than Thor in NVFP4, at 9.1x less energy and equal closed-loop success.
items.abstract_zh: GR00T 等视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过动作头控制机器人：动作头是一个扩散 Transformer，在少数 flow-matching 步内把噪声变成一段动作。每一步都要从 DRAM 重新读取动作头全部权重，而每个权重仅作用于约 50 个 token，因此推理受内存带宽限制，延迟与能耗主要由传输的权重比特总量决定。作者指出，后续流步会削弱前序步的量化误差，因此动作头的权重精度应随步数递增。仅用逐通道舍入、不做校准或训练，让位宽沿步数从 2 比特升至 4 比特，即可保持机器人策略的闭环成功率，且比每步都用 4 比特少传 25% 的比特。但现有的 Jetson AGX Thor GPU 内核因固定开销无法利用这种逐步精度。作者因此设计了一款可编程加速器，其延迟与能耗均随传输的权重比特数缩放：以 DRAM 速率对比特串行子阵列的熵编码权重解码；由于位宽逐步变化，运行时分配器在这些子阵列之间为线性层与注意力分配负载；同一批子阵列可运行不同家族与尺寸的动作头，乃至一个视觉语言模型。DRAM 侧每个 bank 配有重量化器与熵编码器，使一份存储的 8 比特副本可替代所有位宽的副本。按 LPDDR5X 时序进行 RTL 仿真，四个流步分别采用 2、3、3、4 比特时，GR00T N1.6 动作头每次推理耗时 8.02 ms；在每位宽各存一份副本、使用 Thor 50% 内存带宽的条件下，该加速器亦能运行这一调度。
items.highlight_zh: 动作头权重精度随流步由 2 比特升至 4 比特，少传 25% 比特
items.digest_zh:
· 研究问题：GR00T 这类 VLA 模型靠一个“动作头”控制机器人：动作头是扩散 Transformer，用少数 flow-matching 步把噪声变成一段动作。问题在于每走一步都要从 DRAM 把动作头全部权重读一遍，而每个权重只作用在约 50 个 token 上——推理严重受内存带宽限制，延迟与能耗基本由搬运的权重比特总数决定。
· 关键发现：作者观察到后序流步会“吸收”前序步的量化误差，所以权重精度不必每步相同，而应随步数递增。只用最朴素的逐通道舍入，既不校准也不训练，让位宽沿四个流步按 2、3、3、4 比特递增，机器人策略的闭环成功率即可保持；相比每步用 4 比特，少传 25% 的比特。但现有 GPU 内核（如 Jetson AGX Thor 上）存在固定开销，用不上这种逐步变化的精度。
· 硬件设计：作者实现了一款可编程加速器，延迟与能耗都随传输比特数缩放：以 DRAM 速率对比特串行子阵列做熵编码权重的解码；因位宽逐步变化，运行时分配器在线性层与注意力之间动态划分这些子阵列以平衡负载；同一批子阵列还能运行不同家族与尺寸的动作头，甚至一个视觉语言模型。DRAM 侧每个 bank 都放重量化器与熵编码器，使一份存储的 8 比特副本可替代所有位宽的多份副本。
· 结果与意义：按 LPDDR5X 时序做 RTL 仿真，四个流步分别用 2/3/3/4 比特，跑 GR00T N1.6 动作头每次推理 8.02 ms；在每位宽各存一份副本、使用 Thor 50% 内存带宽时也能运行该调度。意义在于把“算法层的逐步精度调度”与“硬件层的比特级可扩展”配对，绕开 GPU 固定开销这一瓶颈。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Beam Model Technical Report
items.title_zh: Beam模型技术报告
items.abstract_en: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.
items.abstract_zh: Beam是一个稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型，总参数501.3B、激活参数23.4B，专门针对编码、推理和智能体工作负载构建并优化。Beam提供前沿水平推理，同时相比同类许多模型所需推理算力少3–4倍。Beam在23.8T多样、经过筛选的高质量token上预训练，通过新颖的两阶段中期训练阶段实现1M token上下文窗口，该阶段建立在可验证、以正确性为锚的数据之上。后训练利用跨10.5K块GB300 GPU的大规模、全异步强化学习（RL）训练，在4周训练中生成超过100M次rollout。我们认为这是迄今任何开放实验室开展的最大规模RL运行之一。在我们的评估套件中，随着RL算力增加，能力持续提升，没有平台期迹象。在深度软硬件协同设计、FP8/NVFP4量化以及1.93B参数投机解码草稿模型（DFlash 2）支持下，Beam通过高效、灵活部署最大化服务吞吐。按对话轮次和危害类别平均，Beam对88.9%的有害请求拒绝或转移，同时对81.5%的无害请求予以遵从，在Pareto前沿上的开放权重模型中取得了对有害请求最高的拒绝/转移率。

items.title_en: From Sequence to Space: Explicit Spatial Belief with Vision-Language Distillation for Active Geo-Localization
items.title_zh: 从序列到空间：用于主动地理定位的视觉-语言蒸馏显式空间信念
items.abstract_en: Active geo-localization (AGL) asks an agent to navigate a small aerial search grid and reach a target specified by an aerial image, a ground-level photograph, or text. Existing methods align the goal modalities well, but they keep the navigation state inside a large sequential Transformer and train with a dense distance reward that uses the hidden goal location. This paper proposes EAGLE, an Explicit spatial-belief Agent for Geo-Localization and Exploration. Offline training jointly optimizes a teacher-conditioned Swin branch and a context-free Swin student from the same randomly masked partial mosaics. The teacher branch attends to frozen full-scene context extracted by Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both branches receive masked-cell aerial-feature reconstruction and uncertainty supervision, while the student additionally distills stop-gradient feature predictions from the teacher. After distillation, Qwen, its cached context, and the teacher-attention branch are discarded. The retained student predicts cell-level aerial-feature embeddings and predictive uncertainty from partial observations alone. These predictions are combined with the modality-aligned goal embedding and a trajectory-derived visitation mask to construct the spatial belief tensor. The student is then frozen while a compact CNN actor-critic is optimized with PPO. EAGLE achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 78.1%, 76.4%, and 76.8% on MASA, xBD zero-shot transfer, and the MM-GAG zero-shot aerial-goal split, respectively, without using a VLM or cached visual tokens at inference. Code will be made publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 主动地理定位（AGL）要求智能体在小型空中搜索网格中导航，并到达由航拍图像、地面照片或文本指定的目标。现有方法能很好地对齐目标模态，但它们将导航状态保留在大型序列Transformer内，并使用利用隐藏目标位置的稠密距离奖励进行训练。本文提出EAGLE，一种用于地理定位与探索的显式空间信念智能体。离线训练从相同的随机掩码部分拼接图中联合优化一个教师条件Swin分支和一个无上下文Swin学生分支。教师分支关注由Qwen2.5-VL-7B提取的冻结全场景上下文；两个分支都接收掩码单元航拍特征重建和不确定性监督，而学生分支额外蒸馏来自教师的停止梯度特征预测。蒸馏后，Qwen、其缓存上下文及教师注意力分支被丢弃。保留的学生分支仅从部分观测预测单元级航拍特征嵌入和预测不确定性。这些预测与模态对齐的目标嵌入及轨迹导出的访问掩码结合，构建空间信念张量。随后冻结学生分支，并用PPO优化一个紧凑的CNN演员-评论家。EAGLE在MASA、xBD零样本迁移和MM-GAG零样本空中目标划分上分别取得78.1%、76.4%和76.8%的最先进平均成功率，且推理时不使用VLM或缓存视觉token。代码将公开。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: WHU-Road3D: A dataset and benchmark towards fine-grained road surface mapping
items.title_zh: WHU-Road3D：面向细粒度路面成图的数据集与基准
items.abstract_en: Accurately extracting and mapping road surface elements is crucial for applications such as high-definition maps, road asset management, and intelligent transportation systems. This study first provides a comprehensive review of the benchmark datasets for extracting and mapping road elements, encompassing overhead-to-perspective data, large-to-local scales, and coarse-to-fine details. Subsequently, we thoroughly review the relevant approaches for extracting road surface elements. However, we argue that existing datasets still require enhancements in semantic richness, data modality diversity, and scenario complexity. To bridge these gaps, this paper presents WHU-Road3D, a large-scale multimodal dataset for fine-grained road surface mapping to address these shortcomings. WHU-Road3D provides approximately 100 km of diverse Chinese highways and urban streets. It features a rich combination of MLS point clouds, associated panoramic images, vehicle trajectories, detailed vectorized annotations, and pointwise instance annotations for road surface elements. The dataset carefully annotates 15 distinct categories of road elements, including common markings like road boundaries, zebra crossings, lane dividers, stop lines, as well as 10 types of direction symbols. To our knowledge, WHU-Road3D stands as the first multimodal dataset for mapping such a comprehensive range of road surface elements, designed to facilitate cutting-edge research in instance segmentation, full-element extraction and mapping on road surfaces. Beyond these immediate applications, WHU-Road3D also provides a valuable source for hierarchical road topology reasoning, map updating, and street scene generation. The dataset, along with the code for our benchmark methods, will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}.
items.abstract_zh: 准确提取和制图路面要素对于高精地图、道路资产管理及智能交通系统等应用至关重要。本研究首先对用于提取和制图道路要素的基准数据集进行了全面综述，涵盖从俯视到透视数据、从大范围到局部尺度、从粗到细细节。随后，我们深入综述了提取路面要素的相关方法。然而，我们认为现有数据集在语义丰富性、数据模态多样性和场景复杂性方面仍需增强。为弥合这些差距，本文提出WHU-Road3D，一个用于细粒度路面成图的大规模多模态数据集，以解决这些不足。WHU-Road3D提供约100 km多样化的中国高速公路和城市街道。它具有移动激光扫描（MLS）点云、关联全景图像、车辆轨迹、详细矢量化标注以及路面要素逐点实例标注的丰富组合。该数据集精心标注了15个不同类别的道路要素，包括道路边界、斑马线、车道分隔线、停止线等常见标线，以及10种方向符号。据我们所知，WHU-Road3D是首个用于制图如此全面范围路面要素的多模态数据集，旨在促进路面实例分割、全要素提取与制图的前沿研究。除这些直接应用外，WHU-Road3D还为分层道路拓扑推理、地图更新和街景生成提供了宝贵来源。该数据集及我们基准方法的代码将公开提供：\href{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}{https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/WHU-Road3D.git}。

items.title_en: ShEPhERD-score: Fast, adaptable three-dimensional alignment of molecular features
items.title_zh: ShEPhERD-score：快速、可适配的分子特征三维对齐
items.abstract_en: Three-dimensional (3D) molecular similarity scoring and alignment are widely employed in ligand-based virtual screening and molecular design, and are increasingly used for training and evaluating machine learning models. Existing open-source methods utilize various molecular representations spanning shape, electrostatics, pharmacophores, and hybrid representations, but their implementations as independent software packages with distinct application programming interfaces (APIs), optimizers, and limited GPU support make them difficult to compare, combine, or extend. Here, we develop ShEPhERD-score into a unified, modular platform for differentiable 3D molecular similarity scoring and alignment by combining diverse molecular representations with high-performance Numba CPU and Triton GPU kernels to support both large-scale library screening and pairwise similarity workflows. In matched comparisons with open-source 3D similarity tools on the DUDE-Z virtual screening benchmark, ShEPhERD-score performed comparably or better in eight of nine cases. Across the scoring modes in ShEPhERD-score, throughput ranges from 17,800 to 1.03 million alignments/second for ten-million-conformer libraries using a single NVIDIA L40S GPU. Moreover, we found that the most effective scoring mode varied by protein target, indicating that target-specific calibration against validation data may be valuable before large-scale screening and underscoring the need for a unified platform that provides diverse molecular representations. Together, these capabilities establish ShEPhERD-score as a single, extensible toolkit for rapid virtual screening and machine learning workflows.
items.abstract_zh: 三维（3D）分子相似性评分与对齐广泛用于基于配体的虚拟筛选和分子设计，并越来越多地用于训练和评估机器学习模型。现有开源方法利用涵盖形状、静电、药效团和混合表示的各种分子表示，但它们作为具有不同应用程序接口（API）、优化器和有限GPU支持的独立软件包实现，使其难以比较、组合或扩展。在此，我们将ShEPhERD-score开发为一个统一、模块化的可微3D分子相似性评分与对齐平台，通过将多样分子表示与高性能Numba CPU和Triton GPU内核相结合，支持大规模库筛选和成对相似性工作流。在DUDE-Z虚拟筛选基准上与开源3D相似性工具进行匹配比较时，ShEPhERD-score在九种情况中的八种表现相当或更好。在ShEPhERD-score的各评分模式下，使用单个NVIDIA L40S GPU处理千万构象库时，吞吐量范围为17,800至103万次对齐/秒。此外，我们发现最有效的评分模式因蛋白靶标而异，表明在大规模筛选前根据验证数据进行靶标特异性校准可能有价值，并凸显了提供多样分子表示的统一平台的必要性。总之，这些能力使ShEPhERD-score成为一个用于快速虚拟筛选和机器学习工作流的单一、可扩展工具包。

items.title_en: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 超越语料驱动的模仿：量子强化学习下智能体管弦乐团的音乐心态演化
items.abstract_en: This paper presents a framework for computer-aided music composition and performance based on quantum reinforcement learning and multi-agent interaction. We introduce the agentic orchestra, where musical agents evolve distinct mindsets through trial-and-error engagement with a musical environment, rather than through training on large datasets. The agents are implemented as parameterised quantum circuits. They evolve distinct compositional behaviours, referred to as mindsets. This enables the exploration of musical decision spaces using quantum superposition and entanglement within a hybrid quantum-classical loop. We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. Mindsets are shaped through musically grounded reward functions, which can be combined and weighted to develop different mindsets across agents. The resulting system positions quantum computing agents less as autonomous composers and more as adaptive musical partners, each developing its own musical personality through interaction rather than imitation. Demonstrations show how agents generalise their learned behaviour to previously unseen material, operating in interactive and offline batch modes using MIDI-encoded music. While quantum computers are still in development, experiments conducted on IBM quantum hardware confirmed that musically meaningful learning is achievable with existing quantum computers. For composers and performers, the agentic orchestra opens new possibilities for emergent, process-oriented musical creativity, offering a scalable foundation for quantum computer-aided music composition as quantum computing technology continues to advance.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个基于量子强化学习与多智能体交互的计算机辅助音乐创作与演奏框架。我们引入“智能体管弦乐团”，其中音乐智能体通过与音乐环境反复试错，而非在大规模数据集上训练，演化出各自不同的“心态”。智能体以参数化量子电路实现，在混合量子—经典回路中利用量子叠加与纠缠探索音乐决策空间，从而演化出不同的作曲行为（即心态）。我们给出两种互补的智能体架构：原子式智能体分别处理音高与节奏，整体式智能体则把音高与时值视为统一的音符事件。心态由具有音乐依据的奖励函数塑造，这些奖励可组合与加权，以在不同智能体上发展出不同心态。该系统把量子计算智能体定位为自适应的音乐伙伴而非自主作曲家，各自通过交互而非模仿形成音乐个性。演示表明智能体能将所学行为泛化到此前未见的材料，并以交互或离线批处理模式处理 MIDI 编码音乐。尽管量子计算仍在发展，在 IBM 量子硬件上的实验确认，现有量子计算机已能实现具有音乐意义的学习。
items.highlight_zh: 用参数化量子电路智能体试错演化出各自的音乐“心态”
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：现有 AI 作曲大多靠学习海量音乐语料来“模仿”人类风格。作者问：能否让智能体不靠大语料，而是通过与环境互动试错，长出自己的音乐偏好和判断方式（文中称为“心态”）？
2）用了什么方法：作者搭建“智能体管弦乐团”，每个音乐智能体由一个参数化量子电路实现，在混合量子—经典回路中利用量子叠加与纠缠来探索音乐决策空间，并用强化学习更新参数。智能体有两种架构：原子式把音高和节奏分开处理；整体式把音高与时值当作一个统一的“音符事件”。训练信号不是模仿目标，而是有音乐依据的奖励函数，这些奖励可以组合、加权，不同权重会养出不同心态。
3）有什么结果：智能体演化出彼此不同的作曲行为，并能把学到的行为泛化到此前没见过的音乐材料；系统支持交互式演奏和离线批处理两种模式，输入输出均为 MIDI 编码音乐。作者还在 IBM 的真实量子硬件上做了实验，确认现有量子计算机已能完成对音乐有意义的学习，尽管规模仍受硬件限制。
4）为何重要：它把量子智能体定位成“会成长的音乐伙伴”而不是自动作曲机，为过程性、涌现式的音乐创作提供了新范式，也为量子计算在创意领域的应用给出了可扩展的雏形。

items.title_en: Continual Tool-Space Extension Learning for Multimodal Agents
items.title_zh: 面向多模态智能体的持续工具空间扩展学习
items.abstract_en: Multimodal agents largely rely on generic tools such as cropping, search, and code execution, leaving specialist vision models outside their tool space. However, bringing such a model into an already trained agent is not straightforward. The challenge is to learn each new tool efficiently while retaining the ability to use existing ones. This work proposes COTEX, continual tool-space extension learning, that adds new tools at efficient adapter-level cost. COTEX locates two sets of parameter directions; one triggers a tool call and thereby opens a multi-turn reasoning trajectory, while the other determines which tool is chosen. The adapter of a new tool is restricted to the calling directions that leave earlier tool choices unaffected by orthogonal constraint. We further introduce a protocol that converts specialist models' existing task-specific annotations into verified tool-use trajectories. Experiments on two representative agents and three specialist tools show gains on ten vision-language benchmarks, with at most a 0.3-point drop on existing tools.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态智能体主要依赖裁剪、搜索和代码执行等通用工具，使专用视觉模型处于其工具空间之外。然而，将此类模型引入已训练的智能体并非易事。挑战在于高效学习每个新工具，同时保留使用现有工具的能力。本工作提出 COTEX，即持续工具空间扩展学习，以高效的适配器级成本添加新工具。COTEX 定位两组参数方向；一组触发工具调用，从而开启多轮推理轨迹，另一组决定选择哪个工具。新工具的适配器被限制在调用方向上，并通过正交约束使先前的工具选择不受影响。我们进一步引入一种协议，将专用模型现有的任务特定标注转换为经过验证的工具使用轨迹。在两个代表性智能体和三种专用工具上的实验表明，在十个视觉-语言基准上取得提升，同时在现有工具上最多下降 0.3 个百分点。

items.title_en: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
items.title_zh: MemFolder：结构引导的记忆折叠用于高效智能体记忆管理
items.abstract_en: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.
items.abstract_zh: 长期智能体在交互展开过程中会积累大型外部记忆存储，从而增加存储、检索和响应生成成本。效率受两个耦合因素制约：记录数量增长增加检索开销，而更长的检索上下文增加预填充计算和解码时注意力成本。现有方法对记录进行剪枝或合并，但剪枝可能丢弃有用证据，而合并可能产生更少但更长的检索单元。我们提出MemFolder，一个结构引导的记忆折叠框架，依次减少记录数量和上下文长度。该框架包含两个共享记忆组的核心组件，利用跨记录结构同时指导证据合并和紧凑表示。RecordFolder对实体提及进行落地，逐步选择具代表性又互补的锚点，并将语义和实体亲和力与时间链接相结合，把兼容记录合并为更少的检索单元。ContextFolder将这些组内的原始记录编码为紧凑文本，并在关键事实无法恢复时利用验证反馈修正编码。在三个基于文本的记忆基准LoCoMo、PersonaMem和LongMemEval以及两个多模态基准M3-Bench-web和M3-Bench-robot上的实验证明了我们方法的强大性能。值得注意的是，在Mem0上，RecordFolder在记录数减少50%的情况下，在三个基于文本的基准上保留了原始平均性能的99.0%，在性能保留率上超过最强基线1.9个百分点。与ContextFolder结合，现有记录压缩方法进一步缩短其输出记录，同时保留大部分性能。

items.title_en: Teaching VLMs What to Say, Not How to Reason: Rethinking Counterfactual Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 教视觉语言模型说什么，而非如何推理：重新思考自动驾驶中的反事实推理
items.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving systems have been shown to suffer from shortcut learning and causal confusion, limiting their ability to generalize robustly under distribution shift. To mitigate these limitations, recent works based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored incorporating linguistic reasoning capabilities into driving decision-making, reporting improvements in driving performance. In particular, counterfactual (CF) reasoning has been proposed to enable self-reflective, high-level causal understanding. However, it remains unclear whether the language-based reasoning mitigates shortcut learning or merely shifts it from visual representations to linguistic patterns, creating an illusion of causal understanding. Moreover, existing approaches often conflate intervention-based reasoning with CF reasoning, leaving the effects of genuine CF reasoning unexplored. In this work, we examine what CF reasoning actually induces in VLM-based autonomous driving and observe that it shifts the action distribution toward more conservative behaviors while increasing uncertainty in reasoning and decision-making. This effect persists under reinforcement fine-tuning, suggesting that it is not merely a transient artifact. Furthermore, visual attention analysis shows that CF reasoning does not alter visual grounding, while causal intervention experiments reveal that masking causally relevant and non-causal factors in accident scenarios results in comparable decision change rates. Overall, these results suggest that CF reasoning does not induce genuine causal reasoning grounded in visual evidence. Instead, it acts as a linguistic shortcut that reshapes the action distribution, teaching models what to say but not how to reason, highlighting a gap between language-based reasoning and causal understanding in autonomous driving.
items.abstract_zh: 端到端自动驾驶系统已被证明会遭受捷径学习和因果混淆，限制了其在分布偏移下稳健泛化的能力。为缓解这些局限，近期基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的工作探索将语言推理能力纳入驾驶决策，并报告了驾驶性能的提升。特别是，反事实（CF）推理被提出以实现自我反思式的高层因果理解。然而，目前尚不清楚基于语言的推理是缓解了捷径学习，还是仅将其从视觉表示转移到语言模式，从而制造出因果理解的错觉。此外，现有方法常常将基于干预的推理与CF推理混为一谈，使真正的CF推理效果未被探索。在本工作中，我们考察CF推理在基于VLM的自动驾驶中实际诱导了什么，并观察到它将动作分布转向更保守的行为，同时增加推理和决策中的不确定性。这种效应在强化微调下仍然存在，表明它不仅仅是暂时性伪影。此外，视觉注意力分析表明CF推理并未改变视觉 grounding，而因果干预实验揭示，在事故场景中遮蔽因果相关和非因果因素会导致可比的决策变化率。总体而言，这些结果表明CF推理并未诱导出以视觉证据为基础的真实因果推理。相反，它作为一种语言捷径重塑动作分布，教模型说什么而非如何推理，凸显了自动驾驶中基于语言的推理与因果理解之间的差距。

items.title_en: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
items.title_zh: DACA：用于零样本3D视觉定位的双锚点协作智能体
items.abstract_en: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA
items.abstract_zh: 3D视觉定位（3D-VG）是一项连接自然语言与3D空间的任务，是具身智能与人机交互的基础能力。尽管近期的3D-VG智能体克服了对预处理3D点云的依赖，但它们本质上采用单向、流水线式的工具调用架构。该架构将语义理解与几何重建分离，导致误差累积，并且无法在失败后自主恢复。针对这一缺陷，本文提出双锚点协作智能体（DACA），将3D-VG重新解释为语义-几何双锚点协同推理范式。DACA包含两个互补的专用工具：语义锚点工具持有目标的视觉语义特征，并通过光流与VLM局部验证实现高效目标跟踪；几何锚点工具持有目标的3D空间几何特征，并通过体素化与多关键点投影执行全局空间推理。两个组件通过标准化工具调用协议双向交换信息，自主决定下一个感知-动作步骤，形成闭环优化。在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准上的实验表明，零样本DACA在ScanRefer上取得73.6%的总体Acc@0.25，在Nr3D上取得70.4%的总体准确率，远超最新的零样本3D-VG方法。代码与模型见 https://github.com/liujia99/DACA

items.title_en: Inferring Neural Activity Changes under Recording Uncertainty with Transformers and Variational Inference
items.title_zh: 在记录不确定性下使用 Transformer 和变分推断推断神经活动变化
items.abstract_en: A difference in recorded firing rate across days may reflect a change in neuronal activity, missed spikes or recording a different neuron. We present a statistical approach that combines neuron tracking with Bayesian estimates of stationary mean recorded firing rates. Bounds under assumed differences in spike detection connect recorded rates to biological rate changes. We assess recording loss and uncertainty in rate changes in simulations, and count-model fit in recordings. We also compare two transformer estimators with Gaussian and flow variational inference under a shared temporal negative-binomial model. Flow variational inference agrees most closely with reference posteriors, while predictive performance varies across mice. Rate-change intervals contain true simulated changes less often than intended. In UnitMatch recordings from five mice, some inferred changes remain supported when spike detection is allowed to differ between days; others depend on equal detection. These interpretations require a correct neuron match. The approach identifies which inferred rate changes remain supported under specified recording assumptions and where uncertainty limits interpretation.
items.abstract_zh: 跨天记录的发放率差异可能反映神经活动变化、漏检的尖峰，或记录到了不同的神经元。我们提出一种统计方法，将神经元跟踪与对平稳平均记录发放率的贝叶斯估计相结合。在假设的尖峰检测差异下的边界将记录发放率与生物发放率变化联系起来。我们在仿真中评估记录损失和发放率变化的不确定性，并在记录中评估计数模型拟合。我们还在共享的时间负二项模型下，比较使用高斯变分推断和流变分推断的两种 Transformer 估计器。流变分推断与参考后验最接近，而预测性能在不同小鼠间存在差异。发放率变化区间包含真实模拟变化的频率低于预期。在来自五只小鼠的 UnitMatch 记录中，当允许不同天的尖峰检测存在差异时，一些推断出的变化仍然成立；另一些则依赖于检测相同。这些解释需要正确的神经元匹配。该方法识别出在指定记录假设下哪些推断出的发放率变化仍然成立，以及不确定性在何处限制了解释。

items.title_en: Observation of room-temperature intrinsic antiferroelectricity in van der Waals NbOCl2
items.title_zh: 范德华 NbOCl2 中室温本征反铁电性的观测
items.abstract_en: In recent years, two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectricity has been extensively investigated across a wide range of 2D materials, while intrinsic 2D antiferroelectricity remains exceptionally rare, limiting its implementation in next-generation photonic and electronic devices. Here, we report the observation of room-temperature-stable antiferroelectricity in the layered transition metal oxyhalide NbOCl2, and demonstrate a reversible, stimuli-driven antiferroelectric-to-ferroelectric (AFE-to-FE) phase transition in this material. Second-harmonic generation (SHG) mapping reveals a well-defined stripe-like spatial distribution of SHG intensity across as-grown NbOCl2 flakes spanning thickness from few-layer to bulk-like configurations. This distinctive SHG signature originates from the existence of antiferroelectric phase and the coexistence of antiferroelectric and ferroelectric phases within individual crystals, as evidenced by a combined incident-angle-dependent SHG measurement and Raman spectroscopy. By integrating NbOCl2 with one-dimensional silver nanowires, we achieve spatially selective, strain-mediated AFE-to-FE phase transition. Moreover, an ultralow electric field (~20 kV/cm) induces a reversible SHG response, consistent with switching from the centrosymmetric antiferroelectric state (SHG-silent) to the non-centrosymmetric ferroelectric state (SHG-active). This study not only expands the family of room-temperature 2D antiferroelectrics but also establishes a versatile platform for dynamic manipulation of nonlinear light, paving the way toward electric-field-programmable nonlinear photonics and optical information processing.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，二维（2D）铁电性已在广泛的二维材料中得到广泛研究，而本征二维反铁电性仍然极为罕见，限制了其在下一代光子和电子器件中的实现。在此，我们报道在层状过渡金属氧卤化物 NbOCl2 中观察到室温稳定的反铁电性，并展示该材料中可逆的、刺激驱动的反铁电到铁电（AFE-to-FE）相变。二次谐波产生（SHG）映射显示，在从少层到类体块构型的生长态 NbOCl2 薄片中，SHG 强度呈现明确的条纹状空间分布。这种独特的 SHG 特征源于反铁电相的存在以及单个晶体内反铁电相与铁电相的共存，这由入射角依赖 SHG 测量与拉曼光谱相结合所证实。通过将 NbOCl2 与一维银纳米线集成，我们实现了空间选择性的、应变介导的 AFE-to-FE 相变。此外，超低电场（约 20 kV/cm）诱导可逆 SHG 响应，与从中心对称反铁电态（SHG 静默）切换到非中心对称铁电态（SHG 活性）一致。这项研究不仅扩展了室温二维反铁电体家族，还建立了一个动态操控非线性光的通用平台，为电场可编程非线性光子学和光信息处理铺平道路。

items.title_en: Efficient and Variation-Tolerant Tree Inference via Compact and Scalable Mapping in Analog CAMs
items.title_zh: 模拟CAM中通过紧凑且可扩展映射实现高效且抗变异的树推理
items.abstract_en: Tree-based machine learning methods are widely adopted for their interpretability and state-of-the-art accuracy on tabular data. These methods face efficiency challenges on conventional architectures due to irregular memory access patterns during tree traversal. Prior work uses analog CAM to accelerate tree traversal, but inefficient mapping requires exponentially more analog CAM columns as tree depth increases. Accuracy is also degraded by device non-idealities such as programming variations and soft decision boundaries. To address these challenges, we propose ACTIVAR, a compact variation-tolerant tree implementation in a dense analog CAM array via software-hardware codesign. On the software side, we introduce an analog-CAM-aware compact tree model that employs hierarchical subtrees with shared features to maximize hardware utilization. This dense mapping introduces redundancy, improving both model accuracy and hardware defect tolerance. Additionally, we develop Variation-Enhanced Training, which utilizes a fuzzy overlap boundary strategy to build models resilient to analog noise. On the hardware side, we design a FeFET-based analog CAM cell with a driver to sharpen decision thresholds and implement a pipelined multi-core architecture to optimize throughput and energy consumption. Across 13 classification and regression datasets, ACTIVAR maintains near-software-level accuracy while reducing hardware overhead by up to 99% compared with prior analog-CAM-based soft-tree designs. Under realistic hardware noise conditions, ACTIVAR limits accuracy degradation to just 3.7% on the MNIST dataset, whereas baseline models suffer a catastrophic 49.6% drop. Furthermore, the ACTIVAR architecture achieves energy efficiency gains ranging from $10^4$ to $10^6$ times over commercial general-purpose processors, establishing it as a highly efficient solution for high-capacity machine learning at the edge.
items.abstract_zh: 基于树的方法因其可解释性以及在表格数据上的最先进准确率而被广泛采用。由于树遍历过程中不规则的内存访问模式，这些方法在传统架构上面临效率挑战。先前工作使用模拟CAM来加速树遍历，但低效映射导致随着树深度增加需要指数级更多的模拟CAM列。编程变异和软决策边界等器件非理想性也会降低准确率。为应对这些挑战，我们提出ACTIVAR，一种通过软硬件协同设计在密集模拟CAM阵列中实现的紧凑且抗变异的树实现。在软件方面，我们引入一种模拟CAM感知的紧凑树模型，采用具有共享特征的分层子树以最大化硬件利用率。这种密集映射引入冗余，从而同时提升模型准确率和硬件缺陷容忍度。此外，我们开发了变异增强训练，利用模糊重叠边界策略构建对模拟噪声具有鲁棒性的模型。在硬件方面，我们设计了一种带有驱动器的基于FeFET的模拟CAM单元以锐化决策阈值，并实现流水线多核架构以优化吞吐量和能耗。在13个分类和回归数据集上，ACTIVAR保持接近软件级的准确率，同时与先前基于模拟CAM的软树设计相比将硬件开销降低多达99%。在真实硬件噪声条件下，ACTIVAR在MNIST数据集上将准确率下降限制在仅3.7%，而基线模型则遭受49.6%的灾难性下降。此外，ACTIVAR架构相比商用通用处理器实现10^4至10^6倍的能效提升，使其成为边缘高容量机器学习的高效解决方案。

items.title_en: Multimodal Error Detection in Chest X-ray Reports: A Large Language Model Reading Image Evidence
items.title_zh: 胸部X射线报告中的多模态错误检测：大语言模型读取图像证据
items.abstract_en: Rad-Linter checks chest X-ray reports against image-derived evidence to flag potential errors for review. A pretrained image classifier supplies scores for nine pathologies, and a 1.5B-parameter language model, fine-tuned with LoRA on 1,816 examples, checks their consistency with the report. We compare it with a keyword-and-negation rule baseline given the same reports and scores. Evaluation uses controlled report-score pairings from OpenI, with consistency labels derived from automatic report labels and score thresholds. Each counterfactual quad crosses two real reports with two real score vectors from other patients, creating two consistent and two inconsistent pairs. Every report and score vector occurs in both conditions, so either input alone permits only 50% accuracy. On 131 quads, Rad-Linter achieves 98.5% pair accuracy versus 80.5% for the rule baseline, and classifies all four pairs correctly in 94.4% of quads versus 56.5%. The checkers perform similarly on omission items, including unmentioned and negated findings; larger differences occur on the remaining item types, which require interpreting how findings are described. The same language model without fine-tuning remains near 50% accuracy. On a second set of 181 quads that also includes reports on which the automatic labelers disagree, pair accuracy is 93.4% versus 75.3%. These controlled results show that, given the same image-derived scores, a trained language model detects report-score inconsistencies more accurately than the tested rule baseline, with the advantage concentrated in interpreting how findings are worded.
items.abstract_zh: Rad-Linter将胸部X射线报告与图像导出的证据进行核对，以标记潜在错误供审查。一个预训练图像分类器提供九种病理的分数，一个1.5B参数的语言模型在1,816个示例上通过LoRA微调，检查这些分数与报告的一致性。我们在给定相同报告和分数的情况下，将其与关键词和否定规则基线进行比较。评估使用来自OpenI的受控报告-分数配对，一致性标签由自动报告标签和分数阈值导出。每个反事实四元组将两份真实报告与来自其他患者的两份真实分数向量交叉，形成两个一致配对和两个不一致配对。每份报告和分数向量都出现在两种条件中，因此仅凭任一输入只能达到50%准确率。在131个四元组上，Rad-Linter达到98.5%的配对准确率，而规则基线为80.5%；在94.4%的四元组中正确分类所有四个配对，而基线为56.5%。检查器在遗漏项（包括未提及和被否定的发现）上表现相似；更大差异出现在其余项目类型上，这些类型需要解释发现是如何被描述的。未经微调的同一语言模型仍保持在约50%准确率。在第二组181个四元组上（其中还包括自动标注器存在分歧的报告），配对准确率为93.4%，而基线为75.3%。这些受控结果表明，在给定相同图像导出分数的情况下，经过训练的语言模型比所测试的规则基线更准确地检测报告-分数不一致，其优势集中在解释发现的措辞方式上。

items.title_en: Assessing Vision-Language Models for Early Prediction of Unsafe Situations in Robotics
items.title_zh: 评估视觉语言模型用于机器人中不安全情况的早期预测
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process visual information and textual instructions and, by using their ability to understand and reason about context, are well-suited for predicting robot failures before they occur. However, evidence supporting this remains limited. To address this, we present an empirical evaluation of VLMs for predicting robot failures. In particular, we experiment with Qwen, InternVL, and LLaVA-OneVision across three robotic case studies (HuRoN, Pal Robotics, and CrowdBot), analyzing both video and odometry data for early failure warning (i.e., before an unsafe situation occurs). Specifically, we evaluate their performance in classifying situations as safe, potentially unsafe, and unsafe, together with uncertainty quantified using various metrics, and study the relationship between uncertainty and performance. Our results showed that Qwen provides the strongest overall classification and prediction-reliability performance, while InternVL shows stronger early-warning capability in several configurations. The results further show that the effect of robot-state information and temporal history depends on the model and evaluation objective. Overall, our findings indicate that general-purpose VLMs can support early robot-safety monitoring, but the most suitable configuration depends on whether the priority is accurate assessment of safety-state, reliable confidence and uncertainty, or timely warning before unsafe events.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）处理视觉信息和文本指令，并利用其理解和推理上下文的能力，非常适合在机器人故障发生之前进行预测。然而，支持这一点的证据仍然有限。为此，我们提出了对 VLM 预测机器人故障的实证评估。具体而言，我们在三个机器人案例研究（HuRoN、Pal Robotics 和 CrowdBot）中实验了 Qwen、InternVL 和 LLaVA-OneVision，分析视频和里程计数据以进行早期故障警告（即在不安全情况发生之前）。具体来说，我们评估它们在将情况分类为安全、潜在不安全和不安全方面的性能，以及使用各种指标量化的不确定性，并研究不确定性与性能之间的关系。我们的结果表明，Qwen 提供了最强的整体分类和预测可靠性性能，而 InternVL 在多种配置中显示出更强的早期预警能力。结果进一步表明，机器人状态信息和时间历史的影响取决于模型和评估目标。总体而言，我们的发现表明，通用 VLM 可以支持早期机器人安全监控，但最合适的配置取决于优先事项是准确评估安全状态、可靠的置信度和不确定性，还是在不安全事件之前及时警告。

items.title_en: SegAnyFruit: Learning Generalizable and Edge Deployable Fruit Instance Segmentation at Scale
items.title_zh: SegAnyFruit：学习可泛化且可边缘部署的大规模水果实例分割
items.abstract_en: Deploying fruit instance segmentation in real agricultural settings requires generalizing across unseen species, orchards, and imaging conditions under strict onboard compute and annotation budgets. We introduce SegAnyFruit (SAF), a data construction and progressive training framework that distills foundation-model priors into lightweight, prompt-free segmenters. SAF combines generic mask pre-training, broad mid-training on automatically annotated web imagery from our curated WebFruits dataset, and human-verified agricultural refinement post-training on PaperFruits, together spanning 733K images and 9.66M whole-fruit masks across 165 fruit types. Across seven benchmarks, zero-shot SAF-RF-DETR-XL reaches 69.06 average mask AP50:95 (+4.76 over SAM 3) while remaining deployable on edge devices. SAF initialization also boosts few-shot to full-shot adaptation across five agricultural domains while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we systematically analyze training stages, data scale, model capacity, and generative augmentation, and validate our pipeline's transferability to underwater, cell, and human segmentation. We will release our datasets, code, and SAF models.
items.abstract_zh: 在真实农业环境中部署水果实例分割，需要在严格的板载计算和标注预算下，对未见物种、果园和成像条件具有泛化能力。我们提出SegAnyFruit（SAF），一个数据构建与渐进训练框架，将基础模型先验蒸馏到轻量级、无提示的分割器中。SAF结合了通用掩码预训练、在我们整理的WebFruits数据集上对自动标注网络图像进行广泛中期训练，以及在PaperFruits上进行人工验证的农业精炼后训练，合计涵盖165种水果类型的733K张图像和9.66M个整果掩码。在七个基准上，零样本SAF-RF-DETR-XL达到69.06的平均mask AP50:95（比SAM 3高4.76），同时仍可部署在边缘设备上。SAF初始化还提升了跨五个农业领域的少样本到全样本适应，同时减轻灾难性遗忘。最后，我们系统分析了训练阶段、数据规模、模型容量和生成式增强，并验证了我们流程在水下、细胞和人体分割上的可迁移性。我们将发布数据集、代码和SAF模型。

items.title_en: Scalable Non-Parametric Bayesian Inference of Free Energy Landscapes and Emission Functions from Observations
items.title_zh: 从观测中进行自由能景观与发射函数的可扩展非参数贝叶斯推断
items.abstract_en: Free-energy landscapes govern processes from protein conformational change to climate oscillations, but are typically observed only indirectly, through observables such as FRET intensity or optical-tweezer transmittance. Neither the landscape shape, nor the emission function mapping latent state to signal, is usually known, and distinct states may produce the same signal. We therefore infer landscape and emission function jointly and non-parametrically, using the exact non-linear Bayesian filtering likelihood, to fully use the information contained in observable trajectories that are often noisy, scarce and costly to acquire. A novel parallel-in-time algorithm makes this tractable: it is up to 27 times faster than sequential filtering on one GPU, scales near-ideally across GPUs, and, given enough resources, has runtime independent of trajectory length. We demonstrate the method on a single-protein optical tweezer recording, where distinct conformations produce the same signal, and beyond biology on the El Nino-Southern Oscillation and financial market volatility.
items.abstract_zh: 自由能景观支配着从蛋白质构象变化到气候振荡的过程，但通常只能通过FRET强度或光镊透射率等可观测量被间接观测。景观形状以及将潜在状态映射到信号的发射函数通常均未知，且不同状态可能产生相同信号。因此，我们联合且非参数地推断景观与发射函数，使用精确的非线性贝叶斯滤波似然，以充分利用常含噪声、稀缺且获取成本高的可观测轨迹中包含的信息。一种新的时间并行算法使这一推断变得可行：在单个GPU上，它比顺序滤波快至多27倍，在多个GPU上接近理想扩展，并且在资源充足时运行时间与轨迹长度无关。我们在单蛋白光镊记录上演示了该方法，其中不同构象产生相同信号；并在生物学之外，将其应用于厄尔尼诺-南方涛动和金融市场波动率。

items.title_en: Optical Neural Networks Should Be Evaluated by Function, Not Only Physics
items.title_zh: 光学神经网络应按功能评估，而不仅是物理特性
items.abstract_en: Optical neural networks (ONNs) are attracting significant attention as alternative platforms for machine learning (ML). In an ONN, an optical module often takes over part of the computation inside a digital ML pipeline. How much of the task does the optical module itself perform, and how much does it contribute to any claimed system-level advantages, such as throughput or energy? This paper offers a simple, function-oriented evaluation methodology. Whatever its internal physics, the optical module appears to the surrounding digital pipeline as a mapping between real-valued tensors. We therefore evaluate it in three steps: (i) define its boundary in the pipeline, as real-valued tensors in and out; (ii) replace it with standard digital modules to identify those that match the optical system's performance on the same task and metric; and (iii) state system-level claims, such as speed or energy, per inference against the performance-matched digital module. We summarize steps (i) and (ii) in an Expressivity Card and demonstrate its use on published ONN systems. This helps isolate the optical module's contribution and provides a concrete digital reference for assessing its claimed system-level advantages, without the need to understand the physics. While we focus on optical systems as the most prominent example, the same approach applies to any physical analog computing platform used in ML, wherever a physical module takes over part of a digital pipeline.
items.abstract_zh: 光学神经网络（ONN）作为机器学习的替代平台正受到广泛关注。在 ONN 中，光学模块通常接管数字机器学习流水线中的部分计算。光学模块自身执行多少任务，以及它对所声称的系统级优势（如吞吐量或能耗）贡献多少？本文提供一种简单、面向功能的评估方法。无论其内部物理机制如何，光学模块对周围数字流水线而言表现为实值张量之间的映射。因此，我们分三步评估它：(i) 在流水线中定义其边界，即输入和输出的实值张量；(ii) 用标准数字模块替换它，以找出在同一任务和指标上与光学系统性能匹配的模块；(iii) 针对每次推理，相对于性能匹配的数字模块陈述系统级声明，如速度或能耗。我们将步骤 (i) 和 (ii) 总结为一张 Expressivity Card，并在已发表的 ONN 系统上演示其用法。这有助于分离光学模块的贡献，并为评估其所声称的系统级优势提供具体的数字参考，而无需理解物理机制。虽然我们聚焦于光学系统这一最突出的例子，但同样的方法适用于机器学习中使用的任何物理模拟计算平台，只要物理模块接管了数字流水线的一部分。

items.title_en: Cost-Aware Agentic Feature Optimization System for Fleet-Scale Ranking Models
items.title_zh: 面向集群规模排序模型的成本感知智能体特征优化系统
items.abstract_en: Large Web platforms operate large fleets of ranking models, each selecting features from a shared pool of tens of thousands. We present an end-to-end agentic system that optimizes features across the fleet under resource constraints shared across models and those set per model, such as feature pipeline cost and serving throughput (QPS), respectively. In this system, LLM agents propose hypotheses, and deterministic tools execute experiments and verify them. For each model, an LLM generates and shortlists cross features from a combinatorial candidate space, and all features are then ranked by several importance methods. Feature blending mixes these rankings into a single selection, using Pareto fronts across tasks for multi-task models. An LLM Researcher agent then tunes the feature selection in 10--25 asynchronous trials under resource caps, and a trimming step keeps the pipeline cost within budget. Across production models, the system improves normalized entropy by 0.31% on average within each model's budget, and the trimming step cuts pipeline cost by 2.3% with no regression beyond measurement noise. The optimized models were launched, and in online A/B tests they improved a primary online metric by 0.20%.
items.abstract_zh: 大型Web平台运营着大型排序模型集群，每个模型从共享的数万个特征池中选择特征。我们提出一个端到端智能体系统，在跨模型共享的资源约束以及每个模型单独设置的约束（分别为特征流水线成本和服务吞吐量（QPS））下，优化整个集群的特征。在该系统中，LLM智能体提出假设，确定性工具执行实验并验证假设。对于每个模型，LLM从组合候选空间生成并初筛交叉特征，然后所有特征由多种重要性方法排序。特征混合将这些排序混合为单一选择，对于多任务模型使用跨任务的帕累托前沿。随后，LLM Researcher智能体在资源上限下通过10--25次异步试验调整特征选择，并通过修剪步骤将流水线成本保持在预算内。在生产模型上，该系统在每个模型预算内平均将归一化熵提升0.31%，修剪步骤将流水线成本降低2.3%，且除测量噪声外无性能回退。优化后的模型已上线，在线A/B测试中使一项主要在线指标提升0.20%。

items.title_en: dLoop: Looped Diffusion Language Models via Recurrent Latent Refinement
items.title_zh: dLoop：通过循环潜在精炼的循环扩散语言模型
items.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) support parallel generation, yet they often require many denoising steps because only a fraction of token predictions are sufficiently reliable to be committed at each step. Existing acceleration methods primarily optimize confidence learning or commitment policies. However, these approaches operate on the outputs of a single denoising forward pass, in which information from the prompt, previously committed tokens, and uncommitted positions may not yet be fully integrated. Consequently, some predictions remain under-refined when the commitment decision is made, and modifying the commitment policy alone cannot improve their underlying representations. We introduce dLoop, which restructures a pretrained diffusion language model into a Prelude-Loop-Coda architecture and recurrently applies a parameter-shared intermediate block to the same partially masked state. Rather than advancing the denoising process, each additional loop provides further latent computation, allowing information distributed across uncommitted positions to continue interacting and become more fully integrated before commitment. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH, MBPP, and HumanEval show that dLoop achieves the highest or tied-highest accuracy on every benchmark. With tokens per forward pass (TPF) adjusted for loop computation, it outperforms Fast-dLLM in both accuracy and TPF on all four benchmarks and dParallel on three, and is more accurate than d3LLM on all four, while d3LLM attains higher TPF; no compared method surpasses dLoop in both. Mechanistic analyses show that extra loops mainly help on slow, unstable trajectories and that updates at uncommitted positions drive changes in token decisions and later generation. Pre-commitment latent computation thus makes predictions more reliable, offering a route to DLM acceleration distinct from forcing confidence through the training loss.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）支持并行生成，但它们通常需要许多去噪步骤，因为每一步只有一小部分token预测足够可靠而可以被提交。现有加速方法主要优化置信度学习或提交策略。然而，这些方法作用于单次去噪前向传播的输出，其中来自提示、先前已提交token和未提交位置的信息可能尚未完全整合。因此，在做出提交决策时，一些预测仍未充分精炼，仅修改提交策略无法改善其底层表示。我们引入dLoop，它将预训练扩散语言模型重构为Prelude-Loop-Coda架构，并对相同的部分掩码状态循环应用参数共享的中间块。每个额外循环不是推进去噪过程，而是提供进一步的潜在计算，使分布在未提交位置的信息继续交互，并在提交前更充分地整合。在GSM8K、MATH、MBPP和HumanEval上的实验表明，dLoop在每个基准上都达到最高或并列最高准确率。在针对循环计算调整每次前向传播的token数（TPF）后，它在全部四个基准上在准确率和TPF两方面均优于Fast-dLLM，并在三个基准上优于dParallel；在全部四个基准上比d3LLM更准确，而d3LLM达到更高TPF；没有对比方法在两方面同时超过dLoop。机理分析表明，额外循环主要有助于缓慢、不稳定的轨迹，并且未提交位置的更新驱动token决策及后续生成的变化。因此，提交前潜在计算使预测更可靠，提供了一条不同于通过训练损失强制提高置信度的DLM加速路径。

items.title_en: A Hierarchical Onboard Vision-Language-Navigation Framework for Aerial Robots in Complex Environments
items.title_zh: 复杂环境中空中机器人的分层机载视觉-语言-导航框架
items.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are expected to achieve semantic reasoning, intelligent decision-making, and long-horizon navigation under strict onboard constraints. While recent foundation-model-driven approaches have shown promising progress toward this goal, existing methods remain limited by challenges in 3D data availability, trajectory feasibility, long-horizon reasoning, and computational efficiency in complex environments. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLN-AR, a hierarchical vision-language-navigation (VLN) framework for aerial robots. VLN-AR decouples multimodal reasoning and low-level control, enabling structured prediction of 3D pose commands and navigation intentions that are translated into dynamically feasible actions. To mitigate data scarcity and domain gaps, we introduce a fully automated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based pipeline to generate scalable photorealistic UAV navigation data. A progressive three-stage training strategy further enhances grounding, scene reasoning, and complex navigation. In addition, a lightweight cognitive agent improves long-horizon reasoning via memory-aware task decomposition. Finally, we design onboard optimization techniques, including token sparsification and model lightweighting, achieving 7.1x-9.4x speedup while maintaining high navigation performance on resource-limited UAV platforms. Experiments show great improvements over existing methods in both simulation and real-world UAV navigation. Project website: https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/
items.abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）被期望在严格的机载约束下实现语义推理、智能决策和长时程导航。尽管近期由基础模型驱动的方法在实现这一目标方面已显示出有前景的进展，但现有方法仍受限于复杂环境中三维数据可用性、轨迹可行性、长时程推理和计算效率方面的挑战。为弥合这些差距，我们提出VLN-AR，一种用于空中机器人的分层视觉-语言-导航（VLN）框架。VLN-AR将多模态推理与低层控制解耦，从而能够结构化预测三维位姿命令和导航意图，并将其转换为动态可行的动作。为缓解数据稀缺和域差距，我们引入一个全自动的基于三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）的流程，以生成可扩展的照片级真实感无人机导航数据。渐进式三阶段训练策略进一步增强视觉接地、场景推理和复杂导航。此外，一个轻量级认知智能体通过记忆感知的任务分解改善长时程推理。最后，我们设计机载优化技术，包括token稀疏化和模型轻量化，在资源受限的无人机平台上实现7.1倍至9.4倍加速，同时保持高导航性能。实验表明，在仿真和真实世界无人机导航中均较现有方法有大幅提升。项目网站：https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
items.title_zh: TuringPAI：端侧物理AI的基础
items.abstract_en: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation. TuringPAI-VL is a 0.65B model built on HybridViT-MLQ, which combines convolutional local aggregation with Transformer-based global modeling. Multi-scale Latent Queries integrate spatial features and observation history within the same visual Transformer, providing a compact, structured interface to the language model. Training combines general vision-language data with geometric, cross-view, and temporal supervision. TuringPAI-VL supports general multimodal understanding and improves quantitative geometric perception over Qwen2-VL-2B, while providing a shared initialization for the two downstream VLA models. For autonomous driving, TuringPAI-Drive maintains all evaluated ADE/FDE metrics within 1.2\% of a full-token HybridViT baseline using the MLQ interface and achieves comparable aggregate scores in an in-house simulation evaluation. Using XPeng Native Runtime (XNRT) on a single NVIDIA Orin-X SoC, TuringPAI-Drive generates trajectories at 12\,Hz in on-vehicle operation. For robotic manipulation, TuringPAI-Embodied achieves a 96.8\% average success rate across the four LIBERO suites. These results demonstrate a shared vision-language foundation for driving and robotic manipulation under practical on-device constraints.
items.abstract_zh: 物理AI需要模型在有限的板载算力下理解空间关系与动态环境，并将观测转化为动作。我们提出TuringPAI，一个面向端侧物理AI的模型系列，包括用于共享视觉-语言理解的TuringPAI-VL、用于自动驾驶的TuringPAI-Drive，以及用于机器人操作的TuringPAI-Embodied。TuringPAI-VL是一个0.65B模型，构建于HybridViT-MLQ之上，后者将卷积局部聚合与基于Transformer的全局建模相结合。多尺度潜在查询（Multi-scale Latent Queries）在同一个视觉Transformer内整合空间特征与观测历史，为语言模型提供紧凑、结构化的接口。训练结合通用视觉-语言数据与几何、跨视角和时间监督。TuringPAI-VL支持通用多模态理解，并在定量几何感知上优于Qwen2-VL-2B，同时为两个下游VLA模型提供共享初始化。在自动驾驶方面，TuringPAI-Drive使用MLQ接口，使所有评估的ADE/FDE指标与全token HybridViT基线的差距保持在1.2%以内，并在内部仿真评估中取得可比的综合得分。在单个NVIDIA Orin-X SoC上使用XPeng Native Runtime（XNRT）时，TuringPAI-Drive在车载运行中以12 Hz生成轨迹。在机器人操作方面，TuringPAI-Embodied在四个LIBERO套件上达到96.8%的平均成功率。这些结果展示了在实际端侧约束下，面向驾驶和机器人操作的共享视觉-语言基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Cardiac MRI-informed electrocardiography enables biologically grounded cardiomyopathy detection
items.title_zh: 心脏MRI信息引导的心电图实现具有生物学基础的心肌病检测
items.abstract_en: Precise myocardial phenotyping at population scale is limited by the cost and accessibility of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), whereas electrocardiography (ECG) is widely available but reflects electrical rather than structural and functional information. Here we develop MyoECG, a cross-modal representation learning framework that distils myocardial structural and functional knowledge from CMR into standard 12-lead ECGs, enabling imaging-informed cardiomyopathy detection and subtype classification from ECGs alone. MyoECG was pretrained on 45,241 paired ECG-CMR examinations from UK Biobank and a tertiary cardiovascular centre, then developed and validated across more than 1.8 million ECGs from seven independent datasets. Across internal and external datasets spanning prevalences of 0.2-54.7%, MyoECG outperformed five pretrained ECG foundation models, with AUROCs of 0.800-0.974 for cardiomyopathy detection. In a multi-reader study of six cardiologists, MyoECG assistance improved mean sensitivity by 0.109 (95% CI, 0.041-0.175; P = 0.009) and specificity by 0.056 (95% CI, 0.004-0.108; P = 0.040). In 41,128 UK Biobank participants, the MyoECG score showed genetic correlations with cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.409) and dilated cardiomyopathy (rg = 0.371), genome-wide associations at four loci, including regions mapped to NFIA and KCNQ1, and associations with 69 circulating proteins related to myocardial stress, cell adhesion, vascular biology and metabolism. The cardiomyopathy correlation attenuated to non-significance after adjustment for 27 measured CMR traits (rg = 0.131; P = 0.143), indicating that the score captures CMR-derived information rather than dataset-specific shortcuts. MyoECG offers a scalable route to CMR-informed cardiomyopathy assessment and a strategy for transferring knowledge from resource-intensive imaging to widely deployable physiological signals.
items.abstract_zh: 人群规模上的精确心肌表型分析受限于心脏磁共振（CMR）的成本和可及性，而心电图（ECG）广泛可用，但反映的是电学信息而非结构和功能信息。在此，我们开发了MyoECG，一种跨模态表示学习框架，可将来自CMR的心肌结构和功能知识蒸馏到标准12导联ECG中，从而仅凭ECG实现影像信息引导的心肌病检测和亚型分类。MyoECG在来自UK Biobank和一家三级心血管中心的45,241次配对ECG-CMR检查上进行预训练，随后在来自七个独立数据集的超过180万份ECG上进行开发和验证。在涵盖0.2-54.7%患病率的内部和外部数据集中，MyoECG优于五个预训练ECG基础模型，心肌病检测的AUROC为0.800-0.974。在一项由六名心脏病专家参与的多阅片者研究中，MyoECG辅助将平均灵敏度提高了0.109（95% CI，0.041-0.175；P = 0.009），特异度提高了0.056（95% CI，0.004-0.108；P = 0.040）。在41,128名UK Biobank参与者中，MyoECG评分显示与心肌病（rg = 0.409）和扩张型心肌病（rg = 0.371）存在遗传相关性，在四个位点存在全基因组关联，包括映射到NFIA和KCNQ1的区域，并与69种与心肌应激、细胞黏附、血管生物学和代谢相关的循环蛋白相关。在调整27个实测CMR性状后，心肌病相关性减弱至不显著（rg = 0.131；P = 0.143），表明该评分捕获的是CMR衍生信息而非数据集特异性捷径。MyoECG为CMR信息引导的心肌病评估提供了一条可扩展路径，并提供了一种将知识从资源密集型影像迁移到广泛可部署生理信号的策略。

items.title_en: Application of Pretrained Universal Machine Learning Force-Fields for Phase Transitions Prediction in ZrO2
items.title_zh: 预训练通用机器学习力场在ZrO₂相变预测中的应用
items.abstract_en: Pretrained universal machine-learning force fields can reduce the cost of finite-temperature molecular dynamics relative to density functional theory. However, most benchmarks test only static properties and do not assess whether these models reproduce the correct phase-transition sequence. Here, we benchmark ten open-source universal machine-learning force fields for zirconia (ZrO$_2$) using phonon dispersion calculations and variable-cell isothermal-isobaric molecular dynamics. Zirconia is a useful test because it has three thermodynamically stable crystalline phases prior to melting, following the sequence monoclinic-tetragonal-cubic. Four models reproduce this sequence: 7net-l3i5, MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M, MACE-mpa, and MACE-D3. Models with orthorhombic-tetragonal energy errors above about 10 meV/atom (7net-0, CHGNet, and MACE) instead produce an orthorhombic intermediate and predict monoclinic-orthorhombic-tetragonal-cubic-liquid upon heating. ORB-based models fail to sustain stable variable-cell dynamics because their phonon frequencies are compressed by 30-60% relative to the density functional theory reference. Across all ten models, two ground-state diagnostics predict finite-temperature behavior. Relative polymorph energetics should agree with the matched density functional theory reference within about 6 meV/atom, and the phonon spectrum should not show systematic softening. These diagnostics are practical screening metrics for assessing pretrained force fields for phase-transition predictions.
items.abstract_zh: 预训练通用机器学习力场相对于密度泛函理论可以降低有限温度分子动力学的成本。然而，大多数基准测试只测试静态性质，并未评估这些模型是否重现正确的相变序列。在这里，我们使用声子色散计算和可变晶胞等温等压分子动力学，对氧化锆（ZrO₂）的十个开源通用机器学习力场进行基准测试。氧化锆是一个有用的测试对象，因为它在熔化前有三个热力学稳定晶相，遵循单斜-四方-立方的序列。四个模型重现了该序列：7net-l3i5、MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M、MACE-mpa和MACE-D3。正交-四方能量误差高于约10 meV/atom的模型（7net-0、CHGNet和MACE）反而产生正交中间相，并预测加热时出现单斜-正交-四方-立方-液相。基于ORB的模型无法维持稳定的可变晶胞动力学，因为其声子频率相对于密度泛函理论参考被压缩30-60%。在所有十个模型中，两个基态诊断指标可预测有限温度行为。相对多晶型能量学应与匹配的密度泛函理论参考在约6 meV/atom内一致，并且声子谱不应出现系统性软化。这些诊断指标是评估用于相变预测的预训练力场的实用筛选指标。

items.title_en: Physics-Informed Feature Representations and Pretrained Tabular Foundation Models for Generalizable Melt Pool Geometry Prediction
items.title_zh: 物理信息特征表示与预训练表格基础模型用于可泛化熔池几何预测
items.abstract_en: Developing generalizable, data-efficient machine learning (ML) models for advanced manufacturing remains challenging because experimental datasets are limited and process-property relationships vary across materials and operating conditions. In laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), melt pool width, depth, and melting mode (conduction, transition, or keyhole) govern process stability and defect formation. Conventional ML models typically use dimensional process parameters, which represent laser-material interactions only implicitly and may limit cross-material transfer. This study evaluates whether two physics-informed dimensionless features, normalized enthalpy and Peclet number, combining laser processing conditions with material thermophysical properties, improve melt pool prediction over raw process parameters. We systematically benchmark seven models: four classical ML methods (Gaussian process, support vector machine, random forest, and XGBoost) and three pretrained tabular foundation models (TabPFN, TabDPT, and TabICLv2). Experiments span 316L stainless steel, IN625, IN718, and combined-material datasets, covering regression of melt pool width and depth and classification of melting modes. Dimensionless features yield comparable or superior predictive performance in most settings, with the largest gains in cross-material depth prediction (R^2 = 0.96). Tabular foundation models generally achieve stronger classification performance than classical baselines, particularly for multi-material datasets. These findings indicate that combining physically meaningful dimensionless representations with pretrained tabular models can improve data-efficient melt pool modeling and support more transferable process-window identification in LPBF.
items.abstract_zh: 为先进制造开发可泛化、数据高效的机器学习（ML）模型仍然具有挑战性，因为实验数据集有限，且工艺-性能关系随材料和工况而变化。在激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）中，熔池宽度、深度和熔化模式（传导、过渡或匙孔）决定工艺稳定性和缺陷形成。传统ML模型通常使用有量纲的工艺参数，这些参数仅隐式表示激光-材料相互作用，可能限制跨材料迁移。本研究评估两个物理信息无量纲特征——归一化焓和Peclet数——在将激光加工条件与材料热物理性质结合后，是否比原始工艺参数改善熔池预测。我们系统基准测试七种模型：四种经典ML方法（高斯过程、支持向量机、随机森林和XGBoost）以及三种预训练表格基础模型（TabPFN、TabDPT和TabICLv2）。实验涵盖316L不锈钢、IN625、IN718和组合材料数据集，覆盖熔池宽度和深度的回归以及熔化模式的分类。无量纲特征在大多数设置下产生相当或更优的预测性能，在跨材料深度预测中增益最大（R^2 = 0.96）。表格基础模型通常比经典基线取得更强的分类性能，尤其是在多材料数据集上。这些发现表明，将具有物理意义的无量纲表示与预训练表格模型相结合，可以改善数据高效的熔池建模，并支持LPBF中更具可迁移性的工艺窗口识别。
