items.title_en: Verifiable Logic in Medical LLMs: A Critical Review of Agentic Clinical Reasoning Optimization and Neuro-Symbolic Grounding
items.title_zh: 医疗LLM中的可验证逻辑：智能体临床推理优化与神经符号接地的批判性综述
items.abstract_en: Clinical large language models are usually judged by whether the final answer is right. Yet a model can reach a fluent, plausible output through invalid reasoning that static benchmarks do not detect, and confident hallucination, causally invalid inference, and spurious demographic shortcuts can pass conventional evaluation. This critical review covers four paradigms in turn: how clinical hallucination arises and why static metrics miss it; the agentic hallucination cascade, in which multi-agent and tool-augmented systems propagate and amplify early reasoning errors; process reward modeling as step-level supervision; and neuro-symbolic grounding, in which formal logic engines, ontology reasoners, and knowledge graphs place verifiable constraints on neural output. Within their encoded domains, systems with symbolic veto layers offer guarantees that hold relative to their encoded knowledge, and they report large gains on the safety measures they use. These results come from single studies, mostly in simulated or small-sample settings, and are not directly comparable with neural baselines. Process reward models remain bounded by the statistics of their training data. We propose a conceptual framework that maps each agentic failure mode to a symbolic intervention point, and we argue that clinical AI safety depends substantially on system architecture. Because current regulation emphasizes performance and does not require verification of reasoning steps, we argue that responsible certification should also audit reasoning trajectories alongside accuracy on static benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 临床大语言模型通常以最终答案是否正确来评判。然而，模型可能通过静态基准无法检测的无效推理得到流畅、看似合理的输出，而自信的幻觉、因果无效的推断和虚假的人口统计学捷径可以通过常规评估。本批判性综述依次讨论四种范式：临床幻觉如何产生以及静态指标为何遗漏它；智能体幻觉级联，即多智能体和工具增强系统传播并放大早期推理错误；作为步骤级监督的过程奖励建模；以及神经符号接地，即形式逻辑引擎、本体推理机和知识图谱对神经输出施加可验证约束。在其编码领域内，具有符号否决层的系统提供相对于其编码知识成立的保证，并报告在其采用的安全指标上取得大幅提升。这些结果来自单项研究，大多在模拟或小样本设置中，不能与神经基线直接比较。过程奖励模型仍受其训练数据统计特性的限制。我们提出一个概念框架，将每种智能体失败模式映射到符号干预点，并认为临床AI安全在很大程度上取决于系统架构。由于当前监管强调性能且不要求验证推理步骤，我们认为负责任的认证还应在静态基准准确率之外审计推理轨迹。

items.title_en: Technical Report of Mobile Manipulator Robot for Industrial Environments
items.title_zh: 工业环境移动操作机器人技术报告
items.abstract_en: This paper presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' mobile manipulator robot, developed at the Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory, Department of Electrical Engineering, Shahid Beheshti University. Hereafter, this platform is referred to as the @Work Robot. The robot targets industrial tasks, with an emphasis on improving efficiency in repetitive or hazardous work environments. It uses a 4-wheel Mecanum drive for omnidirectional movement and a 5-degree-of-freedom manipulator arm with a 3D-printed gripper for object handling and navigation. The electronics consist of custom PCB boards built around ESP32 microcontrollers, together with an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX that handles high-level processing and real-time system control. On the software side, Hector SLAM provides mapping and localization, A* handles path planning, and YOLO performs real-time object detection. These modules draw on fused sensor data to deliver robust navigation and reliable collision avoidance. Overall, the system shows effective hardware-software integration, with consistent performance in autonomous navigation, object handling, and task execution in industrial-like settings.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 Auriga Robotics 的移动操作机器人的设计与实现，该机器人由沙希德·贝赫什提大学电气工程系机器人与智能自动化实验室开发。下文将该平台称为 @Work Robot。该机器人面向工业任务，重点提高重复性或危险工作环境中的效率。它使用四轮麦克纳姆驱动进行全向移动，以及一个带有3D打印夹爪的5自由度机械臂用于物体操作和导航。电子系统由围绕 ESP32 微控制器构建的定制 PCB 板组成，以及一个 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX，负责高层处理和实时系统控制。在软件方面，Hector SLAM 提供建图与定位，A* 处理路径规划，YOLO 执行实时目标检测。这些模块利用融合的传感器数据来提供稳健的导航和可靠的避障。总体而言，该系统展示了有效的软硬件集成，在类似工业环境中的自主导航、物体操作和任务执行方面具有一致性能。

items.title_en: ActMem: From Latent Memory Reasoning to Grounded Robotic Action
items.title_zh: ActMem：从潜在记忆推理到接地的机器人动作
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in real-world long-horizon manipulation, where memory plays a crucial role. However, existing memory-augmented VLAs either retrieve past observations without reasoning about what they imply, or reason over the full history in a shared context where it crowds out current perception. Cognitive science treats them as distinct systems: memory reconstructs past experience to decide what to do, while perception guides how to act. We therefore propose ActMem, an in-context memory framework that decouples memory reasoning from perceptual grounding within a single vision-language backbone. Built on a vision-language model with native video understanding, ActMem infers the current subtask from a timestamped interaction history and keeps the hidden states formed during this inference as a Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought (Memory CoT), which conditions a flow-matching action expert. Perception Attention further lets the expert attend directly to the current view. To keep inference fast under long histories, Efficient Memory CoT Inference reuses computation across consecutive decisions without changing the output. ActMem achieves 71.1% task success and 80.8% completion success on RoboMemArena, surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.5 and 8.7 percentage points, and 73.8% average success on MIKASA-Robo, the best among all compared methods. In the real world, it reaches 68.8% average success on exogenous, endogenous, and traceless memory tasks, 10.0 percentage points above the strongest memory-augmented VLA. Code and checkpoints will be released at https://github.com/LigphiDonk/ActMem and https://huggingface.co/donk111/ActMem.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实世界长时程操作中显示出有前景的结果，其中记忆起着关键作用。然而，现有记忆增强VLA要么检索过去观测而不推理其含义，要么在共享上下文中对完整历史进行推理，从而挤占当前感知。认知科学将它们视为不同系统：记忆重构过去经验以决定做什么，而感知指导如何行动。因此，我们提出ActMem，一个上下文内记忆框架，在单一视觉-语言骨干内将记忆推理与感知接地解耦。ActMem构建于具有原生视频理解能力的视觉-语言模型之上，从带时间戳的交互历史推断当前子任务，并将该推断过程中形成的隐藏状态保留为潜在记忆思维链（Memory CoT），用于为流匹配动作专家提供条件。感知注意力进一步使该专家直接关注当前视图。为在长历史下保持推理快速，高效Memory CoT推理在连续决策之间复用计算而不改变输出。ActMem在RoboMemArena上达到71.1%的任务成功率和80.8%的完成成功率，分别超过最强基线7.5和8.7个百分点，并在MIKASA-Robo上达到73.8%的平均成功率，在所有比较方法中最佳。在真实世界中，它在外生、内生和无痕记忆任务上达到68.8%的平均成功率，比最强的记忆增强VLA高10.0个百分点。代码和检查点将在https://github.com/LigphiDonk/ActMem和https://huggingface.co/donk111/ActMem发布。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Traditional and Learning-Based Reference-Free Compressors for Long-Read Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 对长读长测序数据的传统与基于学习的无参考压缩器进行基准测试
items.abstract_en: Long-read sequencing technologies generate large volumes of data, creating substantial storage and transmission demands. Although reference-based compressors can achieve high compression, their reliance on an appropriate reference genome limits their use. We present LRCBench, a benchmark and survey of reference-free lossless compressors for long-read sequencing data. We review traditional and learning-based general-purpose and sequencing-specific methods, then evaluate 35 compressors on 16 real-world datasets from Oxford Nanopore and PacBio platforms. We compare compression ratio, storage savings, runtime, peak memory use, and robustness across datasets. Learning-based compressors are evaluated on six MinION datasets because of their high computational costs. CoLoRd achieves the best overall compression ratios in our experiments, while other methods offer trade-offs in speed, memory use, and robustness. We also examine multithreaded speedup and discuss future directions in parallel acceleration, privacy protection, adaptive parameter tuning, and hardware-algorithm co-design.
items.abstract_zh: 长读长测序技术产生大量数据，带来巨大的存储和传输需求。尽管基于参考的压缩器可以实现高压缩率，但其对合适参考基因组的依赖限制了使用。我们提出 LRCBench，一个针对长读长测序数据的无参考无损压缩器的基准测试与综述。我们回顾了传统和基于学习的通用及测序专用方法，然后在来自 Oxford Nanopore 和 PacBio 平台的 16 个真实数据集上评估了 35 个压缩器。我们比较压缩率、存储节省、运行时间、峰值内存使用以及跨数据集的鲁棒性。由于计算成本高，基于学习的压缩器在六个 MinION 数据集上评估。在我们的实验中，CoLoRd 实现了最佳的总体压缩率，而其他方法在速度、内存使用和鲁棒性方面提供权衡。我们还考察了多线程加速，并讨论了并行加速、隐私保护、自适应参数调优和硬件-算法协同设计等未来方向。

items.title_en: Quantum differential interference contrast microscope
items.title_zh: 量子微分干涉相衬显微镜
items.abstract_en: Optical sensing and imaging of transparent unstained biological and material specimen makes use of optical interference to translate phase shifts into intensity measurements, that are readily available in the optical domain. This is the case of Differential Interference Contrast (DIC) microscopes. However, environmental disturbances such as acoustic vibrations, air currents, temperature shifts, and mechanical drifts cause random phase noise that degrades the precision attainable in the estimation of the unknown phase shift. Although there are tools to compensate for these random phase drifts, such using common path interference techniques or phase stabilization systems, these are not always an option and its introduction is generally at the expense of device simplicity and robustness. Here we introduce a quantum version of Differential Interference Contrast microscopy (qDIC), that makes use of quantum interference for polarization analysis. When compared with standard schemes that make use of coherent light, our approach shows that the transfer of classical DIC microscopy into the quantum domain offers a route towards quantum-enhanced resilience to environmental disturbances, allowing the enhancement of phase sensitivity without sacrificing the simplicity and robustness of the optical setup.
items.abstract_zh: 对透明未染色生物和材料样本的光学传感与成像利用光学干涉将相移转化为强度测量，这在光学域中易于获得。微分干涉相衬（DIC）显微镜就是这种情况。然而，声振动、气流、温度变化和机械漂移等环境扰动会引起随机相位噪声，从而降低未知相移估计可达到的精度。尽管已有工具可补偿这些随机相位漂移，例如使用共路干涉技术或相位稳定系统，但这些并不总是可选方案，而且其引入通常以牺牲设备简单性和鲁棒性为代价。在此，我们引入量子版本的微分干涉相衬显微镜（qDIC），利用量子干涉进行偏振分析。与使用相干光的标准方案相比，我们的方法表明，将经典DIC显微镜迁移到量子域提供了一条通向量子增强的环境扰动鲁棒性的途径，能够在不牺牲光学装置简单性和鲁棒性的情况下增强相位灵敏度。

items.title_en: Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity
items.title_zh: 注意力头专门化：样本复杂度中的相变
items.abstract_en: Attention heads specialize into distinct functions during training, often emerging in stages together with sharp changes in model behavior. While this phenomenon has mostly been studied as a function of training time, we ask how head specialization depends on the amount of available training data. Empirically, we find that heads specialized to syntactic relations in BERT emerge as the dataset size increases. We then study this phenomenon in a solvable high-dimensional model of multi-head attention and establish that, in this model, head specialization is a genuine phase transition in sample complexity, corresponding to a non-analyticity in the test error and other observables. Depending on data structure and regularization, specialization can follow uninformative head differentiation or occur through a cascade of phase transitions that progressively recover weaker latent features, providing a statistical form of simplicity bias. Finally, we relate these statistical transitions to the stagewise emergence of specialized heads during online learning, disentangling statistical from dynamical origins of head specialization.
items.abstract_zh: 注意力头在训练过程中专门化为不同功能，通常分阶段出现，并伴随模型行为的急剧变化。尽管该现象大多作为训练时间的函数进行研究，我们追问头专门化如何取决于可用训练数据量。在实证上，我们发现BERT中专门处理句法关系的注意力头随着数据集规模增大而出现。然后，我们在一个可求解的多头注意力高维模型中研究该现象，并确立：在该模型中，头专门化是样本复杂度中的真正相变，对应于测试误差和其他可观测量中的非解析性。取决于数据结构和正则化，专门化可能继无信息性的头分化之后发生，或通过一系列相变发生，逐步恢复较弱的潜在特征，提供一种统计形式的简单性偏置。最后，我们将这些统计相变与在线学习中专门化头的分阶段出现联系起来，厘清头专门化的统计起源与动力学起源。

items.title_en: PAIR-MED: Policy-reward Alternation for Iterative Refinement in Multilingual Medical Reasoning
items.title_zh: PAIR-MED：用于多语言医疗推理迭代精炼的策略-奖励交替
items.abstract_en: Large language models demonstrate strong medical question-answering capabilities, yet reasoning performance remains uneven across languages. Process reward models (PRMs) provide step-level feedback for improving reasoning, but a fixed PRM may become increasingly misaligned with the trajectory distribution of an evolving policy during reinforcement learning, thereby reducing the reliability of its supervision. We propose a policy--reward alternating training framework that jointly adapts a medical PRM and optimizes a multilingual reasoning policy. Following supervised initialization, the current policy generates multilingual trajectories to update the PRM, which then provides process-level rewards for the next policy update. Medical step supervision maintains the PRM's medical foundation, while process, outcome, and language-related rewards guide policy learning. We develop multilingual medical PRMs (PAIR-PRM) and reasoning models (PAIR-MED) at 8B and 9B scales across 12 languages. On the medical subsets of Global-MMLU and MMLU-ProX, our models improve average accuracy by 3.01--7.47% over their corresponding Qwen backbones. On CUREMED-BENCH, PAIR-MED-9B improves the joint language consistency and logical accuracy metric by 12.88% and 7.45% over baselines for in-domain and out-of-domain languages. Further analyses examine PRM adaptation, multilingual reasoning quality, and the contributions of individual training components.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型展现出强大的医疗问答能力，但推理性能在不同语言之间仍不均衡。过程奖励模型（PRM）提供步骤级反馈以改进推理，但固定PRM在强化学习过程中可能日益与演化策略的轨迹分布失配，从而降低其监督的可靠性。我们提出一种策略-奖励交替训练框架，联合适配医疗PRM并优化多语言推理策略。在监督初始化之后，当前策略生成多语言轨迹以更新PRM，随后PRM为下一次策略更新提供过程级奖励。医疗步骤监督维持PRM的医疗基础，而过程、结果和语言相关奖励指导策略学习。我们开发了覆盖12种语言、8B和9B规模的多语言医疗PRM（PAIR-PRM）和推理模型（PAIR-MED）。在Global-MMLU和MMLU-ProX的医疗子集上，我们的模型相比对应的Qwen骨干模型将平均准确率提高3.01--7.47%。在CUREMED-BENCH上，PAIR-MED-9B在域内和域外语言上相比基线将联合语言一致性与逻辑准确率指标分别提高12.88%和7.45%。进一步分析考察PRM适配、多语言推理质量以及各训练组件的贡献。

items.title_en: Autonomous Track Racing with a Commercially Available Humanoid: System Design and Real-World Deployment
items.title_zh: 使用商用现成人形机器人的自主赛道竞速：系统设计与真实世界部署
items.abstract_en: Learning-based methods now let humanoids run robustly, and they have begun to compete in athletic events. Yet few reports describe a complete autonomous humanoid running system in an actual race, where the robot must follow a lane at a new venue, pace itself within hardware limits, and finish without intervention. We report such a system deployed on the Unitree G1, a commercially available general-purpose humanoid, in the 100 m, 400 m, and 1500 m events of the World Humanoid Robot Games 2026. The system integrates vision-based lane perception, path tracking, and a running policy trained by reinforcement learning with a human motion prior. To address the challenges of humanoid running, we stabilize head-camera images against body motion and use IMU-assisted leg odometry to bridge flight phases. To manage motor heating, we penalize hip-pitch torque during training, add heat-dissipation plates, and apply temperature-based speed limiting with event-specific pacing. The robot placed 13th of 74 in the 100 m, 10th of 44 in the 400 m first round before falling in the semifinal, and seventh of 35 in the 1500 m. In this deployment, thermal margin set the pace in every event, and the semifinal fall followed a lane-detection error.
items.abstract_zh: 基于学习的方法现在使人形机器人能够稳健奔跑，它们也已开始参加体育赛事。然而，很少有报告描述在实际比赛中完整的自主人形机器人跑步系统；在比赛中，机器人必须在新的场地沿跑道行进，在硬件限制内控制配速，并在无干预情况下完成比赛。我们报告了这样一个系统，部署在 Unitree G1 这一商用通用人形机器人上，参加 2026 年世界人形机器人运动会的 100 米、400 米和 1500 米项目。该系统集成了基于视觉的赛道感知、路径跟踪，以及通过带有人类运动先验的强化学习训练的跑步策略。为应对人形机器人跑步的挑战，我们对头部相机图像进行抗身体运动稳定，并使用 IMU 辅助的腿部里程计来桥接腾空阶段。为管理电机发热，我们在训练中惩罚髋关节俯仰力矩，增加散热板，并应用基于温度的速度限制和针对具体项目的配速策略。该机器人在 100 米中位列 74 名选手中的第 13 名，在 400 米第一轮中位列 44 名中的第 10 名，但在半决赛中摔倒，在 1500 米中位列 35 名中的第 7 名。在本次部署中，热裕度决定了每个项目的配速，而半决赛摔倒发生在一次赛道检测错误之后。

items.title_en: Beyond Resemblance: Image Fusion Reimagined
items.title_zh: 超越相似性：重新构想图像融合
items.abstract_en: Image fusion often lacks ground-truth fused images, forcing existing deep methods to indirectly define fusion objectives by requiring the fused image to simultaneously resemble multiple source images. However, the distinct imaging characteristics of different modalities can impose competing constraints on the fused result, potentially limiting the effective integration of their complementary information. To address this long-standing challenge facing the image fusion community, we propose ApexFuse, a novel generative image fusion paradigm that moves beyond source-resemblance constraints toward learning a general distribution of high-quality scene representations. Specifically, we develop a human-LMM-in-the-loop pipeline that leverages large multimodal generative models and iterative human feedback to translate abstract fusion objectives into reliable visual references, thereby defining the target distribution of ideal fusion outcomes. Through target-distribution-guided adaptation, we transfer the rich generative priors of pretrained FLUX to image fusion, enabling high-quality scene reconstruction conditioned on multimodal observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ApexFuse harmoniously integrates salient thermal targets, natural colors, and fine textures, achieving superior visual quality as well as semantic segmentation and object detection performance over previous source-resemblance methods. Moreover, ApexFuse exhibits remarkable cross-task generalization, extending from infrared-visible fusion to multi-exposure fusion, multi-focus fusion, and visible-depth fusion without additional fine-tuning.
items.abstract_zh: 图像融合通常缺乏真值融合图像，迫使现有深度方法通过要求融合图像同时相似于多幅源图像来间接定义融合目标。然而，不同模态的成像特性差异会对融合结果施加相互竞争的约束，可能限制对其互补信息的有效整合。为应对图像融合领域这一长期挑战，我们提出 ApexFuse，一种新颖的生成式图像融合范式，它超越源相似性约束，转向学习高质量场景表示的通用分布。具体而言，我们开发了一种 human-LMM-in-the-loop 流程，利用大型多模态生成模型和迭代式人类反馈，将抽象的融合目标转化为可靠的视觉参考，从而定义理想融合结果的目标分布。通过目标分布引导的适配，我们将预训练 FLUX 的丰富生成先验迁移到图像融合，实现以多模态观测为条件的高质量场景重建。大量实验表明，ApexFuse 能和谐地整合显著热目标、自然色彩和精细纹理，相比先前的源相似性方法，取得更优的视觉质量以及语义分割和目标检测性能。此外，ApexFuse 展现出显著的跨任务泛化能力，无需额外微调即可从红外-可见光融合扩展到多曝光融合、多聚焦融合和可见光-深度融合。

items.title_en: STORM: A Lightweight Structure-Free Model for Binding Affinity Prediction
items.title_zh: STORM：一种用于结合亲和力预测的轻量级无结构模型
items.abstract_en: Accurately predicting a small molecule's binding affinity to a protein, a critical task in drug discovery, remains challenging. Physics-based approaches like free-energy perturbation (FEP) have very high computational costs and require expert setup. Recent machine learning--based cofolding models have reported accuracy approaching that of FEP---and at least one of them, Boltz-2, has already been widely adopted for affinity prediction---but they remain expensive for large computational screens and even more expensive for retraining on newly collected experimental data. To address these challenges, we introduce STORM: Similarity Transfer from Observed Reference Molecules. STORM is a fast, simple machine learning model that ensembles many small model fusions of diverse protein and molecule representations for binding affinity prediction. Trained on the same data, STORM matches or exceeds the accuracy of Boltz-2 on multiple evaluation datasets, while delivering a speed improvement of over five orders of magnitude for both inference and training. Our results also suggest opportunities to substantially improve affinity prediction accuracy by integrating historical experimental affinity data with structural and biophysical information.
items.abstract_zh: 准确预测小分子与蛋白质的结合亲和力是药物发现中的关键任务，仍然具有挑战性。基于物理的方法（如自由能扰动，FEP）计算成本非常高且需要专家设置。近期基于机器学习的共折叠模型报告的精度已接近FEP——其中至少一个模型Boltz-2已被广泛用于亲和力预测——但它们对于大规模计算筛选仍然昂贵，而要在新收集的实验数据上重新训练则更加昂贵。为应对这些挑战，我们提出STORM：从观测参考分子进行相似性迁移（Similarity Transfer from Observed Reference Molecules）。STORM是一种快速、简单的机器学习模型，它集成许多小型模型融合，这些融合由多样的蛋白质和分子表示构成，用于结合亲和力预测。在相同数据上训练，STORM在多个评估数据集上达到或超过Boltz-2的精度，同时在推理和训练上均带来超过五个数量级的速度提升。我们的结果还表明，通过将历史实验亲和力数据与结构和生物物理信息相结合，有望大幅提高亲和力预测精度。

items.title_en: Zernike-efficient phase contrast with a scanned electron probe
items.title_zh: 采用扫描电子探针的Zernike高效相位衬度
items.abstract_en: For weak-phase objects, scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) with a far-field detector transfers at most half of the phase information per electron that Zernike phase-contrast (ZPC) conventional transmission electron microscopy (CTEM) achieves. We propose APEX (Apex Phase-plate EXit-wave imaging), a scanned-probe mode that combines a defocused probe, a $π/2$ phase element in a magnified image of the probe crossover, and in-focus image-plane detection at each scan position. It applies the generalized Zernike framework of Dwyer and Paganin to a scanned probe. In a linear model of a thin weak-phase object with an ideal phase dot, APEX transfers nearly the full Zernike Fisher information over a wide band, substantially more than diffraction-plane four-dimensional STEM (4D-STEM). In idealized simulations of myoglobin in vitreous ice at a cryo-EM dose (elastic scattering only, no chromatic aberration, full coherence), ideal-dot APEX at a probe defocus of 1 $μ$m reconstructs the phase more accurately than defocused 4D-STEM ptychography with one untuned probe setting. At a defocus of about 25 $μ$m, a crossed laser phase plate (XLPP) acts as the $π/2$ element, and APEX of a periodic specimen cell comes close to CTEM with the same plate. In two dimensions, this mode is equivalent to laser phase-plate CTEM of a small, scanned area. A single simulated APEX scan with the XLPP also separates two myoglobin phase screens 150 nm apart in vacuum, at known depths, which is not possible with one ZPC CTEM exposure.
items.abstract_zh: 对于弱相位物体，使用远场探测器的扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）每电子传输的相位信息至多为Zernike相位衬度（ZPC）常规透射电子显微镜（CTEM）所实现的一半。我们提出APEX（Apex Phase-plate EXit-wave imaging，出射波相位板成像），一种扫描探针模式，它结合离焦探针、探针交叉点放大图像中的$π/2$相位元件，以及每个扫描位置处的聚焦像面探测。它将Dwyer和Paganin的广义Zernike框架应用于扫描探针。在带有理想相位点的薄弱相位物体的线性模型中，APEX在宽频带上传输几乎全部的Zernike Fisher信息，显著多于衍射面四维STEM（4D-STEM）。在冷冻电镜剂量下（仅弹性散射、无色差、完全相干）对玻璃态冰中肌红蛋白的理想化模拟中，探针离焦为1 $μ$m的理想点APEX比使用一个未调谐探针设置的离焦4D-STEM叠层成像更准确地重建相位。在约25 $μ$m的离焦下，交叉激光相位板（XLPP）充当$π/2$元件，对周期性样品池的APEX接近使用同一相位板的CTEM。在二维中，该模式等效于对小扫描区域的激光相位板CTEM。使用XLPP的单次模拟APEX扫描还能在真空中已知深度处分离相距150 nm的两个肌红蛋白相位屏，而单次ZPC CTEM曝光无法做到这一点。

items.title_en: Improving Imitation Policies for Multi-Phase Tasks through Residual Learning Allocation
items.title_zh: 通过残差学习分配改进多阶段任务的模仿策略
items.abstract_en: Residual reinforcement learning corrects an imitation-trained base policy using a limited budget of environment interaction. In a task with several phases, this budget must be divided among the phases, and the phase in which the base policy fails is not necessarily the phase in which a correction most improves task completion. We formalize this distinction through the completion gain: the change in full-task completion probability when, during a single phase, a state-feedback controller replaces selected components of the base policy's action. We decompose the completion gain into the probability of reaching the phase and the conditional improvement in completion from the start of the phase, and we estimate it from paired episodes. The positive estimates determine which action components the residual policy corrects and how training episodes are distributed across phases. In stochastic point-mass docking experiments, most failures occurred in the final docking phase, whereas the largest completion gain occurred in the preceding channel phase; gain-based allocation improved completion over allocation proportional to failure counts and, in a variant with a longer approach, over uniform allocation at half of the budget. In simulated bimanual robotic assembly, the completion-gain estimates were positive only for insertion and release, although few failures occurred during release; in a second assembly configuration, a residual policy trained in the release phase improved completion from held-out states at the start of release by 16.9%.
items.abstract_zh: 残差强化学习利用有限的环境交互预算来校正经模仿训练的基础策略。在多阶段任务中，该预算必须在各阶段之间分配，而基础策略失败的阶段不一定是校正最能提高任务完成率的阶段。我们通过完成增益形式化这一区别：完成增益指在单个阶段内，由状态反馈控制器替换基础策略动作的选定组件时，全任务完成概率的变化。我们将完成增益分解为到达该阶段的概率以及从该阶段开始的条件完成改进，并从成对回合中估计它。正估计值决定了残差策略校正哪些动作组件，以及训练回合如何在各阶段间分布。在随机点质量对接实验中，大多数失败发生在最终对接阶段，而最大完成增益出现在此前的中通道阶段；基于增益的分配相比按失败次数比例的分配提高了完成率，并在具有更长接近阶段的变体中，在预算减半时优于均匀分配。在模拟双臂机器人装配中，完成增益估计仅在插入和释放阶段为正，尽管释放阶段很少有失败；在第二种装配配置中，在释放阶段训练的残差策略将从释放开始时的留出状态出发的完成率提高了 16.9%。

items.title_en: Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models
items.title_zh: SLAM-ASR语音识别模型的归纳头起源
items.abstract_en: What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription quality under noisy audio.
items.abstract_zh: 是什么使得从编码器状态到冻结语言模型嵌入空间的一个小型已训练映射足以实现有竞争力的语音识别？SLAM-ASR架构的前提是冻结语言模型拥有足够丰富的语言知识来执行识别任务。这一假设虽然合理，但几乎无法揭示这些模型背后的机制。因此，我们寻求它们所依赖的具体内部结构。本工作表明，SLAM-ASR模型依赖于冻结语言模型的归纳头：在文本中复制重复词元序列的相同头，对于将语音嵌入映射到转写词元也很重要。此外，我们发现成对的头表现出一种受约束形式的差分注意力，抵消注意力噪声并将注意力锐化到先前生成的词上。最后，我们展示了归纳头如何用于在嘈杂音频下提高转写质量。

items.title_en: GNetSS: Towards Learning GNSS Corrections without Ground Truth
items.title_zh: GNetSS：迈向无需真值学习 GNSS 校正
items.abstract_en: We present GNetSS, a self-supervised GNSS position correction framework that improves the robustness of single point positioning (SPP) without requiring ground-truth locations for training. GNetSS combines a transformer-based network with a deterministic differentiable positioning solver. The network predicts satellite-wise pseudorange corrections by modelling inter-satellite geometry and temporal context, while the solver converts these corrected measurements into receiver position corrections under GNSS geometry and optional motion constraints. Unlike supervised GNSS correction methods that rely on ground-truth, GNetSS derives its training signal directly from GNSS measurement consistency. Experimental results show that GNetSS improves robustness across open-sky, urban, and forested environments. The method is particularly effective at suppressing large-error outliers, reducing the maximum 3D positioning error by over 50% compared with SPP. These results demonstrate the potential of self-supervised pseudorange correction for scalable and robust GNSS positioning in real-world autonomy applications. Code and the in-house dataset will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 GNetSS，一种自监督 GNSS 位置校正框架，可在无需真值位置用于训练的情况下提高单点定位（SPP）的鲁棒性。GNetSS 将基于 transformer 的网络与确定性可微定位求解器相结合。该网络通过建模卫星间几何关系和时间上下文来预测逐卫星伪距校正，而求解器则在 GNSS 几何和可选运动约束下将这些校正后的测量转换为接收机位置校正。与依赖真值的监督式 GNSS 校正方法不同，GNetSS 直接从 GNSS 测量一致性中获取训练信号。实验结果表明，GNetSS 在开阔天空、城市和森林环境中均提高了鲁棒性。该方法在抑制大误差离群值方面尤其有效，与 SPP 相比将最大 3D 定位误差降低 50% 以上。这些结果展示了自监督伪距校正在真实世界自主应用中实现可扩展且鲁棒的 GNSS 定位的潜力。代码和内部数据集将在录用后发布。

items.title_en: PatchAdaNet: Unsupervised class incremental learning using local patches and global adapters
items.title_zh: PatchAdaNet：使用局部图像块和全局适配器的无监督类增量学习
items.abstract_en: Biological learning systems acquire knowledge incrementally through broad, reusable representations established early and kept largely stable, while integrating new experience with minimal interference with previously learned knowledge. Replay-based methods approximate this by storing samples or features from previous tasks and mixing them into the current task. However, memory buffers grow with the number of tasks and may retain task-specific noise that reduces generalization. To address these limitations, we propose PatchAdaNet (Patch Adapter Network), an unsupervised class-incremental learning method for image classification that continually updates feature representations using autoencoders. Since images share structural features such as edges, corners, and shapes, we first divide each image into patches and train independent autoencoders on external data to reconstruct each patch. The layers of all patch encoders are aggregated into global frozen layers that generalize across tasks and remain fixed throughout learning. Learnable adapters then build global image representations from these features to reconstruct the entire image. To prevent feature drift without storing data, we introduce the Global Feature Centroid (GFC), a fixed-size running average of adapter outputs updated after each task to penalizes representation drift. Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is applied to the learnable layers to preserve previously learned features by constraining important weights. Finally, a linear classifier is trained on the frozen latent representation and GFC for class-incremental evaluation. We evaluate PatchAdaNet in both CNN and Vision Transformer settings on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, miniImageNet and 5-Datasets, providing a comparative study of the two architectures under identical class-incremental settings. Code is available.
items.abstract_zh: 生物学习系统通过早期建立并基本保持稳定的大范围可复用表征来增量获取知识，同时以对先前所学知识的最小干扰整合新经验。基于回放的方法通过存储先前任务的样本或特征并将其混入当前任务来近似这一过程。然而，记忆缓冲区会随任务数量增长，并可能保留降低泛化的任务特定噪声。为解决这些限制，我们提出PatchAdaNet（Patch Adapter Network），一种用于图像分类的无监督类增量学习方法，使用自编码器持续更新特征表示。由于图像共享边缘、角和形状等结构特征，我们首先将每幅图像划分为图像块，并在外部数据上训练独立自编码器以重建每个图像块。所有图像块编码器的层被聚合为全局冻结层，这些层可跨任务泛化并在整个学习过程中保持固定。随后，可学习适配器从这些特征构建全局图像表示以重建整幅图像。为在不存储数据的情况下防止特征漂移，我们引入全局特征质心（Global Feature Centroid, GFC），它是适配器输出的固定大小滑动平均，在每个任务后更新，以惩罚表示漂移。对可学习层应用弹性权重巩固（Elastic Weight Consolidation, EWC），通过约束重要权重来保留先前学到的特征。最后，在冻结的潜在表示和GFC上训练线性分类器，用于类增量评估。我们在CNN和Vision Transformer两种设置下，在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、miniImageNet和5-Datasets上评估PatchAdaNet，并在相同类增量设置下对两种架构进行比较研究。代码已公开。

items.title_en: Neural Circuit Architectural Priors for Rat Locomotion
items.title_zh: 大鼠运动的神经回路架构先验
items.abstract_en: Animals generate behavior through continuous interactions between their neural circuits, bodies, and environment. Embodied simulations study these interactions by testing neural circuit models in biologically realistic settings. Recent efforts have simulated diverse animals, and emerging work on biologically grounded neural architectures has begun to integrate circuit connectivity and single-unit dynamics from experimental data into artificial neural networks, introducing stronger inductive biases and closer mechanistic alignment with biology. How can we develop embodied simulations that enable the study of increasingly complex bodies and neural circuits? In this work, we address the challenge through coordinated advances in the simulated body, neural architecture, and training infrastructure. We introduce Rat v2, an efficient and flexible biomechanical body for simulating rat behavior. To control this body, we develop Rat NCAP, a biologically grounded neural architecture for locomotion based on mammalian spinal circuits that incorporates cell-type-specific connectivity and a novel flexor-extensor neuromechanical interface. To optimize circuit parameters, we develop GPU-accelerated simulation and training infrastructure. The model learns to locomote at different speeds and transition between gaits without imitation learning, producing locomotion statistics, kinematics, and cell-type-specific neural activity consistent with experimental data. Analyses reveal that the neuromechanical interface substantially affects trainability and gait quality, and in silico cell-type ablations reproduce known gait phenotypes and predict gait changes under graded perturbations. Together, these findings support the view that embodied simulations at an intermediate level of abstraction can simultaneously reproduce complex behavior and yield mechanistic insights into the neural circuits that generate it.
items.abstract_zh: 动物通过其神经回路、身体和环境之间的持续交互产生行为。具身仿真通过在生物逼真环境中测试神经回路模型来研究这些交互。最近的工作已经模拟了多种动物，而关于具有生物学基础的神经架构的新兴工作已开始将从实验数据获得的回路连接性和单单元动力学集成到人工神经网络中，引入更强的归纳偏置，并在机制上与生物学更紧密地对齐。我们如何开发能够研究日益复杂的身体和神经回路的具身仿真？在这项工作中，我们通过在仿真身体、神经架构和训练基础设施方面的协同进展来应对这一挑战。我们介绍 Rat v2，一种用于模拟大鼠行为的高效且灵活的生物力学身体。为了控制这个身体，我们开发了 Rat NCAP，一种基于哺乳动物脊髓回路的具有生物学基础的运动神经架构，它结合了细胞类型特异性连接和一种新颖的屈肌-伸肌神经力学接口。为了优化回路参数，我们开发了GPU加速的仿真和训练基础设施。该模型无需模仿学习即可学习以不同速度运动并在步态之间转换，产生与实验数据一致的运动统计、运动学和细胞类型特异性神经活动。分析表明，神经力学接口显著影响可训练性和步态质量，并且计算机模拟中的细胞类型消融再现了已知的步态表型，并预测了在分级扰动下的步态变化。总之，这些发现支持这样一种观点：处于中间抽象层次的具身仿真能够同时再现复杂行为，并对产生该行为的神经回路提供机制性见解。

items.title_en: Observation of temporal routing of topological edge states
items.title_zh: 拓扑边缘态的时间路由观测
items.abstract_en: The switching or routing of topological edge states is crucial for disorder-immune state transfer. Previous experimental observations have primarily relied on optical waveguide arrays that treat the spatial coordinate as an equivalent temporal dimension. However, direct experimental observation of the routing dynamics of topological edge states in physical time remains challenging. Here, we report the experimental observation of temporal routing of topological edge states. By constructing a lattice composed of two coupled nonlinear Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chains, the topological edge states exhibit temporal routing behavior controlled by nonlinearity. As the excitation voltage increases from the linear regime, we observe that the voltage intensity distribution transitions from periodic interchain exchange to slowed interchain exchange and ultimately to localization with strongly suppressed interchain exchange, thereby validating the phenomenon of temporal routing. These dynamics are experimentally observed within a finite time window limited by circuit dissipation. Our findings provide valuable insights into the temporal manipulation of topological edge states.
items.abstract_zh: 拓扑边缘态的切换或路由对于免疫无序的状态传输至关重要。先前的实验观测主要依赖于将空间坐标视为等效时间维度的光波导阵列。然而，在物理时间中直接实验观测拓扑边缘态的路由动力学仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们报告拓扑边缘态时间路由的实验观测。通过构建由两条耦合的非线性 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 链组成的晶格，拓扑边缘态表现出由非线性控制的时间路由行为。随着激励电压从线性区域增加，我们观察到电压强度分布从周期性链间交换转变为减慢的链间交换，并最终转变为链间交换被强烈抑制的局域化，从而验证了时间路由现象。这些动力学在受电路耗散限制的有限时间窗口内被实验观测到。我们的发现为拓扑边缘态的时间调控提供了有价值的见解。

items.title_en: Towards Deep Learning-Based Linear Assignment Problem Solvers for Multi-Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向多目标跟踪的基于深度学习的线性分配问题求解器
items.abstract_en: This paper proposes and evaluates deep learning (DL)-based linear assignment problem (LAP) solvers as a replacement for the classical Hungarian algorithm in multi-object tracking (MOT) systems. Three representative neural models are studied, namely a convolutional network (CNN), a graph neural network (GNN), and the graph-based linear assignment network (GLAN). A cost-matrix embedding is introduced so that a single model operates on cost matrices of any size, as required in MOT where the number of objects varies over time, without training a separate model for each input shape. Extensive simulations show that the embedding improves the accuracy of the neural solvers (i.e., CNN and GNN), while GLAN attains the best accuracy among them. These solvers are then integrated into a generalized labeled multi-Bernoulli (GLMB) tracker and evaluated on the WILDTRACK dataset, where GLAN yields tracking accuracy close to the Hungarian reference and comparable to recent DL-based trackers.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出并评估基于深度学习（DL）的线性分配问题（LAP）求解器，以替代多目标跟踪（MOT）系统中的经典匈牙利算法。研究了三种代表性神经网络模型，即卷积网络（CNN）、图神经网络（GNN）和基于图的线性分配网络（GLAN）。引入代价矩阵嵌入，使单一模型能够处理任意大小的代价矩阵，这符合MOT中目标数量随时间变化的要求，而无需为每种输入形状训练单独模型。大量仿真表明，该嵌入提高了神经求解器（即CNN和GNN）的准确性，而GLAN在其中取得最佳准确性。随后这些求解器被集成到广义标签多伯努利（GLMB）跟踪器中，并在WILDTRACK数据集上评估，其中GLAN的跟踪准确率接近匈牙利参考方法，并与近期基于DL的跟踪器相当。

items.title_en: MECI: Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction for Multimodal Entity Linking
items.title_zh: MECI：用于多模态实体链接的多元素协同交互
items.abstract_en: Multimodal Entity Linking (MEL) aims to disambiguate mentions in multimodal contexts by grounding them to specific entities in a knowledge base. A pivotal challenge in MEL is capturing multi-level correspondences: the semantic consistency between mention-entity pairs and the complementary correlations across modalities. However, existing methods often suffer from element dominance due to their reliance on coupled interactions or coarse global aggregations. In response, we propose the Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction (MECI) framework. First, to capture multi-element mention-entity correspondences, we develop a Multi-view Experts Network that leverages a "divide-and-conquer" strategy for decoupled feature learning to mitigate element dominance, supported by a KL-guided routing mechanism that governs expert specialization and collaboration. Furthermore, to model cross-modal complementary correlations, we propose a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Module, where a dynamic modality-aware weighting network refines interactions across hierarchical semantic levels, thereby integrating multi-granular evidence to counteract element dominance. Finally, we incorporate a generative semantic refinement stage that utilizes large language models for zero-shot re-ranking. Extensive experiments on WikiDiverse, RichpediaMEL, and WikiMEL show that MECI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, improving Hits@1 by 1.95%, 7.30%, and 2.31%, respectively.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态实体链接（MEL）旨在通过将多模态上下文中的提及接地到知识库中的特定实体来消歧。MEL 中的一个关键挑战是捕获多级对应关系：提及-实体对之间的语义一致性以及跨模态的互补相关性。然而，现有方法由于依赖耦合交互或粗粒度全局聚合，常常遭受元素主导问题。为此，我们提出多元素协同交互（MECI）框架。首先，为了捕获多元素提及-实体对应关系，我们开发了一个多视图专家网络，它利用“分而治之”策略进行解耦特征学习以缓解元素主导，并由一个 KL 引导的路由机制支持，该机制管理专家专业化和协作。此外，为了建模跨模态互补相关性，我们提出了一个层次化多模态交互模块，其中动态模态感知加权网络在层次化语义级别上细化交互，从而整合多粒度证据以抵消元素主导。最后，我们加入了一个生成式语义细化阶段，利用大语言模型进行零样本重排序。在 WikiDiverse、RichpediaMEL 和 WikiMEL 上的大量实验表明，MECI 始终优于最先进的基线，分别将 Hits@1 提高了 1.95%、7.30% 和 2.31%。

items.title_en: Stereo Visual Odometry with In-the-Loop Geometric Feed-Forward Models Towards Dense Metric Mapping
items.title_zh: 面向稠密度量建图的在环几何前馈模型立体视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: We present a stereo visual odometry (SVO) framework that integrates geometric feed-forward models (GFMs) for dense depth prediction with factor-graph-based visual odometry to achieve accurate localisation and dense metric mapping. Our key idea is to exploit sparse but reliable metric geometry estimated from stereo and temporal multi-view observations to calibrate dense GFM predictions, while retaining the robustness and efficiency of model-based SVO. Rather than directly conditioning the GFM on potentially noisy stereo depth, optimised 3D landmarks are used to jointly estimate a scale-shift transformation over all keyframes within each local submap, yielding metrically consistent dense depth predictions. To balance accuracy and computational efficiency, we introduce a hierarchical factor-graph architecture. At the local level, sliding-window optimisation estimates high-frequency camera poses and multi-view-refined 3D landmarks. Dense predictions are generated only for selected keyframes and registered within each submap using SE(3) Generalised ICP. Consecutive submaps are further aligned in Sim(3) using their shared geometry, allowing residual scale inconsistencies to be corrected. These intra- and inter-submap constraints are incorporated into a global factor graph to produce a consistent trajectory and dense metric reconstruction. Extensive experiments on public and in-house datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive odometry accuracy against geometric and learning-based baselines while providing accurate dense metric reconstruction and improved robustness to failures in learned depth prediction.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种立体视觉里程计（SVO）框架，将用于稠密深度预测的几何前馈模型（GFM）与基于因子图的视觉里程计相结合，以实现准确定位和稠密度量建图。我们的核心思想是利用由立体和时间多视图观测估计的稀疏但可靠的度量几何来校准稠密 GFM 预测，同时保留基于模型的 SVO 的鲁棒性和效率。我们没有直接将 GFM 以可能含噪的立体深度为条件，而是利用优化后的 3D 路标点，在每个局部子图内对所有关键帧联合估计尺度-平移变换，从而得到度量一致的稠密深度预测。为平衡准确性和计算效率，我们引入分层因子图架构。在局部层面，滑动窗口优化估计高频相机位姿和多视图精化后的 3D 路标点。稠密预测仅针对选定的关键帧生成，并使用 SE(3) Generalized ICP 在每个子图内配准。连续子图利用其共享几何在 Sim(3) 中进一步对齐，从而校正残余的尺度不一致。这些子图内和子图间约束被纳入全局因子图，以产生一致的轨迹和稠密度量重建。在公开和内部数据集上的大量实验表明，所提框架在几何和基于学习的基线方法面前取得了有竞争力的里程计精度，同时提供准确的稠密度量重建，并提高对学习深度预测失败的鲁棒性。

items.title_en: TRIDENT: Efficient Triple-Task Learning of Dehazing, Depth, and Uncertainty Estimation for Underwater 3-D Robot Visual Perception
items.title_zh: TRIDENT：面向水下三维机器人视觉感知的去雾、深度与不确定性估计高效三任务学习
items.abstract_en: Underwater visual systems often suffer from blurry textures and low color contrast due to the inevitable light propagation. These issues can significantly degrade the perception of stable robotic operations. In this paper, we introduce a novel learning-based sensing system that tackles the multidimensional vision tasks in underwater; concretely, we deal with image enhancement, depth estimation, and uncertainty for 3-D visual systems. Also, we propose a TRIDENT model in a fast and lightweight manner; TRIDENT consists of three parallelized decoders and one backbone structure for efficient feature sharing. In addition, it is designed to be trained to express complex parameterization. In experimental evaluation on several standard datasets, we demonstrate that TRIDENT significantly outperforms other existing methods on image enhancement and depth estimation. Despite performing three tasks, our model has better efficiency than the others for both memory size and inference time. Finally, our joint learning approach demonstrates robustness in feature matching and seamlessly extends from 2-D to 3-D vision tasks. Supplements are available at https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home
items.abstract_zh: 水下视觉系统常因不可避免的光传播而出现纹理模糊和色彩对比度低的问题。这些问题会显著降低稳定机器人操作的感知能力。本文提出一种新颖的基于学习的传感系统，用于处理水下的多维视觉任务；具体而言，我们处理三维视觉系统的图像增强、深度估计和不确定性。此外，我们以快速轻量的方式提出TRIDENT模型；TRIDENT由三个并行解码器和一个主干结构组成，以实现高效的特征共享。此外，该模型被设计为可训练以表达复杂的参数化。在多个标准数据集上的实验评估中，我们证明TRIDENT在图像增强和深度估计上显著优于其他现有方法。尽管执行三项任务，我们的模型在内存大小和推理时间上均比其他方法具有更好的效率。最后，我们的联合学习方法在特征匹配中表现出鲁棒性，并从二维无缝扩展到三维视觉任务。补充材料见 https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home

items.title_en: Calpha: Toward Native Biomolecular Intelligence in a General-Purpose Language Model
items.title_zh: Calpha：迈向通用语言模型中的原生生物分子智能
items.abstract_en: Biomolecular foundation models predict the structures of proteins and their complexes accurately, and large language models (LLMs) reason in natural language, but the two remain separate: the abilities of the former are not part of a general-purpose LLM, and the reasoning of the latter does not enter a structure prediction. Calpha aims at one general model that folds proteins and complexes, understands protein sequence and structure, and lets its language reasoning influence the structures it predicts. This report covers the first step, in which an LLM outputs single-chain protein structures. Qwen3.5-9B reads a sequence enriched with ESM2 residue features. It can respond in text or emit a token that invokes a pretrained SimpleFold structure head, which receives information about the protein only through Qwen's residue states. Under a fixed folding request, the head achieves mean TM-scores of 0.808 on the FoldBench-334 development set, 0.635 on CASP16 domains and 0.900 on a CAMEO-style PDB set. We compare these predictions with a baseline in which ESM2-3B encodes the sequence and a fine-tuned SimpleFold-3B head predicts the coordinates. The two systems also differ in trainable weights, training duration and crop length. For chains of 100--299 residues, all three paired confidence intervals include zero. At 300--600 residues, the mean differences are -0.044, -0.160 and -0.025, respectively. In a separate test, four English request types triggered folding on every evaluated example. Protein training reduced accuracy on a 350-item MMLU-Pro subset from 77.4% to 70.3%. An LLM can therefore output single-chain structures from its own states, with lower long-chain scores in the current comparisons and reduced accuracy on the evaluated MMLU-Pro subset. Complex prediction, structure understanding and the effect of language reasoning on the predicted coordinates remain future work.
items.abstract_zh: 生物分子基础模型能准确预测蛋白质及其复合物的结构，大语言模型（LLM）能用自然语言推理，但二者仍然分离：前者的能力不属于通用 LLM，后者的推理也不进入结构预测。Calpha 旨在构建一个通用模型，能够折叠蛋白质和复合物、理解蛋白质序列与结构，并让其语言推理影响所预测的结构。本报告涵盖第一步，即 LLM 输出单链蛋白质结构。Qwen3.5-9B 读取用 ESM2 残基特征增强的序列。它可以用文本回应，或发出一个 token 来调用预训练的 SimpleFold 结构头；该结构头仅通过 Qwen 的残基状态接收关于蛋白质的信息。在固定折叠请求下，该结构头在 FoldBench-334 开发集上达到平均 TM-score 0.808，在 CASP16 结构域上为 0.635，在 CAMEO 风格 PDB 集上为 0.900。我们将这些预测与一个基线比较：其中 ESM2-3B 编码序列，微调的 SimpleFold-3B 头预测坐标。两个系统在可训练权重、训练时长和裁剪长度上也不同。对于 100–299 个残基的链，三个配对置信区间均包含零。在 300–600 个残基时，平均差异分别为 -0.044、-0.160 和 -0.025。在一项单独测试中，四种英文请求类型在每个评估示例上都触发了折叠。蛋白质训练将 350 项 MMLU-Pro 子集上的准确率从 77.4% 降至 70.3%。因此，LLM 可以从自身状态输出单链结构；在当前比较中长链得分较低，且在所评估的 MMLU-Pro 子集上准确率下降。复合物预测、结构理解以及语言推理对预测坐标的影响仍属未来工作。

items.title_en: Fractional Charge at Dislocations from Band-Inversion Cancellation
items.title_zh: 能带反转相消导致的位错分数电荷
items.abstract_en: Band inversions with opposite Chern numbers cancel in the Hall response and yield counterpropagating boundary modes that can gap out. However, a bulk probe of the topology that survives such a cancellation is lacking. We here show that dislocations in inversion-symmetric two-band crystals with cancelling band inversions bind a half-integer charge, which reveals the quantized bulk polarization of the bond-centered obstructed atomic limit realized by such crystals. To demonstrate this, we continuously deform a broad class of two-band lattice models into decoupled chains, without closing the bulk gap or breaking the inversion symmetry, where the dislocation charge follows from a count of occupied bonds. Notably, the fractional part of this charge is insensitive to local perturbations of the dislocation core, and it therefore persists after the in-gap core state is removed, as we show analytically in the chain limit and numerically away from it. In the Weyl-semimetal counterpart, the response to a magnetic flux separates this crystalline charge from the charge set by the Chern number of each momentum slice. We propose that a half-integer core charge that persists after the in-gap peak disappears from the local spectrum can be detected in artificial electronic and optical lattices, with metamaterials providing complementary access to the core modes.
items.abstract_zh: 具有相反陈数的能带反转在霍尔响应中相消，并产生可打开能隙的反向传播边界模式。然而，缺乏对这种相消后仍存拓扑的体探测手段。我们在此表明，在具有相消能带反转的反演对称双能带晶体中，位错束缚半整数电荷，这揭示了此类晶体所实现的键中心受阻原子极限的量子化体极化。为证明这一点，我们将一大类双能带晶格模型连续形变为解耦链，而不关闭体能隙或破坏反演对称性；在此过程中，位错电荷可由占据键的计数得到。值得注意的是，该电荷的分数部分对位错芯的局域扰动不敏感，因此即使能隙内芯态被移除，它仍然存在——我们在链极限下解析展示，并在远离链极限时数值展示。在 Weyl 半金属对应体系中，对磁通量的响应将这种晶格电荷与由每个动量切片的陈数所设定的电荷区分开来。我们提出，在人工电子和光学晶格中可探测一种半整数芯电荷，该电荷在局域谱中的能隙内峰消失后仍持续存在，而超材料为芯模提供了互补的访问途径。

items.title_en: A Copper-Inducible Yeast Biosensor with Bioluminescent Readout: Mathematical Modeling, Experimental Validation, and Photodetector Coupling for Molecular Communication in IoBNT
items.title_zh: 一种具有生物发光读数的铜诱导型酵母生物传感器：数学建模、实验验证及用于IoBNT中分子通信的光电探测器耦合
items.abstract_en: Engineered living biosensors constitute promising model organisms for bringing Molecular Communications (MC) closer to practical applications. However, challenges associated with their development and characterization have resulted in the relevant literature being limited in the MC domain, . In this paper, we contribute in this direction by leveraging engineered yeast as a basis to detect heavy metals such as copper. The biosensor's development is supported by a validated mathematical characterization and analysis for possible integration in an MC system. Different from the existing literature, mathematical representations of the major biological processes within the yeast copper detoxification pathway are integrated into a comprehensive framework that predicts the time evolution of the CUP1 gene, which is treated as the system output. In the engineered circuit, CUP1 was replaced with GFP, therefore making GFP fluorescence the final system output. Experimental analysis including mRNA transcript quantification and fluorometric measurements, validate the GFP reporting model to a satisfactory degree. This establishes the proposed model as a useful tool for virtual experimentation and the developed testbed as a suitable platform for further engineering of yeast-based copper sensors. The theoretical analysis is further extended by incorporating a self-sustained bioluminescent reporter for yeast, replacing GFP and enabling optical output without external light excitation. The optical response is coupled to a photodetector model, rendering the system suitable for integration into mobile monitoring devices such as Smart Pills. The presented characterization of the yeast receiver as a copper biosensor, constitutes the first step towards the development and characterization of a complete end-to-end MC based system for gut theranostics after coupling with suitable engineered probiotic senders.
items.abstract_zh: 工程化活体生物传感器是使分子通信（MC）更接近实际应用的有前景的模式生物。然而，与其开发和表征相关的挑战导致MC领域的相关文献有限。在本文中，我们朝这一方向作出贡献，利用工程化酵母作为检测铜等重金属的基础。该生物传感器的开发得到了经过验证的数学表征与分析的支撑，以考虑其集成到MC系统中的可能性。与现有文献不同，酵母铜解毒途径中主要生物过程的数学表示被整合到一个综合框架中，该框架预测CUP1基因的时间演化，并将其视为系统输出。在工程化电路中，CUP1被GFP替换，因此使GFP荧光成为最终系统输出。包括mRNA转录本定量和荧光测量在内的实验分析，在令人满意的程度上验证了GFP报告模型。这使所提出的模型成为虚拟实验的有用工具，并使所开发的测试平台成为进一步工程化基于酵母的铜传感器的合适平台。理论分析进一步扩展，加入一种用于酵母的自维持生物发光报告基因，替换GFP并实现无需外部光激发的光学输出。光学响应与光电探测器模型耦合，使该系统适合集成到如智能药丸的移动监测设备中。所提出的将酵母接收器表征为铜生物传感器的研究，是在与合适的工程化益生菌发送器耦合后，朝着开发和表征用于肠道诊疗的完整端到端基于MC系统迈出的第一步。

items.title_en: Bookkeeping Is Not Judgement: EJBench, an Engineering Judgement Benchmark Built from a Conjugate Heat Transfer Design Campaign
items.title_zh: 记账并非判断：EJBench——基于共轭传热设计活动构建的工程判断基准
items.abstract_en: We introduce EJBench, a benchmark of engineering judgement: whether a model can predict how a design behaves at new conditions from a few earlier results, and decide on it. Unlike engineering benchmarks that test whether an agent can operate simulation or CAD software, EJBench is software-agnostic and asks what an engineer would conclude without running a simulation. Its tasks come from a conjugate heat transfer design campaign for battery cold plates, in three families: matching unlabelled test results to their operating points, choosing which stored runs to reveal before signing off a design, and ranking new duties by peak cell temperature. Every answer is taken from a converged simulation, not from an LLM judge. The best of ten frontier models, GPT-6 Astra, scores 0.71, and models state almost the same confidence on tasks they get wrong as on tasks they get right. We also post-train Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA and reinforcement learning, rewarded by the share of answer criteria the simulation results confirm; on the held-out test split its score rises from 0.071 to 0.106. We release the train, validation and test splits, the evaluation harness and the leaderboard.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出EJBench，一个工程判断基准：模型能否根据少量先前结果预测设计在新条件下的行为，并据此做出决定。与测试智能体能否操作仿真或CAD软件的工程基准不同，EJBench与软件无关，考察工程师在不运行仿真时会得出什么结论。其任务来自电池冷板的共轭传热设计活动，分为三类：将无标签测试结果与其工况点匹配；在批准设计前选择揭示哪些已存储运行；按峰值电芯温度对新工况排序。每个答案均取自收敛的仿真，而非LLM评判器。十个前沿模型中的最佳者GPT-6 Astra得分为0.71，并且模型在答错任务上表达的置信度几乎与答对任务相同。我们还使用LoRA和强化学习对Qwen3.5-9B进行后训练，奖励为仿真结果确认的答案标准所占比例；在留出测试集上，其得分从0.071升至0.106。我们发布训练、验证和测试划分、评估工具和排行榜。

items.title_en: CommDreamer: Radio-Geometric World Models for Mapless Cellular-Connected UAV Trajectory Planning
items.title_zh: CommDreamer：用于无地图蜂窝连接无人机轨迹规划的无线电-几何世界模型
items.abstract_en: Reliable cellular connectivity and collision-free flight are essential for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) operations in low-altitude urban canyons, where dense 3D buildings obstruct flight clearance, shadow serving base stations, and create strong co-channel interference at street intersections. Existing planners either require prior 3D city meshes and channel knowledge maps unavailable onboard, or rely on model-free reinforcement learning with low sample efficiency and poor cross-city generalization. We propose CommDreamer, a mapless radio-geometric world model that fuses raw onboard 3D LiDAR scans, multicell cellular reports, and shift-invariant relative kinematics to jointly infer local obstacle clearance and directional signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) dynamics. Using a categorical recurrent state-space model, CommDreamer compresses multimodal measurement histories into a coordinate-invariant latent belief, enabling the UAV to foresee deep shadow zones and train a lightweight online policy purely via multi-step latent imagination without prior maps or antenna patterns. Zero-shot evaluations across unseen urban morphologies in our open-source ray-tracing simulator, AeroCity-RT, show that CommDreamer converges within 150 episodes where model-free reinforcement learning fails to complete flights, achieving 100.0% mission success with zero collisions while lifting median route SINR to 8.02 dB and cutting effective SINR outage by over 50% relative to radio-blind world-model and reactive LiDAR baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 可靠的蜂窝连接和无碰撞飞行对于无人机（UAV）在低空城市峡谷中运行至关重要；在那里，密集的3D建筑阻碍飞行净空，遮挡服务基站，并在街道交叉口产生强烈的同信道干扰。现有规划器要么需要先验的3D城市网格和机载不可用的信道知识地图，要么依赖无模型强化学习，而后者样本效率低且跨城市泛化差。我们提出CommDreamer，一种无地图无线电-几何世界模型，它融合原始机载3D LiDAR扫描、多小区蜂窝报告和平移不变的相对运动学，以联合推断局部障碍物净空和方向性信号与干扰加噪声比（SINR）动态。CommDreamer使用分类循环状态空间模型，将多模态测量历史压缩为坐标不变的潜在信念，使无人机能够预见深度阴影区，并纯粹通过多步潜在想象训练轻量级在线策略，而无需先验地图或天线方向图。在我们开源射线追踪模拟器AeroCity-RT中，对未见城市形态的零样本评估表明，CommDreamer在150个回合内收敛，而无模型强化学习无法完成飞行；它实现了100.0%的任务成功率和零碰撞，同时将路线SINR中位数提升至8.02 dB，并将有效SINR中断相对于无线电盲世界模型和反应式LiDAR基线降低超过50%。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化一个底层的连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用一个全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续的5维坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与视角相关的发射辐射亮度。我们通过沿相机光线查询5维坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组具有已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了在神经渲染和视图合成方面优于先前工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Long-read metagenomics reveals unexplored viral diversity andgenomic novelty in the mesopelagic Andaman Sea
items.title_zh: 长读长宏基因组学揭示安达曼海中层带未探索的病毒多样性与基因组新颖性
items.abstract_en: The mesopelagic zone (200 to 1000 m) of the ocean represents Earth's largest yet most underexplored biome, particularly with respect to viral diversity and function. The deep-sea virome of the Indian Ocean remains largely unexplored despite the ecological significance of marine viruses in regulating microbial mortality, biogeochemical cycling and carbon flux via the viral shunt. In this study, we explored the diversity of DNA viruses across mesopelagic depths in the Andaman Sea. Seawater samples collected from multiple depths were enriched for viral particles, followed by viral DNA extraction and long-read metagenomic sequencing using Oxford Nanopore Technologies. We used three complementary approaches for the identification of assembled contigs of viruses. Based on the consensus from these three approaches followed by quality assessment, we retained 1,604 viral contigs of high-confidence and high-quality. Among the taxonomically assigned viruses, members of the class Caudoviricetes dominated across all samples. The assignment decreased substantially at lower taxonomic ranks, highlighting the limited representation of environmental viruses in existing reference databases. Gene-sharing network analysis further revealed genomic novelty and showing limited gene-sharing relationships with reference genomes. Host prediction analyses assigned putative hosts to 10.7% of viral contigs, of which 98.3% were associated with bacteria and 1.7% with archaea. Among predicted bacterial hosts, Pseudomonadota predominated. Structure-informed functional annotation of complete viral contigs identified predominantly structural and tail-associated proteins, while a substantial proportion of viral proteins remained functionally uncharacterized. Collectively, these findings reveal previously under-explored viral diversity in the mesopelagic Andaman Sea study and provide the first comprehensive insight into the deep-ocean virome of this region.
items.abstract_zh: 海洋中层带（200 至 1000 米）是地球上最大但最未充分探索的生物群系，尤其在病毒多样性和功能方面。尽管海洋病毒在调节微生物死亡、生物地球化学循环以及通过病毒分流影响碳通量方面具有生态意义，印度洋深海病毒组在很大程度上仍未被探索。本研究探索了安达曼海中层带不同深度的 DNA 病毒多样性。从多个深度采集海水样品，富集病毒颗粒，随后提取病毒 DNA 并使用 Oxford Nanopore Technologies 进行长读长宏基因组测序。我们采用三种互补方法识别组装的病毒 contig。基于三种方法的一致结果并进行质量评估，我们保留了 1,604 个高置信度和高质量的病毒 contig。在可分类的病毒中，Caudoviricetes 纲成员在所有样品中占主导。随着分类等级降低，注释比例显著下降，突显出现有参考数据库中环境病毒代表性有限。基因共享网络分析进一步揭示了基因组新颖性，并显示与参考基因组的基因共享关系有限。宿主预测分析为 10.7% 的病毒 contig 分配了推定宿主，其中 98.3% 与细菌相关，1.7% 与古菌相关。在预测的细菌宿主中，Pseudomonadota 占主导。对完整病毒 contig 的结构信息功能注释主要鉴定出结构蛋白和尾部相关蛋白，而相当一部分病毒蛋白仍未获得功能表征。总体而言，这些发现揭示了安达曼海中层带研究中此前未被充分探索的病毒多样性，并首次提供了对该区域深海病毒组的全面认识。

items.title_en: Magnon high-harmonic generation by nonlinearities of spin torque driven by phonon-mediated crossing of many-body energy levels of bright and dark excitons
items.title_zh: 由声子介导的亮激子和暗激子多体能级交叉驱动的自旋力矩非线性产生磁振子高次谐波
items.abstract_en: Recent intense experimental focus on CrSBr, a two-dimensional (2D) antiferromagnetic semiconductor, has revealed numerous surprises in its response to ultrafast optical drive. We demonstrate that a single microscopic mechanism accounts for two of them---high-harmonic generation of magnons and persistence of magnon oscillations over \mbox{$\sim 1$ ns} time scale that is much longer than the femtosecond laser pulse (fsLP) pump duration. This mechanism arises from an unusually complex interplay of four different fundamental quasiparticles of condensed matter physics: magnons, optically bright and dark excitons, and phonons. By viewing magnons as the system and the other three quasiparticles as a quantum many-body bath, we derive an extended Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (eLLG) equation. Its new term generated by the bath is spatially nonlocal and time-dependent, as well as strongly {\em nonlinear} when the {\em crossing of many-body energy levels} of bright and dark excitons occurs via phonon mediation. It also resembles the so-called field-like spin-transfer torque (STT) in spintronics, but STT is driven there with current pulses, so it explains the microscopic origin of the recently experimentally conjectured {\em excitonic STT}. Since dark excitons supply energy to magnons long after the fsLP is switched off, such a reservoir opens avenues for its engineering and applications in optospintronics and optomagnonics, neuromorphic computing, and quantum transduction.
items.abstract_zh: 近期对二维（2D）反铁磁半导体 CrSBr 的大量实验研究揭示，其在超快光驱动下的响应存在许多意外现象。我们证明，单一微观机制可解释其中两个现象——磁振子高次谐波产生，以及磁振子振荡在约 1 ns 时间尺度上的持续，该时间尺度远长于飞秒激光脉冲（fsLP）泵浦持续时间。该机制源于凝聚态物理中四种不同基本准粒子之间异常复杂的相互作用：磁振子、光学亮激子和暗激子以及声子。通过将磁振子视为系统、将另外三种准粒子视为量子多体浴，我们推导出扩展的 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（eLLG）方程。由该浴产生的新项具有空间非局域性和时间依赖性，并且当亮激子和暗激子的多体能级交叉通过声子介导发生时，该项呈强非线性。它还类似于自旋电子学中所谓的类场自旋转移矩（STT），但 STT 在自旋电子学中由电流脉冲驱动，因此它解释了近期实验上推测的激子 STT 的微观起源。由于暗激子在 fsLP 关闭很久之后仍向磁振子提供能量，这种储库为光自旋电子学和光磁子学、神经形态计算以及量子换能中的工程与应用开辟了途径。

items.title_en: From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening
items.title_zh: 从基准到实验台：双向药物-靶点筛选中的偏好、对应性与选择性
items.abstract_en: Identifying active molecules for known targets and potential targets for existing drugs is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Drug-target interaction (DTI) models can rank vast numbers of drug-target pairs, but limited experimental capacity restricts testing to a small number of candidates. We compared the bidirectional recommendations of 13 released systems across 711 molecular structures of FDA-approved drugs and 614 human proteins. For the same target or drug, pairs of models produced completely disjoint Top-10 molecule and protein lists in 77.8% and 70.1% of comparisons, respectively. Even where recommendations overlapped, agreement between some systems largely reflected recurring preferences for the same candidates. Published inhibition measurements for 79 molecules and 65 kinases revealed that some systems enriched active candidates, yet their hit yields changed little when recommendations were matched to different drugs or targets, whereas other systems lost substantially more hits. Some of the former systems also rarely ranked both molecules and kinases correctly when two drugs favoured different kinases. We further retrained the same architecture on the same data, with the training objective fixed and random seeds varied. Despite similar test performance, mean pairwise Top-10 overlap on a separate screening catalogue was about two candidates. Our study moves DTI model evaluation beyond benchmark performance to assess whether model predictions can guide meaningful experimental decisions in drug discovery and target identification.
items.abstract_zh: 为已知靶点识别活性分子、为现有药物识别潜在靶点是药物发现和药物重定位的核心。药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）模型可对大量药物-靶点对进行排序，但有限的实验能力限制只能测试少量候选。我们比较了 13 个已发布系统在 711 个 FDA 批准药物的分子结构和 614 种人类蛋白质上的双向推荐。对于同一靶点或药物，模型对在分别 77.8% 和 70.1% 的比较中产生完全不相交的 Top-10 分子和蛋白质列表。即使推荐存在重叠，某些系统之间的一致性很大程度上反映了对相同候选物的反复偏好。已发表的 79 个分子和 65 种激酶的抑制测量显示，一些系统富集了活性候选物，但当推荐匹配到不同药物或靶点时，其命中产率变化很小，而另一些系统丢失的命中显著更多。前者中的一些系统在两个药物偏好不同激酶时，也很少能同时正确排序分子和激酶。我们进一步在相同数据上重新训练同一架构，固定训练目标并改变随机种子。尽管测试性能相似，在单独筛选目录上的平均成对 Top-10 重叠约为两个候选物。本研究将 DTI 模型评估从基准性能推进到评估模型预测能否在药物发现和靶点识别中指导有意义的实验决策。

items.title_en: Seeing Isn't Resolving: Visual and Linguistic Disambiguation with Conversational Grounding
items.title_zh: 看见并不等于消解：基于对话接地的视觉与语言消歧
items.abstract_en: Visual grounding benchmarks usually do not consider the contextual uncertainty of real-world scenarios. In this study, we construct a novel benchmark, the Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D) dataset. It consists of human-robot conversational multimodal interactions covering different types of ambiguity, arising from visual and linguistic categories. We evaluate the capabilities of different state-of-the-art Visual Language Models (VLMs) for ambiguity recognition and resolution. We compare dialogue context grounding performance for visual and linguistic ambiguity resolution. Our experiments show that VLMs can substantially improve the resolution of linguistic ambiguity, especially Japanese zero anaphora, by using dialogue context. We further conduct a comparative analysis to understand whether grounding improvements arise from the semantic content of the dialogue or from its conversational structure.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉接地基准通常不考虑真实世界场景中的语境不确定性。在本研究中，我们构建了一个新基准，即面向歧义视觉接地的日语对话评估（JAG-D）数据集。它由人机对话多模态交互组成，涵盖由视觉和语言类别产生的不同类型歧义。我们评估不同最先进的视觉语言模型（VLM）在歧义识别与消解方面的能力。我们比较对话语境接地在视觉歧义消解和语言歧义消解上的表现。实验表明，VLM 可以通过使用对话语境显著改善语言歧义的消解，尤其是日语零回指。我们进一步进行比较分析，以理解接地的改进是来自对话的语义内容还是其对话结构。

items.title_en: Meaning Reaches Object Choice but Not Completion: Where Is a VLA Vulnerable to Landmark Synonyms?
items.title_zh: 语义能影响物体选择，却不能影响任务完成：VLA在何处易受地标同义词影响？
items.abstract_en: VLA policies are fragile to rewording. Success rates alone cannot say whether a policy fails to choose the object or to complete the task, nor where in the policy to intervene. We study the released GR00T N1.7 on two LIBERO-Spatial tasks differing only in the landmark word telling which of two bowls to take. Synonyms absent from the training instructions send the policy to the bowl they name, unlike made-up words, yet complete 67.6% of one task's closed-loop episodes, against the original word's 100%. Before the connector between the vision-language model and the action generator, replacing only the landmark tokens' vectors with the other landmark's (pasting) sends nearly every episode to the other bowl. After the connector, pasting at the landmark, the remaining instruction, or the image tokens alone rarely moves the choice, but any two do. Hiding the landmark tokens from the action generator after the connector still lowers completion for the synonyms that fall short. Finetuning on diversified landmark words repairs that one task's completion for synonyms absent from finetuning; finetuning on the original instructions does not. Training only the connector on the diversified words suffices, as does copying the connector of a policy fully finetuned on them into one finetuned on the original instructions. An open-loop score on starting frames misses that weights outside the connector also carry part of the repair. For now, on this evidence, robustness to rewording should be judged in closed loop, with actions executed, intervening on both sides of the connector, scoring choice and completion separately.
items.abstract_zh: VLA策略对措辞变化很脆弱。仅凭成功率无法判断策略是未能选择物体还是未能完成任务，也无法判断应在策略的何处进行干预。我们研究已发布的GR00T N1.7，在仅在地标词上不同的两个LIBERO-Spatial任务上，该词指示取两个碗中的哪一个。训练指令中未出现的同义词会使策略前往其命名的碗，这一点与生造词不同，但在一个任务的闭环回合中完成率为67.6%，而原始词为100%。在视觉-语言模型与动作生成器之间的连接器之前，仅将地标token的向量替换为另一地标的向量（粘贴），会使几乎每个回合都前往另一个碗。在连接器之后，单独在地标、剩余指令或图像token处粘贴很少改变选择，但任意两处同时粘贴会改变。在连接器之后向动作生成器隐藏地标token，仍会降低那些表现不佳的同义词的完成率。在多样化地标词上微调可修复该任务中未参与微调的同义词的完成率；在原始指令上微调则不能。仅在多样化词上训练连接器就足够；将完全在多样化词上微调的策略的连接器复制到在原始指令上微调的策略中同样足够。对起始帧的开环评分会遗漏连接器之外的权重也承担了部分修复作用。目前，基于这些证据，对措辞变化的鲁棒性应在闭环中评判，执行动作，在连接器两侧进行干预，并分别对选择和完成评分。

items.title_en: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
items.title_zh: Game2Player：通过环境-玩家协同开发为视觉智能体扩展游戏体验
items.abstract_en: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions. Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifiable outcomes. To address these gaps, we introduce Game2Player, a framework that co-develops game environments and players to collect diverse and verifiable gameplay experience at scale. In the Game2Player loop, a Builder agent adapts existing web games, exposes their internal state, and defines tasks with state-based progress measures and success checks. A Coding Player and a VLM Player then attempt the tasks and report problems to the Builder for repair, so that play serves as both environment validation and training data collection. With Game2Player, we build 568 verified web games with 3,436 tasks, collect 15.7K trajectories (307 hours of gameplay), and hold out 50 games as the benchmark PlayerBench. To evaluate the collected experience as training data, we train VLM agents with progress-weighted SFT, assigning greater weight to steps that advance task progress. Game2Player-9B improves progress from 14.3% to 31.2% on PlayerBench and from 30.0% to 53.1% on the external GameWorld benchmark. More broadly, our work suggests a path for visual agents to scale their gameplay experience by building, verifying, and learning from existing game worlds.
items.abstract_zh: 游戏为视觉智能体提供了丰富的测试平台，要求感知、长时程规划和精确控制。然而，收集人类游戏玩法成本高昂，而从游戏视频中学习需要推断缺失的动作。现有数据集覆盖的游戏范围也有限，通常没有明确任务或可验证结果。为弥补这些空白，我们提出 Game2Player，一个协同开发游戏环境和玩家的框架，以大规模收集多样且可验证的游戏体验。在 Game2Player 循环中，Builder 智能体适配现有网页游戏，暴露其内部状态，并定义带有基于状态的进度度量和成功检查的任务。随后，Coding Player 和 VLM Player 尝试这些任务，并向 Builder 报告问题以供修复，从而使游玩同时服务于环境验证和训练数据收集。借助 Game2Player，我们构建了 568 个经过验证的网页游戏，包含 3,436 个任务，收集了 15.7K 条轨迹（307 小时游戏时长），并留出 50 个游戏作为基准 PlayerBench。为评估所收集体验作为训练数据的效果，我们使用进度加权 SFT 训练 VLM 智能体，对推进任务进度的步骤赋予更大权重。Game2Player-9B 在 PlayerBench 上将进度从 14.3% 提升到 31.2%，在外部 GameWorld 基准上从 30.0% 提升到 53.1%。更广泛地，我们的工作为视觉智能体通过构建、验证并从现有游戏世界学习来扩展其游戏体验提供了一条路径。

items.title_en: Within- and transgenerational plasticity evolve separately in a thermally adapted ectotherm
items.title_zh: 在热适应的外温动物中，同代可塑性与跨代可塑性分别演化
items.abstract_en: Climate change is imposing strong selection pressures on many wild populations, forcing them to adapt or face extinction. Conservation biology attempts to predict evolutionary responses to inform management but is hampered by a poor understanding of how variation arises. For many populations, responses to warming may rely substantially upon phenotypic plasticity, with cues from parental and offspring environments shaping development. However, how information from the environment, the genome, and the epigenome interacts to produce phenotypic variation is poorly understood. We investigated these factors, and their interactions, by using Icelandic populations of threespine stickleback (Gasterosteus aculeatus) that have adapted to geothermal warming. Using a split-temperature F1 to F2 hybrid cross, a novel morphometric approach, and reduced representation bisulphite sequencing, we elucidated the genetic architecture of transgenerational plasticity (TGP), within-generation plasticity (WGP), and that of morphological and methylation variation. This revealed that TGP and WGP have distinct genetic architectures involving different biological functions. The genetic architecture of traits was strongly influenced by both the parental and offspring thermal environments, potentially exposing different genetic variation to selection. Finally, we showed that TGP is favoured by selection and driven by the exposure of allelic variation by methylation. Our results suggested that predicting climate change responses should move beyond assessments of standing genetic variation to understand how TGP, WGP and the environment interact. More broadly, these findings improve our understanding of the processes that generate variation during adaptive divergence.
items.abstract_zh: 气候变化正对许多野生种群施加强烈的选择压力，迫使它们适应或面临灭绝。保护生物学试图预测进化响应以为管理提供信息，但由于对变异如何产生了解不足而受到阻碍。对于许多种群，对变暖的响应可能很大程度上依赖于表型可塑性，亲代和子代环境中的线索塑造发育。然而，来自环境、基因组和表观基因组的信息如何相互作用以产生表型变异仍知之甚少。我们通过使用已适应地热变暖的冰岛三刺鱼（Gasterosteus aculeatus）种群，研究了这些因素及其相互作用。利用分温度F1至F2杂交、一种新的形态计量方法以及简化代表性亚硫酸氢盐测序，我们阐明了跨代可塑性（TGP）、同代可塑性（WGP）以及形态和甲基化变异的遗传结构。这揭示出TGP和WGP具有涉及不同生物学功能的独特遗传结构。性状的遗传结构受到亲代和子代热环境的强烈影响，可能使不同的遗传变异暴露于选择。最后，我们表明TGP受到选择青睐，并由甲基化暴露等位基因变异所驱动。我们的结果提示，预测气候变化响应应超越对现有遗传变异的评估，以理解TGP、WGP和环境如何相互作用。更广泛地说，这些发现增进了我们对适应性分化过程中产生变异过程的理解。

items.title_en: From power to spectrum: an off-the-shelf photodiode turned into a spectrometer by its bias alone
items.title_zh: 从功率到光谱：仅凭偏置将现成光电二极管变为光谱仪
items.abstract_en: Computational spectrometers replace dispersive optics with detectors whose spectral response can be varied, but every reported single-detector device obtains this response through dedicated fabrication: two-dimensional heterostructures, graded epitaxial junctions, organic stacks, filters or photonic circuits. We demonstrate a generic, fabrication-free alternative in which a standard commercial photodiode becomes a spectrometer through its electrical drive alone, requiring no modification of the device, no optical filter and no modulation of the light. The mechanism is bias-modulated optoelectronic chromatic dispersion (OED): light of different wavelengths is absorbed at different depths, and a sinusoidal bias changes how carriers generated at each depth are collected, so that every spectrum is encoded in the shape of the photocurrent waveform over one bias period. Applied to an unmodified InGaAs PIN photodiode at room temperature, a 10 us waveform decoded by a neural network reconstructs spectra of one to three laser lines across the 80 nm of the telecom C+L band, locating the lines to 0.3-0.4 nm, counting them in about 99% of measurements and identifying their power levels, with line shifts tracked to tens of picometres. Because OED relies on universal semiconductor transport physics, the approach is material-agnostic and applies in principle to any off-the-shelf photodiode, turning detectors already deployed as power monitors into low-cost spectral sensors.
items.abstract_zh: 计算光谱仪用光谱响应可变的探测器取代色散光学，但已报道的每种单探测器器件都通过专门制造来获得这种响应：二维异质结构、梯度外延结、有机叠层、滤光片或光子电路。我们展示了一种通用且无需制造的替代方案：标准商用光电二极管仅通过其电驱动即可成为光谱仪，无需改造器件、无需光学滤光片、也无需对光进行调制。其机制是偏置调制光电色散（OED）：不同波长的光在不同深度被吸收，正弦偏置改变每个深度产生的载流子被收集的方式，因此每个光谱被编码在一个偏置周期内光电流波形的形状中。将该方法用于室温下未修改的 InGaAs PIN 光电二极管，由神经网络解码 10 μs 波形，可在 80 nm 的电信 C+L 波段上重建一到三条激光线的光谱，将谱线定位到 0.3–0.4 nm，在约 99% 的测量中对谱线计数并识别其功率水平，谱线漂移可追踪到数十皮米。由于 OED 依赖通用的半导体输运物理，该方法与材料无关，原则上适用于任何现成光电二极管，可将已部署为功率监测器的探测器转变为低成本光谱传感器。

items.title_en: Predicting Surface Displacement Fields of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Parts Using STL-Derived Graphs and Part-Level Descriptors
items.title_zh: 利用 STL 派生图和零件级描述符预测激光粉末床熔融零件的表面位移场
items.abstract_en: Predicting part distortion before fabrication remains challenging in laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), while thermomechanical simulation is computationally expensive for repeated design evaluations. This study presents a two-branch graph attention network (GAT) to predict three-dimensional surface displacement directly from STL-derived graphs. The first branch learns geometric relationships among connected vertices of a densified STL surface mesh, while the second incorporates 12 part-level descriptors of mass distribution, build-plate contact, overhang, size, and shape. Displacement labels from ANSYS Additive Print simulations are mapped onto STL vertices using Gaussian-kernel weighted averaging. Evaluated on 117 parts using five-fold cross-validation split by part, the model achieves an R^2 of 0.946 and a mean absolute error of 0.0178 mm for displacement magnitude. Relative to a node-wise multilayer perceptron, GAT improves R^2 from 0.913 to 0.946; for build-direction displacement, R^2 increases from 0.903 to 0.939. GAT also outperforms GraphSAGE (R^2 = 0.936) and a graph convolutional network (R^2 = 0.934) across all five folds. Ablation experiments show that removing mass-distribution descriptors reduces magnitude R^2 to 0.900, while removing build-plate contact and overhang descriptors reduces it to 0.920. These results demonstrate the value of combining local mesh connectivity with global geometric descriptors to predict LPBF distortion, enabling faster design iteration and earlier identification of distortion-prone geometries.
items.abstract_zh: 在激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）中，制造前预测零件变形仍具挑战性，而热力学仿真对于重复设计评估而言计算代价高昂。本研究提出一种双分支图注意力网络（GAT），直接从 STL 派生图预测三维表面位移。第一分支学习致密化 STL 表面网格中相连顶点之间的几何关系，第二分支纳入 12 个零件级描述符，涵盖质量分布、基板接触、悬垂、尺寸和形状。来自 ANSYS Additive Print 模拟的位移标签通过高斯核加权平均映射到 STL 顶点。在 117 个零件上使用按零件划分的五折交叉验证进行评估，模型对位移幅值达到 R^2 为 0.946，平均绝对误差为 0.0178 mm。相对于逐节点多层感知机，GAT 将 R^2 从 0.913 提高到 0.946；对于构建方向位移，R^2 从 0.903 提高到 0.939。GAT 在所有五折中也优于 GraphSAGE（R^2 = 0.936）和图卷积网络（R^2 = 0.934）。消融实验表明，移除质量分布描述符使幅值 R^2 降至 0.900，而移除基板接触和悬垂描述符使其降至 0.920。这些结果证明了将局部网格连通性与全局几何描述符相结合来预测 LPBF 变形的价值，可加快设计迭代并更早识别易变形几何结构。

items.title_en: General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models
items.title_zh: 通用进展可替代语言模型中的特定训练数据
items.abstract_en: Language models acquire their capabilities from training data, and developers withhold data during training to keep models from learning capabilities that could be misused. How long this delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later, is unknown. Here we show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the data that was withheld. We withheld the training signal for individual skills in models of chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text. The delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When models were then trained on the withheld data, they acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and this fraction decreased as the models progressed. A control rule of equal difficulty was learned much more slowly. A programming language withheld from the training text of a 7-billion-parameter model was regained in the same way. Data filtering therefore delays a capability, and the data required to regain it decreases as models improve.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型从训练数据中获得能力，而开发者在训练期间保留数据，以防止模型学习可能被滥用的能力。这会延迟一种能力多久，以及之后获得该能力需要多少数据，尚不清楚。在这里我们表明，模型在其其余训练数据上取得的通用进展可替代被保留的数据。我们在国际象棋、黑白棋、分子字符串、括号语言和网页文本模型中保留了个体技能的训练信号。较大模型中保留技能的延迟可由较小模型预测。一个从未明确训练响应将军的国际象棋模型，对合法应对的排序几乎与一个经过此类训练的模型一样好。当随后在保留数据上训练模型时，它们仅需从初始化开始所需数据的一小部分就获得了该技能，并且这一比例随着模型进展而下降。一个同等难度的对照规则学习得慢得多。一个从70亿参数模型的训练文本中保留的编程语言也以同样方式被重新获得。因此，数据过滤会延迟一种能力，而随着模型改进，重新获得该能力所需的数据减少。

items.title_en: Arboreus: A Realistic Boreal Forest Simulator with Topographic Terrain and Satellite-Informed Parametric Tree Distributions
items.title_zh: Arboreus：一种具有地形与卫星信息参数化树木分布的真实北方森林模拟器
items.abstract_en: This work presents Arboreus, a realistic Boreal forest simulator, developed to support statistical validation of robotic autonomy algorithms in Boreal forest environments. Arboreus presents an automated methodology for synthesizing large-scale, data-informed, plausible forest worlds from parametric trees, height-variant terrain, and satellite-informed tree density distributions. The parametric generation of dominant Boreal tree species such as Birch, Spruce, and Pine is guided by trunk, canopy, and foliage parameters, extracted from growth studies in the Nordic areas. Tree distribution in an area of interest is guided by the Copernicus satellite dataset, which provides tree cover density and dominant species type at up to 10m raster resolution. The forest floor generation is guided by topographic data from the Swedish cadastral agency to produce realistic data-informed terrains. Given coordinates and extents of forested areas of interest, Arboreus synthesizes data-informed plausible forests, while offering flexibility to inject user observations of real forests (detail, age, dimensionality and tree count), which is critical for realistic synthetic data generation and for the testing of feature-sensitive autonomy algorithms. The applicability of Arboreus for benchmarking and validation of robot autonomy for different robot mobilities is demonstrated in Gazebosim, Unreal Engine, and Isaac Sim physics engines. The applicability of Arboreus as a source of synthetic forest data and its potential to support downstream forest resource mapping research (volume estimation, tree instance segmentation and stem attribute estimation) is also demonstrated. Arboreus has been open-sourced along with a dataset comprising 25 Boreal forest worlds of size 1000m2 corresponding to three real forest sites.
items.abstract_zh: 这项工作提出Arboreus，一种真实的北方森林模拟器，旨在支持北方森林环境中机器人自主算法的统计验证。Arboreus提出一种自动化方法，用于从参数化树木、高度变化地形和卫星信息树木密度分布合成大规模、数据驱动、可信的森林世界。诸如桦树、云杉和松树等优势北方树种的参数化生成，由从北欧地区生长研究中提取的树干、树冠和枝叶参数指导。感兴趣区域内的树木分布由Copernicus卫星数据集指导，该数据集提供最高10米栅格分辨率的树木覆盖密度和优势树种类型。林地地面生成由瑞典地籍局的地形数据指导，以生成真实的数据驱动地形。给定感兴趣森林区域的坐标和范围，Arboreus合成数据驱动的可信森林，同时提供灵活性以注入用户对真实森林的观察（细节、年龄、维度和树木数量），这对于真实合成数据生成和测试特征敏感的自主算法至关重要。Arboreus在不同机器人移动能力的机器人自主性基准测试和验证中的适用性，在Gazebosim、Unreal Engine和Isaac Sim物理引擎中得到演示。Arboreus作为合成森林数据来源的适用性，及其支持下游森林资源制图研究（体积估计、树木实例分割和树干属性估计）的潜力也得到演示。Arboreus已开源，并附带一个数据集，包含25个大小为1000平方米的北方森林世界，对应三个真实森林地点。
