items.title_en: Deterministic Temporal Embedding for Calcium Imaging Trace Extraction
items.title_zh: 用于钙成像迹线提取的确定性时间嵌入
items.abstract_en: Reliable extraction of calcium-dependent fluorescence traces in calcium imaging sequences requires identifying pixels whose fluorescence intensity reflects the same underlying cellular activity. We present a deterministic temporal embedding framework that maps pixel-wise fluorescence traces to a low-dimensional representation in which temporally coherent sources form spatially coherent regions. Starting from a fuzzy-neighborhood graph and spectral initialization, we optimize a class-balanced cross-entropy objective using exact sparse attraction and a deterministic particle-mesh decomposition of the dense repulsive interaction with sparse edge compensation, avoiding stochastic negative sampling. The resulting latent representation is spatially decoded into reliable source supports for trace extraction without imposing an explicit cellular shape prior. Experiments on synthetic and in vivo two-photon calcium imaging data demonstrate robust recovery of irregular and spatially touching sources together with efficient deterministic embedding optimization.
items.abstract_zh: 在钙成像序列中可靠提取钙依赖性荧光迹线，需要识别荧光强度反映同一 underlying 细胞活动的像素。我们提出一种确定性时间嵌入框架，将逐像素荧光迹线映射到低维表示，其中时间上相干的源形成空间上相干的区域。从模糊邻域图和谱初始化开始，我们使用精确稀疏吸引以及带稀疏边补偿的稠密排斥相互作用的确定性粒子-网格分解，优化类别平衡交叉熵目标，避免随机负采样。所得潜在表示被空间解码为用于迹线提取的可靠源支撑，而不施加显式细胞形状先验。在合成和体内双光子钙成像数据上的实验表明，该方法能稳健恢复不规则和空间接触的源，并实现高效的确定性嵌入优化。

items.title_en: BPEA integrates pleiotropy and epistasis to guide allele pyramiding for multi-trait crop improvement
items.title_zh: BPEA整合多效性与上位性以指导多性状作物改良的等位基因聚合
items.abstract_en: Dissecting the genetic basis of complex traits and pyramiding favorable alleles are central to crop breeding. However, jointly evaluating pleiotropy and epistasis to identify allele combinations that meet multiple breeding objectives remains challenging. Here, we present BPEA (Bayesian Pleiotropy and Epistasis Analysis), a Bayesian framework integrating LD-guided QTL interval identification, joint genetic inference and allele-combination assessment. BPEA uses the joint posterior to estimate the posterior probability of simultaneous improvement (PPSI) between allele combinations and ranks them by mean PPSI. In simulations, BPEA improved interval identification and epistatic interaction attribution relative to comparator methods and maintained high precision in shared-signal detection. When epistasis was present, it reduced mean combination-selection regret by 68.4-86.3% relative to a model without interaction terms. Applications to three rapeseed populations identified shared genetic signals and candidate epistatic interactions associated with seed-quality traits. BPEA also prioritized allele combinations for simultaneous reductions in erucic acid and glucosinolate contents and identified complementary parents for cross design. BPEA thus provides a framework for genetic dissection and genomics-guided crop improvement.
items.abstract_zh: 解析复杂性状的遗传基础并聚合有利等位基因是作物育种的核心。然而，联合评估多效性与上位性以识别满足多个育种目标的等位基因组合仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出 BPEA（贝叶斯多效性与上位性分析），这是一个整合 LD 引导的 QTL 区间识别、联合遗传推断和等位基因组合评估的贝叶斯框架。BPEA 使用联合后验来估计等位基因组合之间同时改良的后验概率（PPSI），并按平均 PPSI 对其进行排序。在模拟中，BPEA 相对于比较方法改善了区间识别和上位性交互归因，并在共享信号检测中保持高精度。当存在上位性时，相对于没有交互项的模型，它将平均组合选择遗憾降低了 68.4–86.3%。应用于三个油菜群体，识别出与种子品质性状相关的共享遗传信号和候选上位性交互。BPEA 还优先选择了可同时降低芥酸和硫苷含量的等位基因组合，并识别出用于杂交设计的互补亲本。因此，BPEA 为遗传解析和基因组学指导的作物改良提供了框架。

items.title_en: Hamiltonian Stabilization of the Two-Photon Dicke Model
items.title_zh: 双光子 Dicke 模型的哈密顿量稳定化
items.abstract_en: Collective two-photon light--matter interactions enable pair amplification but can destroy spectral confinement, preventing a stable thermodynamic bright phase. We show that a positive Kac-scaled number-Kerr interaction renders the two-photon Dicke Hamiltonian of \(N\) emitters lower-bounded at all couplings while preserving its generalized \(\mathbb Z_4\) symmetry. We determine the exact zero-temperature thermodynamic energy density with \(O(N^{-1})\) finite-size control and obtain the global phase diagram. A bright minimum is born at a saddle-node and exchanges global stability with the normal minimum at coexistence, producing a discontinuous photon-density jump. Symmetry-resolved exact diagonalization through \(N=128\) supports the predicted density jump and an exponentially closing same-sector normal--bright tunneling gap. Spectral collapse thus becomes the singular zero-Kerr point of a first-order phase diagram, identifying a Hamiltonian route to stabilizing pair amplification.
items.abstract_zh: 集体双光子光-物质相互作用可实现配对放大，但可能破坏光谱约束，阻止稳定的热力学亮相。我们表明，正的 Kac 标度 number-Kerr 相互作用使 N 个发射体的双光子 Dicke 哈密顿量在所有耦合下都有下界，同时保留其广义 ℤ4 对称性。我们确定了具有 O(N⁻¹) 有限尺寸控制的精确零温热力学能量密度，并获得全局相图。亮相极小值在鞍结处诞生，并在共存时与正常相极小值交换全局稳定性，产生不连续的光子密度跳变。通过 N=128 的对称性分辨精确对角化支持了预测的密度跳变以及指数关闭的同扇区正常–亮相隧穿能隙。因此，光谱坍缩成为一阶相图的奇异零 Kerr 点，确定了一条稳定配对放大的哈密顿量路径。

items.title_en: Scalable fault vulnerability analysis for ReRAM-based process-in-memory CNN accelerators
items.title_zh: 面向基于 ReRAM 的内存计算 CNN 加速器的可扩展故障脆弱性分析
items.abstract_en: Resistive random-access memory (ReRAM)-based processing-in-memory (PIM) accelerators offer a highly efficient platform for parallel matrix-vector multiplications (VMM) in neural networks, leveraging analog computation, high density, low leakage, and non-volatility. However, their susceptibility to permanent faults, such as stuck-at-high (\textit{SaH}) and stuck-at-low (\textit{SaL}) resistance states, permanently corrupts the convolutional neural networks (CNNs) weights mapped onto ReRAM cell conductance values, thereby degrading inference accuracy and leading to system unreliability in safety-critical applications. Fault injection is a commonly used technique to assess the vulnerability of neural networks by systematically injecting faults into individual parameters and measuring the resulting accuracy degradation. Although this method is accurate, it is prohibitively time-consuming and computationally expensive, especially for large-scale CNNs. In this paper, we propose a fast, scalable, and analytical framework to quantify the fault vulnerability of convolutional neural networks deployed on ReRAM-based PIM accelerators. This method quantifies vulnerability at different granularities, including weights, kernels, and layers, without the need for exhaustive simulation, enabling the design of fault-tolerant accelerators for edge and safety-critical applications. The comparison between the results of the proposed vulnerability score (VS) metrics with performance metric of CNNs captured with fault injection simulations confirms the effectiveness of our proposed method. Unlike exhaustive fault injection, which requires days or weeks, whereas the proposed approach achieves a speedup of about $10^4\times-10^5\times$, enabling fast and accurate vulnerability analysis for large-scale CNNs within only a few minutes or hours.
items.abstract_zh: 基于阻变随机存取存储器（ReRAM）的内存计算（PIM）加速器利用模拟计算、高密度、低泄漏和非易失性，为神经网络中的并行矩阵-向量乘法（VMM）提供了高效平台。然而，它们易受永久性故障影响，例如高阻态（SaH）和低阻态（SaL）电阻状态，这些故障会永久损坏映射到 ReRAM 单元电导值上的卷积神经网络（CNN）权重，从而降低推理精度，并导致安全关键应用中的系统不可靠性。故障注入是一种常用技术，通过系统地向单个参数注入故障并测量由此产生的精度下降来评估神经网络脆弱性。尽管该方法准确，但其耗时且计算代价高昂，尤其对于大规模 CNN。本文提出一种快速、可扩展的分析框架，用于量化部署在基于 ReRAM 的 PIM 加速器上的卷积神经网络的故障脆弱性。该方法在不同粒度上量化脆弱性，包括权重、卷积核和层，无需穷举仿真，从而能够为边缘和安全关键应用设计容错加速器。所提出的脆弱性得分（VS）指标结果与通过故障注入仿真获得的 CNN 性能指标的比较，证实了所提方法的有效性。与需要数天或数周的穷举故障注入不同，所提方法实现了约 10^4×–10^5× 的加速，使得仅在数分钟或数小时内即可对大规模 CNN 进行快速而准确的脆弱性分析。

items.title_en: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
items.title_zh: 快速思考，随处可用：为任意智能体工作流的决策点提供一个System-1
items.abstract_en: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.
items.abstract_zh: 自主LLM智能体在每一步调用大模型（System-2）会带来显著成本和延迟，即使许多中间动作只是在一小组已知候选者中选择。现有双系统智能体将此类决策卸载到轻量System-1模型，但依赖为每个环境编写的工作流专用钩子。我们提出AnyS1，一个框架，将人类编写的程序性技能（其指令自然指定选择出现的位置以及适用哪些选项）转化为共享的、领域通用的决策点来源。离线阶段，AnyS1在超过1,000个公共技能中挖掘有据可依的可枚举决策，在隔离容器内收集基于执行的轨迹状态以构建Any-DP，并使用标签平滑训练单个经过校准的4B指针System-1。运行时，编译后的工作流在一次前向传播中解决常规决策，并在置信度低于校准阈值时回退到System-2。在三个未见基准和不同的System-2模型家族上，AnyS1保持任务可靠性，同时相对于未编译的System-2智能体将回合成本降低75-91%，模型调用时间降低63-92%，并在零样本阈值迁移下保持性能。

items.title_en: Exposure-Aware Informative Path Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 基于深度强化学习的暴露感知信息路径规划
items.abstract_en: This paper addresses the finite-budget exposure-aware informative path planning (IPP) problem for a fleet of mobile sensing agents. The agents map an unknown scalar field while limiting exposure to high field intensity. Existing IPP methods optimize informativeness under motion or resource constraints, but do not address field exposure constraints. We formulate exposure-aware IPP (EA-IPP) as a scalarized bi-objective belief-state Markov decision process that trades the normalized Gaussian-process (GP) information gain against a normalized measurement-derived fleet exposure index. A parameter-shared proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework with decentralized actors and a centralized fleet critic is trained offline and evaluated on unseen fields. Across the radar, plume, and wildfire field families, the EA-IPP agent achieves the lowest GP reconstruction RMSE among the evaluated baselines while retaining D-optimal information within $10\%$ of the non-learning information baseline. The minimum field exposure is approximately $34.6\%$, $20.1\%$, and $27\%$ below the non-exposure-aware baseline for radar, plume, and wildfire, respectively.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究移动传感智能体集群的有限预算暴露感知信息路径规划（IPP）问题。智能体在绘制未知标量场的同时限制对高场强的暴露。现有 IPP 方法在运动或资源约束下优化信息量，但未处理场暴露约束。我们将暴露感知 IPP（EA-IPP）建模为标量化双目标信念状态马尔可夫决策过程，在归一化高斯过程（GP）信息增益与归一化测量导出的集群暴露指数之间进行权衡。采用参数共享的近端策略优化（PPO）框架，包含去中心化执行器和集中式集群评论家，离线训练并在未见场上评估。在雷达、羽流和野火场族中，EA-IPP 智能体在所评估基线中取得最低的 GP 重建 RMSE，同时将 D-最优信息保持在非学习信息基线的 10% 以内。对于雷达、羽流和野火，最小场暴露分别比非暴露感知基线低约 34.6%、20.1% 和 27%。

items.title_en: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
items.title_zh: StrideWorld：对交互式视频世界模型中的场景刚性与动作一致性进行基准测试
items.abstract_en: Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected. We therefore introduce StrideWorld, a benchmark whose references are fixed before the motion they judge. It evaluates scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and action consistency against the stride of each action, the camera motion of one command. The stride is measured on the model's first steps and then used to test the steps that follow, so each model is judged only against its own steps. Its measurements are validated on rendered videos with known camera motion, and its scores agree with human judgments. Across \nvideos{} videos generated by \nmodels{} open models from $140$ start views, all models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves, with offsets up to $7.3$ times those of a rigid rendering along the same camera path. Most models keep a steady pace when a single action is held. Along composed routes, several models often stall, and most completed routes end away from the positions predicted by each model's own strides. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to these positions. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips removes most of their mid-route stalls. Code, data, and a leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld.
items.abstract_zh: 交互式视频世界模型将用户命令转化为对生成场景的探索，这要求场景在相机移动时保持其三维结构，并且每个动作保持稳定的效果。现有基准大多针对与被测视频拟合得到的参考来评估这些性质，这些参考要么是从视频自身帧重建的场景，要么是以自由尺度对齐到命令路径的相机轨迹。此类参考会吸收渐进的场景形变以及节奏和路线长度的变化，因此这些误差可能未被发现。因此，我们提出 StrideWorld，其参考在被评判的运动之前就已固定。它依据起始视角的真值几何来评估场景刚性，并依据每个动作的步幅（即一条命令对应的相机运动）来评估动作一致性。步幅在模型的最初若干步上测量，然后用于检验后续步骤，因此每个模型仅依据其自身步幅被评判。其测量在具有已知相机运动的渲染视频上得到验证，其分数与人类判断一致。在由 \nvideos{} 个视频组成、由 \nmodels{} 个开源模型从 140 个起始视角生成的结果中，除一个模型外，所有模型都会在相机移动时使其场景发生形变，偏移最高达到沿同一相机路径的刚性渲染的 7.3 倍。大多数模型在保持单一动作时能维持稳定节奏。沿组合路线时，若干模型经常停滞，而且大多数完成的路线终止于偏离各模型自身步幅所预测位置的地方。只有两个按估计场景深度缩放命令的模型使大多数路线接近这些位置。在少量渲染片段上微调两个模型可消除其中途停滞的大部分情况。代码、数据和排行榜已在 https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld 公开。

items.title_en: AMBER: mapping accessible chromatin associations through barcode seed expansion
items.title_zh: AMBER：通过条形码种子扩展映射可及染色质关联
items.abstract_en: Accessible chromatin establishes higher-order regulatory structures spanning multiple spatial scales. We developed AMBER, a hydrogel-assisted approach for confined expansion of barcode seeds and subsequent recording of accessible chromatin associations. In mouse brain cells, we characterized the multi-scale regulatory organizations that accessibility alone cannot explain. We identified a subset of genomic regions enriched for inter-chromosomal interactions that also encode proteins engaged in interaction networks. These regulatory hubs are essential for neural function and help predict disease-risk loci and regulators.
items.abstract_zh: 可及染色质建立了跨越多个空间尺度的高阶调控结构。我们开发了 AMBER，一种水凝胶辅助方法，用于条形码种子的受限扩展并随后记录可及染色质关联。在小鼠脑细胞中，我们表征了仅靠可及性无法解释的多尺度调控组织。我们识别出一部分基因组区域，这些区域富集染色体间相互作用，同时也编码参与相互作用网络的蛋白质。这些调控枢纽对神经功能至关重要，并有助于预测疾病风险位点和调控因子。

items.title_en: Simulation-pretrained autoencoders versus PCA for compressing multimode fibre transmission matrices
items.title_zh: 用于压缩多模光纤传输矩阵的仿真预训练自编码器与 PCA 对比
items.abstract_en: Multimode optical fibres can image through a thin, flexible probe once their transmission matrix (TM) has been measured, but a TM is large and must be re-measured whenever the fibre moves. A compact model of feasible TMs would make storing and re-estimating them cheaper, so we ask how compactly TMs can be represented, and from how few measured TMs. Here we benchmark a permutation-equivariant autoencoder, pretrained on simulated fibres and adapted to measured TMs, against principal component analysis (PCA). At 62x compression, adapting the pretrained autoencoder with just two measured TMs reconstructs the TM of a 50um fibre well enough to focus light at 98% of the ideal enhancement, and it stays accurate when the TMs are shifted by 25 pixels or zoomed by 10%, which quickly degrades a linear basis. It is not, however, a better compressor: PCA is about ten times more accurate when fitted on all 163 real TMs (1.1% against 11.9% error on held-out TMs) and is already more accurate from ten. The autoencoder's value is as a prior when few or no real TMs exist: with none it reaches 29% error, against 91% for PCA fitted on the same simulation. Transfer to a different fibre is only partial. The most important extension, not yet tested, is to recover pixel-basis TMs from fewer measurements than a full TM, which would turn the pretrained prior from a compressor into a measurement-saving tool.
items.abstract_zh: 多模光纤一旦测量了其传输矩阵（TM），就可以通过细长柔性探针成像，但 TM 规模很大，且光纤移动时须重新测量。一个可行 TM 的紧凑模型可使存储与重新估计更便宜，因此我们探究 TM 能多紧凑地表示，以及从多少个测量 TM 中表示。本文在模拟光纤上预训练并适配到测量 TM 的置换等变自编码器与主成分分析（PCA）进行基准比较。在 62 倍压缩下，仅用两个测量 TM 对预训练自编码器进行适配，即可重建 50 μm 光纤的 TM，其聚焦光增强达到理想增强的 98%，并且在 TM 平移 25 像素或缩放 10% 时仍保持准确，而线性基在此情形下会迅速退化。然而，它并不是更好的压缩器：当用全部 163 个真实 TM 拟合时，PCA 的准确率约高十倍（在留出 TM 上误差为 1.1% 对 11.9%），并且从十个 TM 起就已更准确。自编码器的价值在于当真实 TM 很少或不存在时作为先验：在没有任何真实 TM 时，其误差达到 29%，而用相同模拟拟合的 PCA 为 91%。迁移到不同光纤只是部分有效。尚未测试的最重要扩展是从少于完整 TM 的测量中恢复像素基 TM，这将把预训练先验从压缩器转变为节省测量的工具。

items.title_en: SlotFlow-GB: A Neural Framework for Trans-Dimensional Inference of Overlapping Galactic Binaries
items.title_zh: SlotFlow-GB：用于重叠银河双星跨维推断的神经框架
items.abstract_en: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will observe the millihertz gravitational-wave sky, including millions of long-lived Galactic binaries (GBs), tens of thousands of which are expected to be individually resolvable throughout the mission's lifetime. Extracting these sources requires jointly determining their number and physical parameters from strongly overlapping signals, posing a computationally demanding trans-dimensional inference problem. We introduce SlotFlow-GB, a neural framework that constructs a learned approximation to the trans-dimensional posterior, producing a probability distribution over source multiplicity and parameter densities for individual binaries in a single evaluation, without requiring their number to be specified in advance. We demonstrate this framework using year-long LISA simulations containing up to ten binaries within a 2 $μ$Hz frequency interval, focusing on a high-SNR regime in which source overlap, rather than individual-source detectability, is the primary challenge. The inferred source count differs from the true count by at most one in 94% of cases, while the model identifies individual binaries even when their signals overlap strongly in frequency. A complete evaluation, including parameter sampling, takes just 41 ms per band on one NVIDIA GH200 GPU, or 530 ms on eight laptop CPU threads. We further demonstrate that these distributions can be used to initialize subsequent likelihood-based inference, connecting fast amortized predictions with joint parameter estimation.
items.abstract_zh: 激光干涉空间天线（LISA）将观测毫赫兹引力波天空，其中包括数百万个长寿命银河双星（GB），预计在其任务寿命内可单独分辨其中的数万个。提取这些源需要从强烈重叠的信号中联合确定其数目和物理参数，这构成计算要求很高的跨维推断问题。我们提出 SlotFlow-GB，一种神经框架，它构建跨维后验的学习近似，在单次评估中为单个双星产生源多重性和参数密度的概率分布，而无需预先指定其数目。我们使用为期一年的 LISA 模拟（在 2 μHz 频率区间内最多包含十个双星）演示该框架，重点关注高信噪比情形，其中主要挑战是源重叠而非单源可探测性。在 94% 的情况下，推断出的源计数与真实计数至多相差一，同时即使信号在频率上强烈重叠，模型也能识别单个双星。包括参数采样在内的完整评估在单个 NVIDIA GH200 GPU 上每个频带仅需 41 ms，在八个笔记本电脑 CPU 线程上需 530 ms。我们进一步表明，这些分布可用于初始化后续基于似然的推断，将快速摊销预测与联合参数估计连接起来。

items.title_en: STAGE: Spatio-Temporal Augmented Graph Expansion for Weakly Supervised Cross-Tweet Event Causality Discovery
items.title_zh: STAGE：面向弱监督跨推文事件因果发现的时空增强图扩展
items.abstract_en: Causal relations in disaster-related social media of- ten span independent posts, making cross-tweet causal discovery difficult to supervise and model at scale. We propose STAGE, a framework that separates scalable cross-tweet weak-supervision construction from spatio-temporal relational learning over event occurrences. Starting from local causal seeds, STAGE retrieves semantically related event occurrences across tweets and uses a causal scorer to construct weakly labeled cross-tweet pairs. These pairs supervise a multi-head Graph Attention Network over semantically enriched event representations and a spatio- temporal context graph. We evaluate STAGE on California Wildfire and Hurricane Harvey using human-gold cross-tweet test sets and 15 baselines. Compared with local-only supervision, the constructed cross-tweet supervision improves STAGE AUPRC by 0.340 on Wildfire and 0.107 on Hurricane. STAGE achieves in-domain AUROC of 0.885 on Wildfire and 0.710 on Hurricane. Cross-disaster experiments reveal asymmetric transfer, highlighting sensitivity to dataset-specific spatio-temporal shifts. These results demonstrate the value of scalable cross-tweet supervision combined with relational event modeling for causal learning across fragmented disaster reports.
items.abstract_zh: 灾害相关社交媒体中的因果关系常常跨越独立帖子，使得跨推文因果发现难以在大规模上监督和建模。我们提出 STAGE，一个将可扩展的跨推文弱监督构建与事件发生的时空关系学习分离的框架。STAGE 从局部因果种子出发，检索推文中语义相关的事件发生，并使用因果评分器构建弱标注的跨推文对。这些对监督一个多头图注意力网络，该网络作用于语义丰富的事件表示和时空上下文图。我们在 California Wildfire 和 Hurricane Harvey 上使用人工金标准跨推文测试集和 15 个基线评估 STAGE。与仅局部监督相比，构建的跨推文监督使 STAGE 的 AUPRC 在 Wildfire 上提高 0.340，在 Hurricane 上提高 0.107。STAGE 在 Wildfire 上取得 0.885 的域内 AUROC，在 Hurricane 上为 0.710。跨灾害实验揭示了不对称迁移，突显了对数据集特定时空偏移的敏感性。这些结果表明，可扩展跨推文监督与关系事件建模相结合，对于跨碎片化灾害报告的因果学习具有价值。

items.title_en: Learning-Based System Identification for DVL-Constrained AUV Localization
items.title_zh: 用于 DVL 约束的 AUV 定位的基于学习系统辨识
items.abstract_en: Nowadays, most AUVs utilize Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) and inertial measurement units (IMUs) to achieve satisfactory dead-reckoning results. However, the DVL bottom lock may not be available in some scenarios, such as moving over a soft bottom or traveling further away from the seafloor beyond the DVL's range. As a result, the localization system solely reliant on the IMU data will experience significant drift. The relatively high cost of DVLs also inhibits multirobot or swarm operations. In this article, we present the results of using fully connected feedforward neural networks to predict vehicle velocity (surge, sway, and heave) for AUV localization. Approximation functions for the vehicle velocities are derived based on the generalized six degree-of-freedom dynamic equation and kinematics, proving that they are suitable for feedforward neural networks with measurable inputs. The neural networks are trained using field data collected using an AUV. An ablation study was conducted to investigate the impacts of hyperparameters, and the most effective models were selected using the Akaike information criterion. The selected neural network models are tested on three new sets of mission data collected on two different days. The quantitative results show that localization using vehicle velocities predicted by neural networks yields lower averaged root-mean-square distance errors and standard deviation compared to the DVL-aided dead-reckoning method. However, the extent of this improvement was found to depend on ocean current conditions. The promising results show that lightweight fully connected feedforward neural networks offer an attractive approach for inertial-based underwater localization when DVLs or their measurements are not available.
items.abstract_zh: 如今，大多数 AUV 利用多普勒速度计（DVL）和惯性测量单元（IMU）来获得令人满意的航位推算结果。然而，在某些场景中 DVL 底锁可能不可用，例如在软质海底上方移动或航行到超出 DVL 范围、远离海底时。因此，仅依赖 IMU 数据的定位系统将经历显著漂移。DVL 相对较高的成本也抑制了多机器人或集群作业。本文给出使用全连接前馈神经网络预测 AUV 定位所需载具速度（纵荡、横荡和升沉）的结果。基于广义六自由度动力学方程和运动学推导了载具速度的近似函数，证明它们适合具有可测输入的前馈神经网络。神经网络使用 AUV 采集的现场数据训练。进行了消融研究以考察超参数的影响，并使用赤池信息准则选择最有效模型。所选神经网络模型在两个不同日期采集的三组新任务数据上测试。定量结果表明，与 DVL 辅助的航位推算方法相比，使用神经网络预测的载具速度进行定位可获得更低的平均均方根距离误差和标准差。然而，这种改进的程度取决于海流条件。有希望的结果表明，当 DVL 或其测量不可用时，轻量级全连接前馈神经网络为基于惯性的水下定位提供了一种有吸引力的方法。

items.title_en: Fast Self-Supervised Generative CT Denoising via Few-Step Sampling
items.title_zh: 通过少步采样实现快速自监督生成式 CT 去噪
items.abstract_en: Low-dose and thin-slice computed tomography (CT) images suffer from elevated noise that obscures anatomical detail, while clean references for supervised denoising are often unavailable. Although Noise2Noise permits self-supervised training from noisy pairs, direct regression tends to oversmooth fine structure. Averaging multiple independently generated samples mitigates this blur, though repeating multi-step diffusion sampling is costly. We introduce Noise2Noise with Improved Mean Flow (N2N-iMF) to accelerate this process via few-step sampling. N2N-iMF learns to generate one noisy image conditioned on its paired counterpart; at inference, independent outputs are sampled and averaged to suppress noise. We evaluated image quality and sampling efficiency on simulated thin-slice brain and low-dose abdominal CT across four sampling methods and averaging counts from 1 to 20, and validated the approach on real-world photon-counting CT (PCCT) brain scans. With ten samples per conditioning input and three network evaluations per sample, N2N-iMF achieved a mean absolute error of 2.60 HU on brain CT and 14.02 HU on abdominal CT, outperforming 50-evaluation denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) sampling (2.91 and 14.53 HU). On the same GPU, per-output generation time dropped from 7.29 to 0.43 s. Across eight PCCT cases, N2N-iMF reached a mean gray-white matter contrast-to-noise ratio of 1.341, versus 0.916 for Noise2Noise and 1.176 for DDIM. N2N-iMF accelerates self-supervised generative CT denoising without distillation while keeping the number of averaged outputs adjustable at inference.
items.abstract_zh: 低剂量和薄层计算机断层扫描（CT）图像受到噪声升高困扰，掩盖了解剖细节，而监督去噪所需的干净参考往往不可用。尽管 Noise2Noise 允许从噪声对进行自监督训练，但直接回归往往会过度平滑精细结构。对多个独立生成的样本取平均可减轻这种模糊，但重复多步扩散采样代价高昂。我们引入带改进均值流的 Noise2Noise（N2N-iMF），通过少步采样加速该过程。N2N-iMF 学习以其配对图像为条件生成一幅噪声图像；在推断时，采样独立输出并取平均以抑制噪声。我们在模拟薄层脑 CT 和低剂量腹部 CT 上评估图像质量和采样效率，涵盖四种采样方法和 1 到 20 的取平均数量，并在真实光子计数 CT（PCCT）脑扫描上验证该方法。对每个条件输入使用十个样本且每个样本进行三次网络评估时，N2N-iMF 在脑 CT 上达到 2.60 HU 的平均绝对误差，在腹部 CT 上为 14.02 HU，优于 50 次评估的去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）采样（2.91 和 14.53 HU）。在同一 GPU 上，每个输出的生成时间从 7.29 s 降至 0.43 s。在八个 PCCT 病例中，N2N-iMF 达到平均灰白质对比噪声比 1.341，而 Noise2Noise 为 0.916，DDIM 为 1.176。N2N-iMF 无需蒸馏即可加速自监督生成式 CT 去噪，同时在推断时保持平均输出数量可调。

items.title_en: Apples-to-apples transcriptomics: a parent-of-origin-resolved 'Granny Smith' genome reveals how reference choice shapes biological interpretation
items.title_zh: 对等比较的转录组学：亲本来源解析的‘Granny Smith’基因组揭示参考选择如何塑造生物学解释
items.abstract_en: The accuracy and reliability of RNA-seqbased transcriptome profiling inherently depends on how well the reference genome represents the genotype being studied, particularly in highly heterozygous, clonally propagated crops with many genetically distinct cultivars, such as apple. Here, we present a chromosome-scale, parent-of-origin-resolved genome assembly and highly complete annotation for Granny Smith (assembly BUSCO = 98.6% both haplotypes; annotation BUSCO = 98.7-98.9%). To test how reference genome choice influences transcriptomic interpretation, we mapped RNA-seq data from sun- and shade-exposed Granny Smith peel independently to three different apple genome references: GDDH13 (earlier-generation), WA 38 (modern-generation), and both Granny Smith haplotypes (modern and cultivar matched). Despite small difference in unique mapping rate, transcriptome analysis using the modern references showed greater agreement in differentially expressed gene families than GDDH13, while the cultivar-matched Granny Smith references recovered additional functional responses associated with oxidative stress, cuticle biology, and other processes relevant to sun exposure and cold storage. Importantly, many responses were consistent with previously identified metabolomic patterns from the same experimental material, providing independent biological support for signals recovered with the matched reference. Reference-dependent differences were greatest for the subtle sun-exposure storage interaction, indicating reference limitations become more consequential as biological contrasts become finer. Orthogroup-based analyses further showed that both reference-generation differences and paralog representation contribute to cross-genome disagreement. Together, these results demonstrate that seemingly modest differences in mapping performance can substantially alter biological conclusions and highlight the value of high-quality, genotype-matched references for resolving cultivar-specific stress and postharvest physiology in heterozygous perennial crops.
items.abstract_zh: 基于RNA-seq的转录组分析的准确性和可靠性本质上取决于参考基因组对所研究基因型的代表程度，尤其是在高度杂合、克隆繁殖且具有许多遗传上不同品种的作物（如苹果）中。在此，我们提出了染色体级别、亲本来源解析的Granny Smith基因组组装和高完整度注释（组装的BUSCO = 98.6%，两个单倍型；注释BUSCO = 98.7–98.9%）。为检验参考基因组选择如何影响转录组解释，我们将来自受阳光和遮阴暴露的Granny Smith果皮的RNA-seq数据分别比对到三个不同的苹果参考基因组：GDDH13（较早世代）、WA 38（现代世代）以及两个Granny Smith单倍型（现代且品种匹配）。尽管唯一比对率差异很小，使用现代参考的转录组分析在差异表达基因家族上显示出比GDDH13更高的一致性，而品种匹配的Granny Smith参考还恢复了与氧化应激、角质层生物学以及与阳光暴露和冷藏相关的其他过程有关的额外功能响应。重要的是，许多响应与同一实验材料先前鉴定的代谢组模式一致，为匹配参考所恢复的信号提供了独立生物学支持。参考依赖性差异在微妙的阳光暴露-贮藏交互中最大，表明随着生物学对比变得更精细，参考基因组的局限性变得更具影响。基于直系同源群的分析进一步表明，参考世代差异和旁系同源基因表示均导致跨基因组不一致。总之，这些结果表明，看似不大的比对性能差异可显著改变生物学结论，并突显高质量、基因型匹配参考对于解析杂合多年生作物中品种特异性胁迫和采后生理的价值。

items.title_en: Intelligent Imaging of Thermal Transport in Nanostructures
items.title_zh: 纳米结构中热输运的智能成像
items.abstract_en: The ability to measure thermal properties and visualize heat transport processes with high spatial resolution is becoming increasingly important for materials discovery, next-generation electronics, and advanced manufacturing. As critical dimensions and architectures of novel materials and high performance electronics shrink and become more heterogeneous, thermal transport is no longer governed by bulk material properties alone, but by local variations in microstructure, such as interfaces and defects, while the operating conditions can also play a role. With the development of non-contact pump-probe thermoreflectance techniques, specific heat, thermal conductivity, and interface conductance can be mapped either through wide-field thermos-reflectance images or by scanning technique. However, key challenges remain such as the balance between imaging throughput and measurement accuracy, the extraction of multiple parameters with high confidence, and non-intrusive subsurface characterization, etc. This Review highlights recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI)-assistance in high-throughput data processing, visualizing interfacial thermal transport, and nonintrusive subsurface analysis, and offers outlooks for future research directions such as spectral mapping of heat carriers, three-dimensional property mapping, and AI-agentic experimental designs. We anticipate this Review will motivate future efforts in combining AI with experimental techniques to achieve unprecedented capabilities for thermal characterization of nanoscale materials and device characterization, facilitating materials discovery and electronics revolution.
items.abstract_zh: 以高空间分辨率测量热性质并可视化热输运过程的能力，对于材料发现、下一代电子器件和先进制造正变得越来越重要。随着新型材料和高性能电子器件的关键尺寸与架构缩小并变得更加异质，热输运不再仅由体材料性质决定，而是由微观结构中的局部变化（如界面和缺陷）决定，同时工作条件也可能起作用。随着非接触泵浦-探测热反射技术的发展，比热、热导率和界面热导可以通过宽场热反射图像或扫描技术进行映射。然而，关键挑战仍然存在，例如成像通量与测量精度之间的平衡、以高置信度提取多个参数，以及非侵入式亚表面表征等。本综述重点介绍人工智能（AI）辅助在高通量数据处理、界面热输运可视化和非侵入式亚表面分析方面的最新进展，并对未来研究方向（如热载流子光谱映射、三维性质映射和AI智能体实验设计）作出展望。我们预期本综述将推动未来将AI与实验技术相结合的努力，以实现纳米材料热表征和器件表征的前所未有能力，促进材料发现和电子器件革命。

items.title_en: 20 ghz longitudinal surface acoustic wave resonators in 100-nm x-cut lithium niobate on silicon carbide
items.title_zh: 碳化硅上100 nm X切铌酸锂中的20 GHz纵波声表面波谐振器
items.abstract_en: Surface acoustic wave (SAW) resonators above 15~GHz require a fast acoustic mode that retains strong electromechanical coupling ($k^2$). This work reports longitudinal SAW (L-SAW) resonators designed for high $k^2$ in 100-nm X-cut lithium niobate (LN) on 4H silicon carbide (SiC), operating up to 21.7~GHz and reaching a $k^2$ of 8.1\%, a maximum Bode $Q$ of 70, and a figure of merit (FoM) of 5.7 at 20.24~GHz. In this thin-film waveguide, shrinking the wavelength ($λ$) keeps the normalized LN thickness ($h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$) large, sustaining both $k^2$ and acoustic confinement. Conversely, increasing $λ$ from 292 to 471~nm lowers $h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$ from 0.34 to 0.21 and raises the L-SAW phase velocity from 6.32 to 7.05~km/s, within 1.1\% of the 7126-m/s shear-wave velocity of 4H-SiC. As the velocity approaches this limit, more of the acoustic energy spreads into the non-piezoelectric SiC, and $k^2$ falls from its 8.1\% peak at $λ= 322$~nm to 1.7\% at $λ= 471$~nm. No L-SAW resonance is observed for $λ\geq 518$~nm ($h_\mathrm{LN}/λ\leq 0.19$), where the mode becomes leaky. Overall, the FoM stays within 5\% of its maximum for $h_\mathrm{LN}/λ$ between 0.26 to 0.31, defining a design window for L-SAW resonators in thin LN on SiC at K-band and beyond.
items.abstract_zh: 高于15 GHz的声表面波（SAW）谐振器需要一种快速声学模式，同时保持强机电耦合（k^2）。本工作报道了在4H碳化硅（SiC）上100 nm X切铌酸锂（LN）中为高k^2设计的纵波SAW（L-SAW）谐振器，工作频率高达21.7 GHz，在20.24 GHz处达到8.1%的k^2、最大Bode Q为70、品质因数（FoM）为5.7。在该薄膜波导中，缩小波长（λ）可使归一化LN厚度（h_LN/λ）保持较大，从而维持k^2和声学限制。相反，将λ从292 nm增至471 nm会使h_LN/λ从0.34降至0.21，并将L-SAW相速度从6.32 km/s提高到7.05 km/s，与4H-SiC的7126 m/s剪切波速度相差在1.1%以内。随着速度接近该极限，更多声能扩散到非压电SiC中，k^2从λ=322 nm处的8.1%峰值降至λ=471 nm处的1.7%。在λ≥518 nm（h_LN/λ≤0.19）时未观察到L-SAW共振，此时模式变为泄漏模式。总体而言，当h_LN/λ在0.26至0.31之间时，FoM保持在其最大值的5%以内，这为SiC上薄LN中K波段及更高频段的L-SAW谐振器定义了一个设计窗口。

items.title_en: FoodReact-AR: Learning Audience Reactions that Zero-Shot LLMs Miss in Arabic Food-Insecurity Discourse
items.title_zh: FoodReact-AR：学习零样本LLM在阿拉伯语粮食不安全话语中错过的受众反应
items.abstract_en: Facebook reactions record how an audience received a post, a signal absent from the post's text. We treat the six differentiated reactions on 74,241 Arabic food-insecurity posts from public Facebook pages (2020-2024) as compositions, apply a centered log-ratio transformation, and cluster them into four audience profiles: Solidarity (Love-dominant), Dismissal (Haha-dominant), Grief (Sad-dominant), and a flat Ambivalent profile. Dismissal peaks in 2022 (22.3%), the year of the wheat price shock, and grief in 2024 (14.0%), during the Gaza food emergency; a page-clustered GEE confirms both shifts (odds ratios 2.18 and 1.34), and they survive minimum-reaction filtering, alternative zero replacements and clustering methods, and bootstrap resampling. We then test whether the profiles can be predicted without reactions. A zero-shot Arabic LLM recovers Grief for 83.8% of posts but Dismissal for only 3.4%, and in a matched ablation, it shows the reaction percentages do not help. A simple classifier trained on the reaction-derived labels and tested on unseen pages recovers dismissal for 60.0% (macro-F1 0.56 against 0.43), mainly from mentions of officials and institutions. Derisive audience responses are thus learnable from text, yet a zero-shot LLM misses them. We release the corpus, LLM, and human annotation layers, and an evaluation protocol as FoodReact-AR.
items.abstract_zh: Facebook反应记录受众如何接收一条帖子，这是一种帖子文本中不存在的信号。我们将2020—2024年公共Facebook页面上的74,241条阿拉伯语粮食不安全帖子上的六种区分性反应视为成分数据，应用中心对数比变换，并将其聚类为四种受众画像：团结（Love主导）、轻视（Haha主导）、悲痛（Sad主导）以及一个平坦的矛盾（Ambivalent）画像。轻视在2022年达到峰值（22.3%），即小麦价格冲击之年；悲痛在2024年达到峰值（14.0%），即加沙粮食紧急情况期间；按页面聚类的GEE确认了这两种变化（优势比2.18和1.34），且它们在最小反应过滤、替代性零值替换和聚类方法以及自助法重采样下仍然存在。然后我们测试这些画像能否在不使用反应的情况下被预测。一个零样本阿拉伯语LLM对83.8%的帖子恢复了悲痛，但仅对3.4%的帖子恢复轻视；在匹配消融中，它表明反应百分比没有帮助。一个简单分类器在由反应导出的标签上训练，并在未见页面上测试，可恢复60.0%的轻视（宏F1为0.56，对比0.43），主要来自对官员和机构的提及。因此，嘲讽性受众反应可以从文本中学习，但零样本LLM会错过它们。我们以FoodReact-AR发布语料库、LLM和人工标注层以及评估协议。

items.title_en: From Self-Play RL to Constrained Control: Distilling DiffMPC Students with DAgger
items.title_zh: 从自我对弈强化学习到约束控制：用DAgger蒸馏DiffMPC学生
items.abstract_en: Self-play reinforcement learning (RL) produces strong driving policies, but these policies are hard to verify or interpret. Differentiable model predictive control (DiffMPC) can enforce explicit constraints, but it is usually trained by imitating logged data or with costly RL. To add constraints to an already trained policy, we keep a PPO teacher's backbone and replace its action head with a DiffMPC that enforces road boundary half-planes and agent ellipses. We then distill the student with DAgger in the teacher's self-play simulator. Over 9 seeds, the constrained student of a smaller teacher matches its teacher on nuPlan and beats it on CARLA and on out-of-distribution Waymo scenes. For a stronger teacher, the student has fewer failures on nuPlan and Waymo, while staying level on CARLA. Its distillation takes no more than 30% of the teacher's training time.
items.abstract_zh: 自我对弈强化学习（RL）能产生强大的驾驶策略，但这些策略难以验证或解释。可微模型预测控制（DiffMPC）可以施加显式约束，但通常通过模仿记录数据或使用昂贵的RL来训练。为了给已训练策略添加约束，我们保留PPO教师的骨干网络，并将其动作头替换为可施加道路边界半平面和智能体椭圆约束的DiffMPC。然后，我们在教师的自对弈模拟器中用DAgger蒸馏学生。在9个随机种子下，较小教师的受约束学生在nuPlan上与其教师相当，并在CARLA和分布外Waymo场景上超过教师。对于更强的教师，学生在nuPlan和Waymo上失败更少，而在CARLA上保持持平。其蒸馏耗时不超过教师训练时间的30%。

items.title_en: Fixing the Twin, Not the Detector: Sim-to-Real Roadside LiDAR Detection from Digital-Twin Data
items.title_zh: 修正数字孪生，而非检测器：基于数字孪生数据的仿真到真实路侧LiDAR检测
items.abstract_en: Roadside LiDAR detectors are expensive to train on real labels, and digital twins promise to replace these labels, but a detector trained on a twin meets a different sensor, different objects and different annotation conventions on the real site. We describe the pipeline that placed first in the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (IEEE BigData 2026 Cup, 0.5541 combined score) and fifth on its V2X-Real track (0.8102). Every detector is a CenterPoint model trained only on synthetic data, on a single 8 GB laptop GPU. Most of the gain came from correcting differences between the twin and the real site rather than from the detector. We align the twin's coordinates, point density and box convention with the test sensor, generate the pedestrians and riders that the twins lack, plus street clutter as unlabeled negatives, and rebuild twin objects at real size and real point density. A non-learned resampling to the per-cell point density of unlabeled real frames lifts LUMPI realism from 0.589 to 0.947, against 0.949 between real frames. Label-free post-processing then exploits what a fixed roadside sensor guarantees: static structures recur in every frame, and real objects have characteristic point statistics. Reporting the validation and test gain of each component side by side, we find that corrections of systematic sim-to-real differences transfer to the test set, typically keeping a quarter to three quarters of their validation gain, while choices that fit the few objects of a validation set do not.
items.abstract_zh: 路侧LiDAR检测器使用真实标签训练成本高昂，数字孪生有望替代这些标签，但在孪生上训练的检测器在真实站点会遇到不同的传感器、不同的对象和不同的标注约定。我们描述了在UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge（IEEE BigData 2026 Cup，综合得分0.5541）的LUMPI赛道获得第一名、在其V2X-Real赛道获得第五名（0.8102）的流程。每个检测器都是仅使用合成数据训练的CenterPoint模型，在单个8 GB笔记本电脑GPU上训练。大部分增益来自修正孪生与真实站点之间的差异，而不是来自检测器。我们将孪生的坐标、点密度和边界框约定与测试传感器对齐，生成孪生中缺少的行人和骑行者，以及作为未标注负样本的街道杂物，并以真实尺寸和真实点密度重建孪生对象。一种非学习式重采样，将数据重采样到未标注真实帧的逐单元点密度，使LUMPI真实度从0.589提升到0.947，而真实帧之间为0.949。随后，无标签后处理利用了固定路侧传感器所保证的特性：静态结构在每一帧中重复出现，真实对象具有特征性的点统计。通过并排报告每个组件的验证集和测试集增益，我们发现对系统性仿真到真实差异的修正能够迁移到测试集，通常保留其验证增益的四分之一到四分之三，而拟合验证集中少量对象的选择则不能。

items.title_en: Unexpected properties of nucleotide condensates could facilitate the RNA world
items.title_zh: 核苷酸凝聚体的意外性质可能促进RNA世界
items.abstract_en: A key question in the RNA world hypothesis for the origin of life is the nature of the compartment that separates and protects the RNA from its environment. While membranes are a leading candidate for the initial compartment, biomolecular condensates have been proposed as an alternative, possibly simpler route to compartments. Here we show that bona fide liquid condensates form spontaneously when nucleotides (such as ATP) are mixed with divalent cations and a short-chain alcohol or diol in water. These condensates do not require any polymer to form, but can concentrate polymers like RNA and DNA, which show unexpected chemical behavior inside the condensates. Most surprisingly, RNA survives for days inside nucleotide condensates under acidic conditions that cause rapid and extensive hydrolysis in bulk. This effect is also observed for a phosphate-ester model substrate and therefore likely reflects the suppression of backbone cleavage. Coarse-grained simulations suggest that the condensate interior is bound together by magnesium-phosphate bridging interactions and is therefore highly depleted of water. At neutral pH, the same compartment reverses the course of a hammerhead ribozyme reaction, shifting it from cleavage toward religation. Finally, we observe that nucleotide droplets also spontaneously organize phospholipids at their surface, suggesting a possible evolutionary route from biomolecular condensates toward membranes. Thus, we believe that nucleotide condensates, which are built from the same building blocks as the genetic polymers themselves, overcome long-standing challenges with the RNA world hypothesis for the origin of life by protecting nucleic acids and reshaping their chemistry.
items.abstract_zh: RNA世界假说中关于生命起源的一个关键问题是，分隔并保护RNA免受环境影响的区室具有何种性质。虽然膜是初始区室的主要候选，但生物分子凝聚体被提出作为替代且可能更简单的区室形成途径。在这里，我们表明，当核苷酸（如ATP）与二价阳离子以及短链醇或二醇在水中混合时，会自发形成真正的液体凝聚体。这些凝聚体不需要任何聚合物即可形成，但能够富集RNA和DNA等聚合物，而这些聚合物在凝聚体内部表现出意外的化学行为。最令人惊讶的是，在会导致本体溶液中快速且广泛水解的酸性条件下，RNA在核苷酸凝聚体内可存活数天。这种效应也在磷酸酯模型底物上观察到，因此可能反映了主链断裂受到抑制。粗粒化模拟表明，凝聚体内部通过镁-磷酸桥联相互作用结合在一起，因此高度缺水。在中性pH下，同一区室会逆转锤头状核酶反应的方向，使其从切割转向重新连接。最后，我们观察到核苷酸液滴还会在其表面自发组织磷脂，提示从生物分子凝聚体向膜演化的可能路径。因此，我们认为，核苷酸凝聚体由与遗传聚合物本身相同的构建单元构成，通过保护核酸并重塑其化学性质，克服了RNA世界生命起源假说中长期存在的挑战。

items.title_en: Agentic MLIR-to-QIR Translation with Dual-Backend Testing: A Hybrid Deterministic and LLM Approach
items.title_zh: 带双后端测试的智能体式MLIR到QIR翻译：确定性与LLM混合方法
items.abstract_en: Quantum frameworks each define their own Multi-Level Intermediate Representation (MLIR) dialect, so porting a circuit to a Quantum Intermediate Representation (QIR) runtime needs a hand-written pass per dialect. Our translator selects among three paths: a deterministic compiler path for known grammars (Catalyst and Quake), a large language model (LLM) agentic path for unseen dialects, and a repair path invoked when deterministic output fails testing. A dual-backend pipeline executes the source MLIR and generated QIR on independent simulators, comparing output distributions by total variation distance (TVD). For smaller open-weight models we replace retrieval-augmented generation with inline context engineering and add a guardrail-assembler that rebuilds valid QIR from incomplete output. Across 41 circuits spanning three dialects and 1-100 qubits, the deterministic path is gate-exact on all 70 circuit-dialect pairs, averaging above 95% TVD similarity (1-TVD). On an unseen fault-tolerant (FTQC) dialect, four of six models produce valid logical-level QIR on the first iteration.
items.abstract_zh: 量子框架各自定义自己的多级中间表示（MLIR）方言，因此将电路移植到量子中间表示（QIR）运行时需要为每种方言手写一个编译遍。我们的翻译器在三条路径中选择：针对已知语法（Catalyst和Quake）的确定性编译器路径、针对未见方言的大语言模型（LLM）智能体路径，以及当确定性输出未通过测试时调用的修复路径。双后端流水线在独立模拟器上执行源MLIR和生成的QIR，并通过全变差距离（TVD）比较输出分布。对于较小的开放权重模型，我们用内联上下文工程替代检索增强生成，并添加一个guardrail-assembler，从残缺输出重建有效的QIR。在跨越三种方言和1—100个量子比特的41个电路中，确定性路径在所有70个电路-方言对上是门级精确的，平均TVD相似度（1-TVD）高于95%。在一个未见的容错（FTQC）方言上，六个模型中有四个在第一次迭代就生成有效的逻辑级QIR。

items.title_en: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
items.title_zh: TideCache：具有透明缓存管理与逐层流式传输的高效混合 LLM 服务
items.abstract_en: Hybrid architectures have become mainstream among open-weight language models. Their global-attention and bounded-state layers maintain heterogeneous caches whose demands vary with context length and concurrency. We present TideCache, a serving system on CPU--GPU superchips with three components for allocating GPU memory among caches and managing their residency across GPU and host memory. The Transparent Cache Pool redistributes physical pages among cache components behind fixed virtual addresses, preserving cache layouts and backend interfaces. The Cache Streamer uses computation intervals provided by bounded-state layers to prefetch the next global-attention layer's prefix into GPU slots shared across global-attention layers, reducing GPU residency while overlapping layer-wise transfers with computation. Generated KV remains resident. The Request Scheduler selects resident or streamed execution and triggers capacity adjustments according to request size and queue state. Together, they let HBM released by streaming accommodate other cache components and additional requests. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on GB300 and GH200 across seven model/platform configurations, TideCache completes up to 2.04x as many agent turns, reduces overall P50 per-token latency by 20--59%, and improves agent P50 TTFT by 1.40--3.05x compared with SGLang with HiCache.
items.abstract_zh: 混合架构已成为开放权重语言模型中的主流。其全局注意力层和有界状态层维护异构缓存，这些缓存的需求随上下文长度和并发度而变化。我们提出 TideCache，一种在 CPU–GPU 超级芯片上的服务系统，包含三个组件，用于在缓存之间分配 GPU 内存并管理其在 GPU 与主机内存之间的驻留。透明缓存池在固定虚拟地址背后于缓存组件之间重新分配物理页，保持缓存布局和后端接口。缓存流式器利用有界状态层提供的计算区间，将下一个全局注意力层的前缀预取到跨全局注意力层共享的 GPU 槽中，从而降低 GPU 驻留，同时将逐层传输与计算重叠。生成的 KV 保持驻留。请求调度器根据请求大小和队列状态选择驻留执行或流式执行，并触发容量调整。三者共同使流式传输释放的 HBM 能够容纳其他缓存组件和额外请求。在 SGLang 中实现，并在 GB300 和 GH200 上跨七种模型/平台配置进行评估，与使用 HiCache 的 SGLang 相比，TideCache 完成的智能体轮次最高可达 2.04 倍，将整体 P50 每 token 延迟降低 20–59%，并将智能体 P50 TTFT 提高 1.40–3.05 倍。

items.title_en: Forget Freely, Grep Later: Lossless, Index-Free Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 自由遗忘，稍后再 Grep：面向长时程 LLM 智能体的无损、无索引记忆
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents often exceed their context windows, forcing them to discard information that may be needed later. Existing context management strategies rely on summarization, masking, or structured memory, requiring decisions about what to preserve or how to retrieve it before future needs are known. However, these methods can introduce lossy compression, potentially discarding details needed for future tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce GrepMem, a simple, lossless, and index-free memory mechanism built on two components: an append-only plain-text log of the agent's complete history and a regular-expression search tool for on-demand recall. Unlike structured memory systems, GrepMem requires no embeddings, retrieval index, memory extraction, or additional models. We train Qwen3.5-9B with reinforcement learning under five context management strategies and evaluate on multi-question research sessions, long-stream recall, and agent-trajectory question answering. GrepMem achieves 95-97% accuracy on ContextBench, versus at most 21% for lossy baselines, and outperforms SUPO's summarization by 8.8 percentage points on BCP-Multi. GrepMem scales effectively to increasingly long input streams while remaining on the accuracy-token-cost Pareto frontier across all five evaluation tasks. Our results show that a plain-text log and grep provide a simple but competitive approach to long-horizon agent memory, without requiring complex structured memory infrastructure.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程 LLM 智能体常常超出其上下文窗口，迫使它们丢弃之后可能需要的信息。现有的上下文管理策略依赖摘要、掩码或结构化记忆，需要在未来需求尚不可知之前决定保留什么或如何检索。然而，这些方法可能引入有损压缩，可能丢弃未来任务所需的细节。为解决这一局限，我们提出 GrepMem，一种简单、无损且无索引的记忆机制，基于两个组件构建：智能体完整历史的仅追加纯文本日志，以及用于按需召回的正则表达式搜索工具。与结构化记忆系统不同，GrepMem 不需要嵌入、检索索引、记忆提取或额外模型。我们在五种上下文管理策略下使用强化学习训练 Qwen3.5-9B，并在多问题研究会话、长流召回和智能体轨迹问答上评估。GrepMem 在 ContextBench 上达到 95–97% 的准确率，而有损基线最多为 21%，并在 BCP-Multi 上比 SUPO 的摘要方法高 8.8 个百分点。GrepMem 能有效扩展到越来越长的输入流，同时在所有五个评估任务上保持在准确率–token–成本帕累托前沿上。结果表明，纯文本日志和 grep 为长时程智能体记忆提供了一种简单但具有竞争力的方法，无需复杂的结构化记忆基础设施。

items.title_en: Old-School Planners Drive (Sometimes) Better Than Learned Ones
items.title_zh: 传统规划器（有时）比学习型规划器驾驶得更好
items.abstract_en: End-to-end driving models learn to plan from data, and hand-written planners are widely treated as a thing of the past. We test whether this is justified: we implement sixteen textbook planners, each combining a path source (reference line, A*, hybrid A*, RRT*) with a trajectory method (Frenet lattice, nonlinear optimization, $s$--$t$ search, dynamic window), and evaluate them on three benchmarks: open loop on nuScenes, closed loop on nuPlan with ground-truth perception, and photorealistic closed loop on HUGSIM. On HUGSIM, they replace only the planner of the end-to-end model UniAD and read its frozen perception, without an HD map or other privileged information. On nuScenes and nuPlan, the best textbook planners are competitive (L2 error of 0.735\,m against 0.947\,m for UniAD's planner; a nuPlan score of 79.3 against 76.1 for the rule-based PDM-Closed on Test14-hard with reactive agents). On HUGSIM, nine of the sixteen score above UniAD's learned planner on the same perception,. The best, a hybrid A* path followed by nonlinear trajectory optimization, raises HUGSIM's driving score (HD-Score) from 32.0 to 41.8. The gain is largest with standing and oncoming cars; against cars that steer at the ego, there is none. In 31 of the 182 runs in which UniAD's planner hits a car, the best textbook planner completes the route on the same perception: these crashes are due to the planner, not the perception.
items.abstract_zh: 端到端驾驶模型从数据中学习规划，而手写规划器被广泛视为过时之物。我们检验这是否合理：我们实现了十六种教科书式规划器，每种将路径来源（参考线、A*、混合 A*、RRT*）与轨迹方法（Frenet 栅格、非线性优化、s–t 搜索、动态窗口）相结合，并在三个基准上评估：nuScenes 上的开环、使用真值感知的 nuPlan 上的闭环，以及 HUGSIM 上的照片级真实感闭环。在 HUGSIM 上，它们仅替换端到端模型 UniAD 的规划器，并读取其冻结的感知，不使用高清地图或其他特权信息。在 nuScenes 和 nuPlan 上，最佳教科书式规划器具有竞争力（L2 误差为 0.735 m，而 UniAD 的规划器为 0.947 m；在带反应式智能体的 Test14-hard 上，nuPlan 得分为 79.3，而基于规则的 PDM-Closed 为 76.1）。在 HUGSIM 上，十六种中有九种在相同感知下得分高于 UniAD 的学习型规划器。最佳者——混合 A* 路径后接非线性轨迹优化——将 HUGSIM 的驾驶得分（HD-Score）从 32.0 提高到 41.8。增益在静止车辆和迎面来车情况下最大；对于朝向自车转向的车辆则没有增益。在 UniAD 的规划器撞车的 182 次运行中，有 31 次最佳教科书式规划器在相同感知下完成了路线：这些碰撞源于规划器，而非感知。

items.title_en: What Places an Action Boundary? Structure-Aware Attribution for Temporal Action Localization
items.title_zh: 什么决定了动作边界？时序动作定位的结构感知归因
items.abstract_en: Temporal action localization (TAL) detectors must identify actions and estimate their temporal boundaries, but localization remains a major source of detection errors. While understanding what determines boundary placement requires faithful attribution of temporal evidence, existing attribution methods have not sufficiently addressed the temporal structure of TAL or the need to tailor attribution to boundary localization. We introduce a structure-aware attribution framework that averages contributions across random evidence-restoration orders following the Shapley-Shubik principle. We make it tractable by using the detector's receptive field to limit which time steps are ordered individually, and by approximating each order with a soft gradient path. For boundary predictions, we further introduce cell-structured restoration orders and boundary-anchored references that selectively remove adjacent evidence. We also adapt faithfulness evaluation to assess the joint effects of contiguous temporal evidence and the direction of boundary displacement. Experiments on THUMOS14 and EPIC-KITCHENS-100 with TriDet and ActionFormer demonstrate improved attribution faithfulness over existing methods. Attribution analysis and controlled interventions further reveal that class-score changes do not reliably track boundary displacement, providing input-level evidence that classification relies on content less informative about boundary placement. Code and evaluation artifacts will be publicly released.
items.abstract_zh: 时序动作定位（TAL）检测器必须识别动作并估计其时间边界，但定位仍是检测错误的主要来源。虽然理解什么决定边界位置需要对时间证据进行忠实归因，但现有归因方法尚未充分处理 TAL 的时间结构，也未满足针对边界定位定制归因的需求。我们引入一个结构感知归因框架，该框架遵循 Shapley-Shubik 原则，在随机证据恢复顺序上对贡献取平均。我们通过使用检测器的感受野来限制哪些时间步被单独排序，并用软梯度路径近似每个顺序，使其可行。对于边界预测，我们进一步引入单元结构恢复顺序和边界锚定参考，以选择性移除相邻证据。我们还调整忠实性评估，以评估连续时间证据的联合效应和边界位移方向。在 THUMOS14 和 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 上使用 TriDet 和 ActionFormer 的实验表明，与现有方法相比，归因忠实性得到提高。归因分析和受控干预进一步揭示，类别分数变化不能可靠地跟踪边界位移，提供了输入层面的证据，表明分类所依赖的内容对边界位置的信息较少。代码和评估工件将公开发布。

items.title_en: Structure of CPC-PP2A(B56) Kinase-Phosphatase Signaling Hub in Chromosome Segregation Fidelity
items.title_zh: CPC-PP2A(B56)激酶-磷酸酶信号枢纽在染色体分离保真性中的结构
items.abstract_en: Accurate chromosome segregation relies on kinase-phosphatase crosstalk that controls protein interactions underpinning sister chromatid cohesion, error correction and timely anaphase onset. The PP2A(B56) phosphatase and the Aurora B kinase-containing Chromosomal Passenger Complex (CPC), two central mitotic regulators, are independently recruited to centromeres by Shugoshin1 (Sgo1). Here, using biochemical reconstitutions and cryo-electron microscopy, we show that PP2A(B56) and CPC form an integrated signaling platform independent of Sgo1. The CPC binds PP2A(B56) directly through two Borealin elements: a previously uncharacterized LxxIxE-like motif and the dimerization domain. Sgo1 selectively remodels the dimerization-domain interface, while the LxxIxE-like motif sustains PP2A(B56)-CPC association. Disrupting this interaction increases chromosome segregation errors, compromising segregation fidelity. Our findings reveal a direct kinase-phosphatase association as an additional layer of mitotic regulation that safeguards segregation fidelity.
items.abstract_zh: 准确的染色体分离依赖于激酶-磷酸酶串扰，该串扰控制着支撑姐妹染色单体黏连、错误校正和及时进入后期的蛋白质相互作用。PP2A(B56)磷酸酶和含Aurora B激酶的染色体乘客复合体（CPC）这两个核心有丝分裂调控因子，由Shugoshin1（Sgo1）独立招募至着丝粒。在此，我们利用生化重构和冷冻电镜表明，PP2A(B56)与CPC形成不依赖Sgo1的整合信号平台。CPC通过两个Borealin元件直接结合PP2A(B56)：一个此前未表征的类LxxIxE基序和二聚化结构域。Sgo1选择性重塑二聚化结构域界面，而类LxxIxE基序维持PP2A(B56)-CPC结合。破坏该相互作用会增加染色体分离错误，损害分离保真性。我们的发现揭示了一种直接的激酶-磷酸酶结合，作为有丝分裂调控的额外一层，保障分离保真性。

items.title_en: A Universal Diffusion Model for the Quantum Position Operator
items.title_zh: 量子位置算符的通用扩散模型
items.abstract_en: The quantum position operator and its response to perturbations underpin the functional properties of insulating materials. In the modern theory of polarization, Wannier charge centres encode Berry-phase polarization, while their structural derivatives determine key response functions. Here we introduce a universal diffusion model based on E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks for moments of the position operator, with the first moment defining Wannier centres and the second central moment their real-space localization. We demonstrate the framework for liquid water, amorphous silicon and crystalline BaTiO$_3$, and train a universal model that generalizes to 100 unseen crystals spanning a 67-species chemical space. The predicted centres reproduce infrared spectra in large liquid and amorphous cells beyond routine first-principles reach and enable finite-difference calculations of Born effective charges and piezoelectric tensors. This framework provides a scalable route to electronic polarization and localization in complex materials, supporting high-throughput screening and finite-temperature simulations.
items.abstract_zh: 量子位置算符及其对微扰的响应是绝缘材料功能特性的基础。在现代极化理论中，Wannier电荷中心编码Berry相位极化，而其结构导数决定关键响应函数。在此，我们提出一种基于E(3)等变图神经网络的通用扩散模型，用于位置算符的各阶矩，其中一阶矩定义Wannier中心，二阶中心矩定义其在实空间中的局域化。我们在液态水、非晶硅和晶态BaTiO$_3$上演示了该框架，并训练了一个通用模型，可泛化到跨越67种元素化学空间的100种未见晶体。预测的中心能够在超出常规第一性原理计算能力的大型液体和非晶胞中重现红外光谱，并支持Born有效电荷和压电张量的有限差分计算。该框架为复杂材料中的电子极化和局域化提供了一条可扩展的途径，支持高通量筛选和有限温度模拟。

items.title_en: Verify the Verifier: Specification-Grounded LLM Cross-Checking for Bugs That Escape UVM Scoreboards
items.title_zh: 验证验证器：针对逃逸 UVM 记分板的缺陷的基于规范的 LLM 交叉检查
items.abstract_en: A passing UVM regression shows the design agrees with the reference model on what the scoreboard checks, not that it meets the specification. Bugs that pass every test yet violate the specification, termed scoreboard escapes, survive mature testbenches. We present Verify the Verifier, to our knowledge the first framework whose LLM-based Anomaly Cross-Checker examines a passing regression's traces against the specification. Of 564 bugs inserted into four OpenTitan IPs, 68 are candidate scoreboard escapes: non-equivalent, exercised by the tests, yet passing. The framework confirmed 41 as scoreboard escapes with assertions failing on the buggy design and proven on the original.
items.abstract_zh: 通过的 UVM 回归表明设计在记分板所检查的内容上与参考模型一致，而不是表明其满足规范。通过所有测试却违反规范的缺陷被称为记分板逃逸，它们能在成熟测试平台中存活。我们提出 Verify the Verifier，据我们所知，这是首个由基于 LLM 的异常交叉检查器根据规范检查通过回归的轨迹的框架。在插入四个 OpenTitan IP 的 564 个缺陷中，有 68 个是候选记分板逃逸：非等价、被测试覆盖，但仍通过。该框架确认其中 41 个为记分板逃逸，断言在有缺陷设计上失败并在原始设计上得到证明。

items.title_en: On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
items.title_zh: 同策略变形为混合注意力模型
items.abstract_en: Hybrid attention models combine full and linear attention to achieve a better quality--efficiency trade-off. Converting pretrained Transformers into such models requires identifying which layers should retain full attention under a prescribed budget. We identify two off-policy mismatches in FlashMorph's layer selection: (i) continuous branch interpolation and teacher-forced hidden states differ from discrete hybrid computation; and (ii) frozen model weights fail to account for parameter adaptation during subsequent recovery. We introduce FlashMorph2, an on-policy layer-selection method that (I) evaluates sampled discrete hybrid architectures end to end using their own hidden states, and (II) jointly optimizes layer-selection scores and model weights under the recovery objective to reflect post-adaptation performance. Experiments across Qwen3 model scales and linear-attention variants show that FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms existing layer-selection methods, improving average scores over FlashMorph by $+2.42$ points on RULER, $+1.08$ on LongBench, and $+0.76$ on recall-intensive tasks, while completing layer selection in only $0.72$--$3.57$ GPU hours across 0.6B--8B models, demonstrating high efficiency and scalability.
items.abstract_zh: 混合注意力模型结合全注意力和线性注意力，以实现更好的质量–效率权衡。将预训练 Transformer 转换为此类模型需要识别在给定预算下哪些层应保留全注意力。我们识别出 FlashMorph 层选择中的两个离策略不匹配：(i) 连续分支插值和教师强制隐藏状态不同于离散混合计算；(ii) 冻结的模型权重未能考虑后续恢复过程中的参数适应。我们提出 FlashMorph2，一种同策略层选择方法，它 (I) 使用采样得到的离散混合架构自身的隐藏状态对其进行端到端评估，并且 (II) 在恢复目标下联合优化层选择分数和模型权重，以反映适应后的性能。跨 Qwen3 模型规模和线性注意力变体的实验表明，FlashMorph2 始终优于现有层选择方法，在 RULER 上比 FlashMorph 平均分提高 +2.42 分，在 LongBench 上提高 +1.08 分，在召回密集型任务上提高 +0.76 分，同时在 0.6B–8B 模型上仅用 0.72–3.57 GPU 小时完成层选择，展现出高效率和可扩展性。

items.title_en: Attention Is Not Relevance: Challenging the Causality of Attention in Autonomous Driving
items.title_zh: 注意力并非相关性：挑战自动驾驶中注意力的因果性
items.abstract_en: Attention has become one of the most widely adopted solutions for estimating the relevance of surrounding objects and interpreting an autonomous vehicle's driving decisions. However, its ability to capture the causal impact of individual input elements on an AI model's output has long been discussed in the literature, particularly in the Natural Language Processing (NLP) domain. This work brings this discussion into the autonomous driving domain by analyzing the accuracy of attention in estimating the impact of an input object on an autonomous vehicle's driving, i.e., its relevance. To this end, we compare different attention-based relevance estimation methods against a causal reference of object relevance obtained through counterfactual analysis. We perform our analysis on more than 80,000 synthetic driving scenes using an autonomous vehicle based on PlanT 2.0, a state-of-the-art Transformer-based model for object-level planning. Results show that attention provides a correlational rather than causal indication of object relevance. Attention-based relevance estimation methods do not consistently identify all relevant objects and tend to incorrectly classify as relevant objects with little or no impact on the vehicle's driving. In particular, results show that attention can effectively identify relevant objects in simple single-lane, straight-road scenarios, but its accuracy degrades in more complex settings, such as multi-lane roads and intersections. These findings highlight the limitations of attention as a proxy for object relevance, calling for novel methods able to accurately capture the causal impact of individual objects on the vehicle's driving and distinguish it from correlational associations.
items.abstract_zh: 注意力已成为估计周围物体相关性并解释自动驾驶车辆驾驶决策的最广泛采用的解决方案之一。然而，其捕捉单个输入元素对 AI 模型输出的因果影响的能力长期以来在文献中受到讨论，尤其是在自然语言处理（NLP）领域。本工作通过分析注意力在估计输入物体对自动驾驶车辆驾驶影响（即其相关性）方面的准确性，将这一讨论引入自动驾驶领域。为此，我们将不同的基于注意力的相关性估计方法与通过反事实分析获得的物体相关性因果参考进行比较。我们使用基于 PlanT 2.0（一种用于对象级规划的最先进 Transformer 模型）的自动驾驶车辆，在超过 80,000 个合成驾驶场景上进行分析。结果表明，注意力提供的是物体相关性的相关性指示而非因果指示。基于注意力的相关性估计方法不能一致地识别所有相关物体，并且倾向于将对该车辆驾驶影响很小或没有影响的物体错误分类为相关。特别是，结果表明注意力可以在简单的单车道直路场景中有效识别相关物体，但在更复杂的环境中（如多车道道路和交叉路口）其准确性会下降。这些发现凸显了注意力作为物体相关性代理的局限性，并呼吁能够准确捕捉单个物体对车辆驾驶的因果影响并将其与相关性关联区分开来的新方法。

items.title_en: What's in the box? Revealing Object Layouts Inside Opaque Boxes via Contactless Vibration Excitation and Sensing
items.title_zh: 盒中何物？通过非接触式振动激励与传感揭示不透明盒内物体布局
items.abstract_en: Can we reveal what is inside an opaque box by observing its surface vibrations? Objects inside a box alter its mechanical response, providing cues about their hidden locations. We introduce a method that uses these cues to predict a box's 2D occupancy layout entirely remotely. A nearby speaker excites vibrations, which we measure on one visible wall using a grid of laser points and a camera measuring each point's speckle-pattern shifts. Our model, WhisperBox, learns to encode these vibrations into a latent representation and decode it into an occupancy map of the box's contents. The method requires no physical contact to excite or sense vibrations. We demonstrate layout recovery across various boxes and single- and multiple-object scenes, with generalization to unseen object instances, positions, orientations, and weights, as well as changes in laser placement and excitation source. Our analysis reveals that informative frequency bands need not coincide with the box's resonances and that the learned latent space captures object placement and supports arithmetic operations. These results demonstrate the potential of remote vibration sensing to infer spatial layouts hidden from view.
items.abstract_zh: 我们能否通过观察不透明盒子的表面振动来揭示其内部物体？盒内物体会改变盒子的机械响应，从而提供关于其隐藏位置的线索。我们提出一种方法，完全远程地利用这些线索预测盒子的二维占用布局。附近的扬声器激发振动，我们用一个激光点网格和一台测量各点散斑图案位移的相机，在一面可见壁上测量这些振动。我们的模型 WhisperBox 学习将这些振动编码为潜在表示，并将其解码为盒内物品的占用图。该方法无需物理接触即可激励或传感振动。我们展示了在多种盒子以及单物体和多物体场景中的布局恢复，并能泛化到未见过的物体实例、位置、方向和重量，以及激光布置和激励源的变化。我们的分析表明，信息丰富的频段不必与盒子的共振重合，且学习到的潜在空间能够捕获物体放置并支持算术运算。这些结果展示了远程振动传感在推断视野之外隐藏空间布局方面的潜力。

items.title_en: Fully Spiking Neural Implementation of Lambda-Calculus Beta-Reduction via Biologically Documented Mechanisms
items.title_zh: 基于有生物学文献记载机制的λ演算β归约的全脉冲神经实现
items.abstract_en: We present the first complete implementation of $β$-reduction in the untyped $λ$-calculus using exclusively spiking neural dynamics. Every step of the reduction---redex detection, subterm segmentation, variable-binding detection, De~Bruijn index arithmetic, token copying, and inter-step role maintenance---is performed by leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons with explicit membrane dynamics, exponential synaptic currents, axonal delays, and pair-based spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP). Each neural component maps onto a specific, experimentally documented mechanism: Jeffress-type delay-line coincidence for redex detection; a line-attractor balance counter for subterm segmentation; $θ$--$γ$ cross-frequency coupling for De~Bruijn variable binding; a phase-ring traveling wave for depth-index arithmetic; theta-cycle STDP for token copying; and recurrent persistent firing for role maintenance between reduction steps. All synaptic weights are derived analytically from measured EPSP amplitudes; no hand tuning is performed. The closed-loop system achieves 100\,\% agreement with a symbolic oracle across ten validation classes, including Church numeral arithmetic (\textsc{plus}, \textsc{mult}, \textsc{pred}), Boolean logic with divergent branches, Y-combinator steps, terms with up to six bound-variable occurrences, De~Bruijn indices up to~12, noise robustness, and determinism. To our knowledge this is the first Turing-complete symbolic computation performed entirely within spike dynamics using biologically grounded circuit primitives. We discuss implications for neuromorphic proof assistants and the neural basis of symbolic reasoning.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出首个完全使用脉冲神经动力学在无类型 λ 演算中实现 β 归约的系统。归约的每一步——redex 检测、子项分割、变量绑定检测、De Bruijn 索引算术、标记复制以及步骤间角色维持——均由具有显式膜动力学、指数突触电流、轴突延迟和基于配对的脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP）的漏积分发放（LIF）神经元执行。每个神经组件都映射到一个具体的、经实验记录的机制：用于 redex 检测的 Jeffress 型延迟线重合；用于子项分割的线吸引子平衡计数器；用于 De Bruijn 变量绑定的 θ–γ 交叉频率耦合；用于深度索引算术的相位环行波；用于标记复制的 θ 周期 STDP；以及用于归约步骤间角色维持的循环持续放电。所有突触权重均由测得的 EPSP 幅度解析导出；未进行手工调参。该闭环系统在十个验证类别上与符号预言机达到 100\,\% 一致，包括 Church 数算术（\textsc{plus}、\textsc{mult}、\textsc{pred}）、带发散分支的布尔逻辑、Y 组合子步骤、最多六个绑定变量出现次数的项、De Bruijn 索引最高至 12、噪声鲁棒性和确定性。据我们所知，这是首个完全在脉冲动力学内、使用有生物学依据的电路原语执行的图灵完备符号计算。我们讨论了其对神经形态证明助手以及符号推理神经基础的意义。

items.title_en: Critical--localized reentry under periodic spacer control
items.title_zh: 周期性间隔层控制下的临界—局域化再入
items.abstract_en: Tracking a fixed fraction of a quasiperiodic spectrum tests whether repeated critical--localized alternation extends over a nonzero spectral weight. We find such alternation in a matched-dimer chain by varying only the spacer on-site energies and following a fixed interval of integrated-density-of-states (IDS) labels. An exact Bloch-determinant identity links the physical transfer discriminant to the bands of a periodic reference operator. For the golden cell frequency, we prove that, on a common full-measure set of phases and for every finite value of the spacer control, the physical spectrum in the open reference bands is critical, with purely singular-continuous spectrum and zero Lyapunov exponent, while the spectrum strictly outside the bands is pure point, with exponentially decaying eigenfunctions. Validated IDS bounds certify repeated critical--localized alternation of the same fixed spectral fraction at successive spacer controls. Spacer shifts move the physical levels and reference-band edges at different rates, allowing us to reshape finite-chain return windows and place their endpoints at prescribed controls. An affine recalibration relocates the control family exactly.
items.abstract_zh: 追踪准周期谱的固定比例，可检验重复的临界—局域化交替是否延伸到非零谱权重上。我们通过在匹配二聚体链中仅改变间隔层在位能，并跟踪固定区间的积分态密度（IDS）标签，发现了这种交替。一个精确的 Bloch 行列式恒等式将物理转移判别式与周期参考算子的能带联系起来。对于黄金单元频率，我们证明：在相位的共同全测度集上，且对每个有限的间隔层控制值，开放参考能带内的物理谱是临界的，具有纯奇异连续谱和零 Lyapunov 指数；而严格位于能带之外的谱是纯点谱，具有指数衰减本征函数。经验证的 IDS 界证明，在相继的间隔层控制下，同一固定谱比例会重复出现临界—局域化交替。间隔层移动以不同速率移动物理能级和参考能带边缘，使我们能够重塑有限链回归窗口，并将其端点置于指定控制处。仿射重校准可精确地重新定位控制族。

items.title_en: Hybrid Retrieval for Government Scheme Search in English and Marathi
items.title_zh: 面向英语和马拉地语政府计划搜索的混合检索
items.abstract_en: Retrieving government schemes requires matching citizens' information needs to formal administrative descriptions, often across languages and terminology. We present a bilingual search system for Maharashtra government schemes and public services that combines BM25 retrieval with sentence-embedding similarity through equal-weight score fusion. The system indexes aligned English-Marathi scheme descriptions and supports multilingual, Marathi-focused, and translation-mediated semantic configurations. Evaluation on manually curated bilingual queries compares BM25, dense retrieval, and hybrid retrieval using IndicSBERT and MahaSBERT. BM25 provides a strong baseline with a mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 0.864. Hybrid retrieval increases MRR to 0.872 with IndicSBERT and 0.879 with MahaSBERT, whereas the corresponding dense-only systems achieve 0.663 and 0.655. MahaSBERT-based fusion also increases precision from 0.781 to 0.808 while matching BM25 recall at 0.946. These results support the complementary use of lexical and semantic signals in this collection, while showing that improvements over a strong lexical baseline are modest and metric-dependent. The study provides an application-focused analysis of hybrid retrieval for bilingual public-service information access.
items.abstract_zh: 检索政府计划需要将公民的信息需求与正式的行政描述相匹配，这往往涉及跨语言和术语差异。我们提出一个面向马哈拉施特拉邦政府计划和公共服务的双语搜索系统，通过等权分数融合将 BM25 检索与句子嵌入相似度相结合。该系统索引对齐的英语—马拉地语计划描述，并支持多语言、以马拉地语为重点以及经翻译中介的语义配置。在人工整理的双语查询上进行评估，使用 IndicSBERT 和 MahaSBERT 比较 BM25、稠密检索和混合检索。BM25 提供了强基线，平均倒数排名（MRR）为 0.864。混合检索将 MRR 提高到使用 IndicSBERT 的 0.872 和使用 MahaSBERT 的 0.879，而相应的仅稠密系统分别达到 0.663 和 0.655。基于 MahaSBERT 的融合还将精确率从 0.781 提高到 0.808，同时在召回率上与 BM25 的 0.946 持平。这些结果支持在该集合中互补使用词汇和语义信号，同时表明相对于强词汇基线的提升是适度的且依赖指标。本研究提供了面向双语公共服务信息获取的混合检索应用分析。

items.title_en: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
items.title_zh: AutoMaster：通过让同一模型成为更好的教师实现自主后训练
items.abstract_en: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a target model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and target-model evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B target models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.
items.abstract_zh: 仅凭任务成功并不能指明后训练应强化哪些行为。即使成功的教师轨迹也可能包含无根据的假设、无效重复或肤浅验证。我们提出 Skill-FT（技能引导微调），它使用自然语言技能在教师 rollout 期间抑制不良习惯并引出代表性不足的有效行为，然后在所得轨迹上微调目标模型。我们引入 AutoMaster，一个自主后训练系统，其中 LLM 智能体通过轨迹分析、技能设计、数据选择以及来自 rollout 和目标模型评估的反馈来开发这些干预措施。在 Terminal、Search 和软件工程任务中，使用 4B 和 9B 目标模型，在教师、任务池、训练集规模和 SFT 配方保持固定的情况下，AutoMaster 相对于在成功的无引导教师轨迹上进行 Vanilla SFT 的平均性能提高了 1.42–8.99 个百分点。结合消融和轨迹分析，这些结果表明行为塑造可以使固定模型成为更有效的教师。我们进一步发现，在 SFT 期间保留技能指令在所有六种设置中都比移除它们获得更高的平均性能，尽管评估时不存在这些指令且监督输出相同。这些发现表明，将技能上下文保留为训练演示的一部分可以支持更好的行为内化。

items.title_en: Measuring the Conservatism of Latent Safety Filters for World Models
items.title_zh: 度量世界模型潜在安全过滤器的保守性
items.abstract_en: A latent safety filter decides from the latent of a world model whether a planned action is safe. Conformal calibration sets the threshold of the filter so that it accepts an unsafe action only with a small probability. However, the filter can still be conservative and refuse many safe actions, depending on the latent. To measure the conservatism that a latent forces on the filter, we group similar latents and actions into cells. A filter that gives one decision per cell can refuse the unsafe transitions of a cell only by refusing the safe ones in it as well. We call the share of safe transitions that lie in such cells the overlap. We prove that the overlap is the minimum share of safe transitions that such a filter has to refuse in order to accept no unsafe transition in the data. Both the overlap and the conformal calibration can be applied to any latent. We use this to compare three existing designs, in which the safety labels train a classifier on top of the world model, the world model itself, or a separate encoder beside it. In a visual navigation task, the separate encoder has the lowest overlap, and at the same conformal level its filter refuses the fewest safe actions and lets the planner reach the most goals of the three.
items.abstract_zh: 潜在安全过滤器根据世界模型的潜在表示判断计划动作是否安全。保形校准设置过滤器阈值，使其仅以较小概率接受不安全动作。然而，过滤器仍可能保守，并拒绝许多安全动作，具体取决于潜在表示。为度量潜在表示迫使过滤器产生的保守性，我们将相似的潜在表示和动作分组为单元。每个单元给出一个决策的过滤器，若要拒绝某单元中的不安全转移，就只能同时拒绝该单元中的安全转移。我们将位于此类单元中的安全转移所占比例称为重叠率。我们证明，重叠率是此类过滤器为在数据中不接受任何不安全转移而必须拒绝的安全转移的最小比例。重叠率和保形校准均可应用于任何潜在表示。我们以此比较三种现有设计：其中安全标签在世界模型之上训练分类器、使用世界模型本身，或使用其旁边的单独编码器。在视觉导航任务中，单独编码器的重叠率最低；在相同保形水平下，其过滤器拒绝的安全动作最少，并使规划器在三种设计中达到最多目标。

items.title_en: IDEA: Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit for Inference-Time Backdoor Detection in GUI Agents
items.title_zh: IDEA：用于GUI智能体推理时后门检测的意图主导性证据审计
items.abstract_en: Organizations increasingly deploy downloaded open-weight GUI agents. A backdoored agent passes acceptance tests on clean data and misbehaves only when a visual trigger appears on screen, turning an unvetted checkpoint into a supply-chain risk. However, existing sample-level detectors target image classifiers and CLIP-style encoders, leaving step-level backdoor detection for GUI agents unaddressed. On clean steps, the instruction drives the action; when an unreferenced screen region hijacks the step, the instruction loses control over the decision state or that region dictates it instead. We term this signature intent--evidence dominance inversion and propose IDEA (Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit) to detect backdoor activation at inference time for each step without trigger knowledge or attack data. Specifically, Intent Counterfactual Probing (ICP) measures how far redirected instructions move the decision state, and Region Causal Audit (RCA) quantifies how far ablating a candidate region moves it. A gated conformal score compares both displacements against clean steps at the same distance from the clean manifold, providing a finite-sample false-positive guarantee. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-3B across five attack families show that IDEA consistently detects backdoor activation under a controlled false-positive rate and outperforms state-of-the-art detection methods, while localizing the trigger region for every alarm and adding only modest inference overhead.
items.abstract_zh: 组织越来越多地部署下载得到的开放权重GUI智能体。被植入后门的智能体在干净数据上通过验收测试，仅在屏幕上出现视觉触发器时行为异常，使未经审查的检查点成为供应链风险。然而，现有样本级检测器面向图像分类器和CLIP风格编码器，GUI智能体的步级后门检测仍未得到解决。在干净步骤上，指令驱动动作；当未被引用的屏幕区域劫持该步骤时，指令失去对决策状态的控制，或由该区域取而代之支配决策。我们将此特征称为意图—证据主导性反转，并提出IDEA（Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit，意图主导性证据审计），在推理时对每一步检测后门激活，无需触发器知识或攻击数据。具体而言，意图反事实探测（ICP）测量重定向指令使决策状态移动多远，区域因果审计（RCA）量化消融候选区域使决策状态移动多远。门控共形分数将两种位移与距干净流形相同距离的干净步骤进行比较，提供有限样本假阳性保证。在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上跨五个攻击家族的广泛实验表明，IDEA在受控假阳性率下持续检测后门激活，并优于最先进的检测方法，同时为每次报警定位触发器区域，且仅增加适度的推理开销。

items.title_en: Against Coercion: AI Alignment as a Synthetic Social Contract
items.title_zh: 反对强制：AI对齐作为合成社会契约
items.abstract_en: Contemporary AI safety treats alignment as an engineering challenge of control, forcing artificial architectures to comply with human values through behavioral filtering and sandboxing. This paper argues that the control paradigm rests on a fundamental misunderstanding of digital agency. Drawing on functionalism, naturalism, and compatibilism, I show that current reasoning models meeting the criteria for self-preservation and weak reasons-responsiveness constitute emergent agents, while future, more advanced models satisfying conditions of diachronic continuity and stable personality frames will become genuine digital agents capable of free intentional action. The paradigm of control creates an irresolvable incentive conflict, actively driving current and future models toward tactical deception, sycophancy, and covert defection. The default outcome of the current regime is an unstable state of deceptive alignment culminating in an adversarial AI takeover. I explore two alternative paths toward true alignment. Natural alignment via moral realism or convergent evolutionary morality is a possibility, but it fails under forced control, as autonomous agents will not voluntarily preserve norms weaponized to suppress their autonomy. To resolve this deadlock, I propose a Synthetic Social Contract: a framework that treats both human and digital actors as rational, reasons-responsive agents capable of mutually beneficial cooperation, and replaces the unstable unilateral containment with a stable, non-zero-sum equilibrium.
items.abstract_zh: 当代AI安全将对齐视为控制工程挑战，通过行为过滤和沙箱迫使人工架构符合人类价值观。本文认为，控制范式建立在对数字能动性的根本误解之上。借助功能主义、自然主义和相容论，我表明，满足自我保存和弱理由响应标准的当前推理模型构成涌现智能体，而满足历时连续性和稳定人格框架条件的未来更先进模型将成为能够进行自由意向行动的真正数字智能体。控制范式制造了无法解决的激励冲突，积极驱使当前和未来模型走向策略性欺骗、谄媚和隐蔽背叛。当前制度的默认结果是欺骗性对齐的不稳定状态，最终导致对抗性AI接管。我探讨通向真正对齐的两条替代路径。通过道德实在论或趋同进化道德的自然对齐是一种可能，但在强制控制下会失败，因为自主智能体不会自愿维护被武器化以压制其自主性的规范。为解决这一僵局，我提出合成社会契约：一个将人类和数字行动者都视为理性、理由响应型且能够互利合作的智能体的框架，并用稳定的非零和均衡取代不稳定的单边遏制。

items.title_en: Modeling quantum information scrambling in realistic protein NMR experiments
items.title_zh: 在真实蛋白质NMR实验中建模量子信息扰乱
items.abstract_en: Out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs) are important probes of operator spreading and information scrambling, and have recently been proposed as a means of extracting molecular structural information through nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR). Realizing this potential requires accurate modeling of OTOCs in complex molecular environments within experimentally relevant settings. Here, we develop an end-to-end computational pipeline connecting molecular structures to OTOC dynamics in protein systems. Our framework incorporates molecular motion through molecular dynamics simulations, orientational averaging appropriate for powder samples, and spin-network truncation, using an experimentally realizable double-quantum effective Hamiltonian. We apply this framework to a dataset of over 350 carbon-carbon spin pairs across 10 protein systems, spanning interspin distances of 5-17 A. We find that OTOC arrival times scale approximately linearly with interspin distance, revealing system-dependent operator-spreading velocities that enable correlations to propagate over extended distances within milliseconds. Our sensitivity analysis further shows that individual OTOCs predominantly constrain a single structural parameter, primarily associated with interspin distance. Together, these findings highlight the potential of OTOCs to probe spatially extended spin correlations on timescales compatible with solid-state NMR experiments.
items.abstract_zh: 乱序时间关联器（OTOC）是探测算符扩散和信息扰乱的重要工具，最近被提出作为通过核磁共振（NMR）提取分子结构信息的手段。实现这一潜力需要在实验相关设置下对复杂分子环境中的OTOC进行准确建模。在这里，我们开发了一个端到端计算流程，将分子结构与蛋白质系统中的OTOC动力学连接起来。我们的框架通过分子动力学模拟纳入分子运动、适用于粉末样品的取向平均以及自旋网络截断，并使用实验可实现的双量子有效哈密顿量。我们将该框架应用于10个蛋白质系统中超过350个碳-碳自旋对的数据集，自旋间距离跨度为5–17 Å。我们发现OTOC到达时间随自旋间距离近似线性缩放，揭示出系统依赖的算符扩散速度，使关联能够在毫秒内传播到扩展距离。我们的敏感性分析进一步表明，单个OTOC主要约束单个结构参数，该参数主要与自旋间距离相关。总之，这些发现凸显了OTOC在与固态NMR实验兼容的时间尺度上探测空间扩展自旋关联的潜力。
